chapters.title: Chapter 2480 2480 The Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor! III
paragraphs: 2480 The Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor! III
Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!

Something that very few beings attained as those who didn't have it had to survive purely based on their essences- with a Dynamis of Extremity being one of the few authorities that could handle the authority of nothingness and stop it from permeating into one's Soul.
Yet there was one truth that made those who had attained Vacuous Hyperversal Authority so crucial.
Even if one could survive in such a region outside the scope of time and reality...could they ever have an output of their essence?

The moment they released any of their essence outside to release an ability or skill, it would be devoured by the authority of nothingness unless...it was the essence of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!
BZZZT!
Burning cherry colored light rose in the depths of darkness as to Noah's eyes, the space was as clear as day.
To others, there was only endless darkness as they couldn't feel anything.

Yet his Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation could withstand Vacuous Hyperversal Authority while his Absolute Dynamis of Extremity was the one authority that could freely isolate one from Vacuous Hyperversal Authority even before Noah gained his Foundation!
It was one of the few methods of attacking here.
And with the quasi-quality of Infinite Mana for his Quintessential Hyperversal Soul...
An endless cherry colored sea bloomed behind Noah's visage.
His figure moved across the dense space of nothingness as he floated ever closer towards his target.
Euryale of the Noblesse Lineage.

A name only looked at as a Legend from the memories of the noblesse Noah had destroyed. Yet now, her dark hair buzzed as one could see a malevolent and shocked expression on her face, layers of vibrant Crimson black illusory shields conjured around her as they covered her entirely!

Not too far from her, the other Apex Aeonic Noblesse Richard could be seen doing something similar as he cast protective layers a Dynamis of Extremity to prevent the area of nothingness from entering his Aspects of Existence.
The both of them only had a singular goal while surrounded by Vacuous Hyperversal Authority that they had only heard about!
Noah drew closer to Euryale as the burning cherry flames around him cried out with rage.
He drew inches away from her as she was crouched in a battle stance ready to move at any moment, preserving all of her essence and authority as she truly felt nothing around her!

Even though Noah was right in front of her figure, she didn't feel anything about him as more layers of defenses wrapped around her, a malevolent gaze on her face as she bellowed out even in such a situation.
Sound could not be heard as Noah inferred from her lips.
"Little rat, where are you?! I know a domain like this is timed as when I get out...you're ripped to fucking pieces!"
WAA!
Her lips repeated these words over and over again as even in this situation, she was confident in her own power.
She knew her enemy was someone who hadn't even undergone Apexification- no matter how they had access to momentarily lay out a region of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
So long as she persevered in this state...that would be it for him.
This was what she believed anyway.
Noah stared at her battle ready visage right in front of him as a vile being like this who nearly killed his son...he would break her down until she sensed such terror herself!
He would tear her apart piece by piece until this malicious expression on her face was entirely torn away.

And so...he raised his hand and unfurled his fist as with the back of his hand that was wrapped in a scaled armament pulsing with Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity, he swung towards the left side of her face!
PAH!
A backhand filled with the authority of an Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity.
A backhand carrying 25 Quintessential Hyperversal Damage Values!

The impact was dreadful, and yet the layers of defenses Euryale laid out at least worked as they fluctuated, her figure feeling the impact only when it arrived as thereafter, she moved quickly to strike where Noah's hands had been!
SHAA!
Her hands had naturally and naturally moved while trying to release beams of burning darkness, but they were devoured by the emptiness around them as nothing reached Noah.
Instead, Noah's swung right hand came down from the other side to smack her right cheek, his left hand forming into a fist that directly went towards her abdominal region!
PAH!
BOOM!
Heavy impacts boomed out as Euryale roared out silently, none of the damage reaching her as it seemed her Apex Aeonic Defense Values were at the very minimum nearing 100!

Noah's strikes pulsing with 25 Quintessential Hyperversal Damage Values shouldn't be reaching her, yet every single one ate up at her Soul Values as she had to both survive and expend her power in this realm of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, and also defend against an enemy she couldn't see!
And this wasn't all.
Hyperversal Damage Values. Apex Aeonic Damage Values.
These different values held a distinction that even Noah himself had yet to fully grasp as the latter Value was much greater in its standing!

Every time Noah struck, even though his Damage Values were 25, he saw the layers of defenses around Euryale fluctuating in a much greater effect as it felt like his Damage Values were much more penetrative- overpowering the Apex Aeonic Defense Values Euryale conjured by an unknown percentage.
It was the difference in quality as truthfully, it may have been 30 or 35 Damage Values being delivered instead of the 25!

Noah had to better analyze the differences between Quintessential Hyperversal Damage Values at a different time as now, his hands continued to smash down and release their cold anger on this foe before him.
She couldn't see or feel him, and she could only react after being hit.

She couldn't express any manifestation of her core as for her, no matter how much more potent she was compared to him- she was a sitting duck unless she could withstand and freely move around in this realm filled with Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!

chapters.title: Chapter 2481 2481 The Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor! IV
paragraphs: 2481 The Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor! IV
HUUM!
The cherry colored flames behind Noah flowed into his fists.
His figure was enlarged as a single smack of his hand covered Euryale's whole head, and a smash of his fist would have its impact felt with half of her whole body!

He moved around her freely and began pummeling her from different directions, her expression buzzing and full of rage as she flailed around trying to hit back against an enemy she couldn't see or feel.
It was a terrifying state!
PAH! BOOM! PAH!

Her layers of defenses fluctuated and flickered as they absorbed tens of Quintessential Hyperversal Damage Value multiple times within an instant, the authority of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority sneaking in with any open gaps as this situation was truly the worst against someone that had no connection to it.
One of the only ways to defend against it was to never allow oneself to be covered in its domain!
"OOOH!"

Euryale bellowed out with fervor and anger at taking hits constantly, feeling her used up soul values continuing to drain as she spun her body with her fists and legs outstretched around her while they shone with the glint of multiple Dynamis of Extremity.
At such a juncture, Noah's cold figure moved above her as he tapped out.
BZZT!
A singularity born of the essence of Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity was born as it remained steady and ready.
An instant later, an infinity rune carrying the black gold essence of the Aletheian Dynamis of Extremity formed as it spun with infinite mass and density!
Then, the surging cherry flames coalesced into a single region as three abilities, each boasting 25 Quintessential Hyperversal Damage Values, formed with utmost grandeur.

Noah's left hand then pulsed dangerously as a black gold sword of flames instantly bloomed, his right hand conjuring a pulsing spear bearing the weight of the whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven in addition to the flames of a Dynamis of Extremity!

The Singularity, Infinity rune, coalesced cherry flames, and the black gold sword of flames in Noah's left hand simultaneously thundered down as their aim was to instantaneously deliver over 100 Quintessential Hyperversal Damage Values.
To instantly shatter the barrier still trying to protect Euryale!

At the same time, more manifestations of singularities, infinity runes, cherry colored flames, and black gold swords of flames began to bloom around Euryale's figure as even if they couldn't all be controlled to arrive simultaneously, it would be close as what was about to happen now...was a bombardment of abilities.
Mana and Soul Values were used without reservations as the rage of the Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor led to nothing other than spamming!
The top four attacks arrived first as...
BOOM...CRACK!
A heavy set of damage values exploded out as the barrier around Euryale shattered.
And before she could reform it as her head turned up while bellowing out, the Spear in Noah's right hand...was already an inch from her raised forehead.
A spear burning with the flames of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity while also carrying the weight of the whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
It arrived first before any other spammed attacks as Noah coldly and with blazing Wrath drove it into the head of Euryale!

Skin, bones, and stellar brain matter shattered as the Spear pierced her head and passed through the very center of her throat, continuing down and piercing her chest and buzzing with destruction as it crossed her abdominal region and came out on the other end!
It was a horrific scene as at that same instant, the other bombardment of attack arrived while streams of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority streamed towards her mutilated body.
"GRHOO!"

Her mouth and neck were split apart as guttural sounds came, and yet her lifeforce was abundant as an Apex Aeonic Lifeform as she shockingly grabbed onto the Spear mutilating her tightly, ferociously pushing it even deeper into her as she rose up to grasp the hand of the man holding it!

She...had actually maxed to grasp onto him while surrounded by nothingness, her bleeding eyes filled with anger and madness as she ushered all of her Damage Value to bombard the being she had grasped!
Noah's Innate Quintessential Hyperversal Barrier fluctuated as the protective cherry flames around him burst, but this was all.

The streams of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority had sunk into different parts of her body during the bombardment that continued even now as Euryale was losing feeling in different parts of her, her soul and other Aspects of Existence becoming jumbled!
Noah's gaze was exceedingly cold as his left hand came down and grasped the tight grasp of Euryale's hand that had grasped onto his, unclasping her fingers as if they were steeled metalloids.

Her eyes on her head that was split in two were still as ferocious as she choked on the heavy spear, the feeling of nothingness becoming ever present as Crimson blood burst and trickled down into nothingness.
Immense pain wracked different parts of her body as her immense life force was making it even worse- where she could feel every single thing!
Noah's bombardment of attacks stopped as he looked at the body of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform torn and shredded due to his actions.
An Apex Aeonic Lifeform- skewered by a spear through his hands!
Streams of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority had entered different parts of her as the moment this occurred, her fate was sealed!
At such a juncture, dazzling cherry colored flames moved out with utmost control from Noah as they encased the splintered head region of Euryale that still had a spear piercing through it.
The Vacuous Hyperversal Authority in that area was isolated out as for the first time in what seemed like a million years to Euryale, she could see again.

Her eyes that were staring in different directions due to her body being split left and right gazed forward with utmost fury as the light of the cherry colored flames only allowed her to see the devilishly handsome face of the Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor.
"Fu-rckign c-oward..."
She slurred her words out as even at this juncture, she held many grievances as her personality didn't change.
She knew that if this Vacuous Hyperversal Authority around them wasn't there, this being wouldn't have been able to put her in this state!
Yet he stared towards her coldly as he voiced out.
"For trying to kill my son and my people, you shall experience trillions of years of pain before your soul faces nothingness."

She heard simple words that caused her bloodied eyes to expand and blink, even more insanity and rage rising within them as she found out her attacks hadn't even managed to kill the young Lernaean Commander she targeted!
Then what the hell was all this for?!

Guttural sounds erupted from her as she tried to gather the authority of her Dynamis of Extremity, but the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority dispersing throughout other parts of her Aspects of Existence made it extremely hard to put anything together as she could only state with hate towards Noah.
If what he said was true, then...
"My...birg-gest re-grret is that I dir-dn't kirll morre Le-rrneans!"

Her torn tongue could barely formulate words as while feeling Vacuous Hyperversal Authority infecting everything about her, she didn't despair as she even started cackling with rage, despondency, and madness!

She stared towards the frigid visage of the Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor as even while pierced with a spear, she bellowed out and tried to surge towards him in a last ditch effort!
And the cherry colored flames of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity disappeared.
Everything around her turned into nothingness once more as her guttural roars and voice couldn't be heard anymore.
'Fuck.'
She cursed in her mind.
'Fuck! Fuck! Fuck that Lernaean Commander. Fuck his father! Fuck all of them to oblivion!'
For what seemed like forever, she cursed and continued cursing as the lifeforce and Soul of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform that had undergone Apexification was extremely strong!
Even as her aspects of Existence were permeating with nothingness, it would take a long time for them to be ground down and destroyed.
Of course, this 'long time' was not a real passage of time as it was simply what she would experience as the passage of time.

Off to the side, Noah could already see different parts of her body being eaten up by Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as the Source that made her...Noah wouldn't waste it to be thrown to void as his Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation pulled the different parts of her being devoured by nothingness into Noah!
His frigid eyes then watched her be obliterated as he then turned towards the second Apex Aeonic Noblesse who was beside Euryale.
The one who stood beside her as she assaulted his people!
It was another Apex Aeonic Lifeform who would face his Wrath as dense singularities, infinity symbols, and flames rose up while they burned with the light of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2482 Killing An Apex Aeonic Lifeform! I
paragraphs: 2482 Killing an Apex Aeonic Lifeform! I
Around the same time that Noah released the utterly expansive domain of Miniature Vacuous Hyperversal Domain.

Silver skies filled with floating islands of glaciers and freezing ice could be seen in what used to be the past region where Planes of Existence belonging to the Ancestral Lernaeans stood, the main bodies of Aurelia, Orion, and a few more Apex Aeonic Lernaeans who had joined them could be seen with troubled faces as Aurelia was speaking with a sharp tone.
"We need to make our way into the Infinite Plane and protect it with our main bodies. For an attack to reach there during such a critical time..."
Worry was abundant on hers and Orion's faces as they already saw the tremendous potential and possibilities for all Lernaeans within the Infinite Plane!

Seeing the recent events, these Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were ready to bring their main bodies into the Infinite Plane as Orion and Aurelia still remembered Noah's words for the other Apex Aeonic Lernaeans.
He wanted them to bend the knee in order to enter his lands and relish the benefits!
As they were thinking about how to move...
ZAP!

The silver skies above them crackled as Aurelia's gaze instantly changed, a golden light of a Dynamid of Extremity erupting around her as a moment later, the skies were filled with an illusory blue palm smashing down towards them with utmost ferocity!

A few hundred Apex Aeonic Damage Values were contained in this strike as after Aurelia reacted, Orion's body also lit up with a milky white light along with the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms around them- facing the surprise attack head on as even then, their gazes heavily changed and turned ashen.
This was because in the skies, tens of illusory blue hands manifested an instant after as their target seemed to be Aurelia at the very center of their group!
It was...the forces of the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction making a move to hunt their suspected Mutated Entities!

The gazes of Aurelia and Orion's clone changed in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, this change very soon being picked up by the reality around them that was more observant than ever after what had just occurred.
Their eyes turned more difficult by the second as a moment later, Noah's voice reverberated from all around them as his will that was left behind communicated with them.
"What happened?"
His voice was utterly cold as it emanated out, Aurelia gritting her teeth as she spat out with a sense of shock.
"We are being attacked by an Apex Aeonic Lifeform stronger than any we've met before...he shouldn't even be from this Haven!"
The pressure and level of damage they were receiving was catastrophic as their main bodies were barely defending!
Noah only listened to Aurelia's account briefly as before even a fraction of a Second passed, his voice emanated out once more as bright balls of light floated towards Aurelia and Orion.
"Head to these coordinates in the Lands of the Noblesse. I can lend you aid there."
The area where his Main Body was stuck dealing with two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms already!
He couldn't move from his at this moment as less than 3 seconds had already passed from his 1 Minute time where he could maintain his fusion.
This was just how rapidly the attacks and communications could occur with existences as powerful as them who could even throw out attacks within the span of nanoseconds!

A dreadful and powerful battle could be finished with a victor decided in less than the passage of a second, and yet to the powerful Boundary Expansion Realm experts fighting, it may have seemed like the ordeal of a lifetime with hundreds of attacks exchanged.

Aurelia's eyes snapped with a difficult light as it didn't seem right that they would listen and seek the aid of an existence who hadn't undergone Apexification- no matter how unique and powerful he was, but she didn't have time to think it over as her Boundary of Fortune warned her that this peril was the greatest one in her life!

So she quickly ascertained the information released by Noah as the task for her, Orion, and the few Apex Aeonic Lernaeans following them was to protect against the heavy attacks being thrown their way while teleporting towards the coordinates of a location the Noblesse Domains!
In the Quasarian Lands.

Grand Singularity Elder Zeitgeist had a cold countenance as he was receiving information from multiple sources, his heart feeling trepidation as he already knew Hyperversal Extremity Kabul was nearing!

Over a dozen Apex Aeonic Elders of the Singularity Overseers were spreading outwards from this location to search for any signs of the perpetrator that arrived to snatch away the prize that belonged to the Hyperversal Devourer.
The images of Caesar, Xiaomi, and most of all the Unknown assailant that aided their escape were passed around to all Apex Aeonic Elders of the Singularity Overseers.

The Apex Aeonic Quasarians were pacified as he quickly took control and reigned in Quasarian Elder Booma, the power of an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity being something others couldn't even fathom- especially one connected to the Hyperversal Extremity of Devouring!
As a few seconds trickled, information quickly flowed as he finally received something.

"Grand Singularity Elder, I sense heavy fluctuations of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms towards my direction. Looking at the local topology, it should be within the aboriginal domain of the Noblesse who are now under the influence of the Genesis Institute of Extremity..."
The information buzzed in Zeitgeist's mind as his Kismet Dynamis of Extremity shone brightly.
It told him that there was a high likelihood of what he sought to be there!
So his countenance hardened as he commanded.
"Converge upon this location. Monitor and only act if you confirm the targets."
Kismet danced wildly in his heart.
He could feel it.
It further told him that his chance to perform a achievement that would be worthy of recognition of the Hyperversal Extremity of Devouring was coming!
He didn't want to miss it as he himself moved from the Quasarian Lands to head towards the coordinates his subordinate specified...

chapters.title: Chapter 2483 Killing An Apex Aeonic Lifeform! II
paragraphs: 2483 Killing an Apex Aeonic Lifeform! II
The Apex Aeonic Lernaeans and their attacker converged towards a single location.
The Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Singularity Overseers also converged towards a location.
All of it was connected to a single being!
But this wasn't all.
It was the Noblesse Domains.
Naturally, those living in this region would be those to arrive first.
HUUM!

Essence buzzed wildly as a few thousand miles away from the circle of darkness pulsing with Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, the figures of over a dozen Apex Aeonic Lifeforms rose as the distinct obsidian skin of the Noblesse could be seen.
Each of them released brilliant grandeur, yet they were still eclipsed by two men and women who floated amongst them who weren't of the Noblesse Lineage!

"I'll have to thank Grand Genesis Elder Meiying for your help today. Explaining things to the Adjudicator of Dissolution will be that much easier with the aid of the Genesis Institute of Extremity. We shall discipline Euryale after this to make sure such things don't happen again..."
A Noblesse with a valiant visage adorned in a sleek Crimson battle armor spoke with an ingratiating expression towards a pink haired woman of utmost beauty!
Her nose was sharp as her eyes were beautifully wide, one being inadvertently lost in them if they stared for too long.

She wasn't just any Grand Elder who led the incursion into the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution this time- but a powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeform who was rumored to be close to grasping an Absolute Seed of Extremity!
She held multiple Dynamis of Extremity already as she was Infinitely close to fusing multiple Concepts of Extremity into a single Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
Against common Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, she was considered exceptional!

Grand Genesis Elder Meiying nodded with a smile while her eyes released blinding radiance, moving ever closer to the coordinates they had received as she stared closely at the mass of darkness ahead of them.
"I came to help...but I'm not sure if we have made it in time. That...seems eerily close to Vacuous Hyperversal Authority."
WAA!
A dangerous authority was uttered from her as this was something she had felt an Esteemed Extremity freely control before!
Her words caused the expressions of the Apex Aeonic Noblesse to change as the leading one spoke in a heavy tone.

"Could the Adjudicator of Dissolution have already acted? Punishment for violating the Investiture of Extremity by killing lower lifeforms will never be death. Accepting isolation or an Albatross at most..."
The Investiture of Extremity!
The set of rules and regulations that all Races in the Havens of Extremity followed after the Extremity Sanctification of the Aeonic Haven of Genesis!
They knew these rules well, along with the results of violating them as Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were treated well when any violations were made.
After all, they were the current and future weapons who would stand against the terrible enemies that could even bother Hyperversal Extremities!
"Didn't the message you all received say that a Lower Lifeform had appeared before Richard and Euryale? A Lernaean coming to seek revenge from those Euryale targeted and killed?"
Grand Genesis Elder Meiying spoke inquisitively while staring ahead as her words caused the minds of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms nearby to buzz.
A lower lifeform...did she truly imply that he was the one who may be responsible for the swirling mass of darkness ahead of them? For calling upon Vacuous Hyperversal Authority?!

"Lernaeans...Lernaeans! Commander Vladic, it is always these rats we have been fighting with!" An Apex Aeonic Noblesse spoke with distaste while gazing towards their Commander who stood besides Meiying.
Vladic!
A famous Apex Aeonic Lifeform of their Lineage who sat at the leading seat of their council!
His expression was cold as he went forward.
"It can't be a Lower Lifeform who is capable of this. If an Apex Aeonic Lernaean gets involved to cause any harm to Euryale..."
His eyes shone with a dangerous glint that betrayed some of his emotions and showed a hidden connection this being held with Euryale that far surpassed merely a colleague of the same race.
Her wild demeanor and unstable nature crossed through his eyes as billions of years of memories passed.
She was a being who did what she wished as at certain times, even those closest to her called her crazy!
But he adored that craziness.
He loved her wild and somewhat cruel nature as his position of power allowed her to run free all these years!
If anything actually happened to her...much through the hands of Lernaeans no less- he would burn them all to the ground.
All of them!
"Let's go!"
He uttered out while moving ever closer to the swirling mass of darkness.
Within the Miniature Vacuous Hyperversal Domain.
Noah's gaze was cold as he stared at the masculine Apex Aeonic Noblesse who held over a dozen blazing crimson back flaming swords piercing his body from different directions.
Each of them pulsed with both the Aletheian and Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity as they burned brightly even while encircled by Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!

Any Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who didn't have an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity and actually managed to get stuck in Noah's Miniature Vacuous Hyperversal Domain when he was in his fused state...their fate would be abysmal!
If he had his normal power, maybe they would outlast how long he could have it active.
And he wouldn't be able to bypass their defenses of tens or hundreds of Apex Aeonic Defense Values so easily.
But in his fused state as the Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor...his lives were up to him!
He stared at them as to his left, Euryale kept up a ferocious expression while her Aspects of Existence were entirely invaded by Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
Her body seemed dead and ready to turn to ash as the only thing keeping it together were illusory Extremity Meridians numbering 8 still pulsing weakly within her body!
They contained the concepts she characterized herself with in abundance, as well as the Sources of the Dynamis of Extremity she formed.
Yet even they were slowly turning gray as for her, there was no turning back!

chapters.title: Chapter 2484 Killing An Apex Aeonic Lifeform! III
paragraphs: 2484 Killing an Apex Aeonic Lifeform! III
Over 80% of Euryale's Aspects of Existence were already permeated with the authority of nothingness as she couldn't return from this even if she tried.
Now, she just experienced pain outside the scope of time itself as she wallowed in her hatred.
To his right, Richard held a regretful expression as his lips would occasionally voice out...
"I...tried to stop her."

70% of his Aspects of Existence were already infected and about to fade away into nothingness as the Vitality of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform held strong, his 7 Extremity Meridians pulsing weakly as half of them had already turned gray!
They would die here, but Noah did not feel content.
He felt like even though they were experiencing the passage of countless illusory years, it was still not enough.
His Wrath wanted to do more.
His eyes buzzed as an instant later, a path bloomed as he chose it.
He would do more than just kill them.
He would also send a message!
HOONG!
His figure moved as each of his hands wrapped around the husks of the necks of Euryale and Richard.
They couldn't even react to him as they preserved the last of their Souls from fading away, and the vibrant darkness of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority around them began to pulse and retreat!

Noah deactivated this Miniature Vacuous Hyperversal Domain as he wanted to take the dredges of what remained of two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms to send a message to the Noblesse and any others on what would happen if they targeted anything that was his!
He wanted to send a message to whoever was attacking Aurelia and the others headed here about what would be in store for them.
BZZT!
So the Miniature Vacuous Hyperversal Domain pulsed and began to fade as his figure clasping onto the dying necks of husks of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms was gradually unveiled!
"My oh my...."
The voice of the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction echoed out as his figure appeared meters away from the Adjudicator of Dissolution.
Each of their bodies pulsed with the shocking authority of Hyperversal Extremity and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as the both of them were watching the unfolding scene below!

"An existence yet to undergo Apexification and he can stand toe to toe with Apex Aeonic Lifeforms because he can call upon a semblance of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, however weak it is, and even survive in it."
His voice carried immense interest and power as he spoke, his Will watching the veil of the Vacuous Hyperversal Domain fade as a shocking scene was gradually revealed!
At his words and appearance, the Adjudicator of Dissolution was utterly cold as she voiced out calmly and with authority.
[Do not think we do not know your connection to the Avernus Clan. Can I take your actions today as the actions of the Avernus Clan falling out of the 7 Clan Investiture Alliance?]
WAA!
Her words held a hint of danger as the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction replied while shaking his head.

"My actions are my own...but what have I exactly done that was wrong today? All I did was come pay my respects to you. I would never dare to even show a semblance of dishonor towards a Hyperversal Extremity who has taken the job of an Adjudicator."
He pounded his chest with a smile as he spoke, where he truly had all of his bases covered today!
[Oh?]
The veiled visage of the Adjudicator of Dissolution shone brightly as she spoke with coldness.
[Then what is the authority of Destruction barreling here at this moment?]

Her words caused the brows of the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction to rise and look down as an instant later, space cracked and fissured as a few Apex Aeonic Lernaeans were spat from it- multiple illusory blue hands of Destruction now tainted with tendrils of red emerging and following behind them closely!

The Golden hair on Aurelia could be seen shining brightly as she bellowed out with power, a milky white light covering Orion as Flowers of Genesis bloomed to protect him and the other Apex Aeonic Lernaeans!
Behind them, a single man stepped out of the fissure of space as his hands were folded behind his back.
His expression was calm and unfettered as his red robe fluttered amidst the surging essence.
A single being.
It wasn't even a cluster of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms targeting them and putting them in such a dire state- but a single one causing all this as they couldn't even escape his chase!
But as soon as they arrived in this new region, they were forced to come to a stop as their surroundings were utterly messy and chaotic, and yet they seemed to be palpating with danger.
Far, far above them, the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction smiled as he saw the one chasing after this group of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms was none other than one of his most prized Disciples.
The Grand Elder Scion of Destruction who had attained 'that'!

Events seemed to be unfolding in an utterly wild direction as the moment he arrived, his chase momentarily stopped as he seemed to sense the fading Vacuous Hyperversal Domain towards the direction where a certain being could be seen holding the necks of husks of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!

As soon as this party of beings arrived, those who were already there before them also appeared as from the depths of the Noblesse Domains, the figures of multiple Apex Aeonic Noblesse appeared as they were followed side by side with the Elders and a Grand Genesis Elder Meiying of the Genesis Institute of Extremity!

Commander Vladic led the Noblesse as his squinting eyes and piercing will instantly focused on the region where a stellar existence blazed with a flaming crown and devilish horns- especially focusing on the husks clasped within his hands as his pupils vibrated when he identified who they were!
BZZZT!
Essence began to dance wildly in this whole region.
Coming out of the Miniature Vacuous Hyperversal Domain, Noah's will felt the convergence of multiple Apex Aeonic Lifeforms here as Providence and Destiny vibrated with immense scrutiny and grandeur.
He smelled opportunity.
He smelled chaos.
He smelled the calculative manipulation and guidance of his anger towards a glorious path.
He sensed the potential of immense glory and Loot as he fearlessly gazed towards the oncoming powerhouses of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, fear not even being a thing in his heart!

Coming out of the Miniature Vacuous Hyperversal Domain, Noah's will felt the convergence of multiple Apex Aeonic Lifeforms here as Providence and Destiny vibrated with immense scrutiny and grandeur.
He smelled opportunity.
He smelled chaos.
He smelled the calculative manipulation and guidance of his anger towards a glorious path.
He sensed the potential of immense glory and Loot as he fearlessly gazed towards the oncoming powerhouses of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, fear not even being a thing in his heart!

chapters.title: Chapter 2485 Killing An Apex Aeonic Lifeform! IV
paragraphs: 2485 Killing an Apex Aeonic Lifeform! IV
Commander Vladic saw...her.

Her skin was turned gray as if she could fall apart any second, her Extremity Meridians thinned and decayed as her foundation was at risk of entirely falling apart. A Spear impaled her top to bottom as she was nearly split in two.
Yet...it was her.
HUUM!

His will was roused as it surged powerfully, his figure going forward and looking at the being grasping onto her with her right arm- seemingly indicating that the last vestige of her life was in his hands!
Bubbling Wrath and apprehension rose as while he neared, his voice echoed out.
"You have greatly wounded and nearly destroyed the foundation of an Apex Aeonic Noblesse. Let it end there as if anything happens to any of them..."

His eyes also caught Richard who was grasped on this being's left hand as he uttered out a threat with his very soul, his eyes becoming ever more baleful as he saw the figures of Apex Aeonic Lernaeans scramble to come behind this being!
The situation before Aurelia exceeded her wilderness dreams.
The coordinates they arrived at showed an inconceivable scene as her bright eyes felt the auras of multiple Apex Aeonic Lifeforms...along with him.
An expansive aurora of wings stretched out behind him as he was adorned in an Armament shimmering with an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
Horns rose from his head as a Wrathful flaming crown spun above it!
His face held a devilishly handsome look and utmost coldness as in his hands, the husks of what seemed to be two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were grasped.

Aurelia and the rest of the Apex Aeonic Lernaeans scrambled to appear behind him as the constant attacks from the force behind them didn't keep coming at this moment, their strained bodies gaining a pause as they heard the words of Commander Vladic of the Noblesse!
This caused their minds to buzz as they truly affirmed that Noah held in his hands the lives of two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!

"How..." Orion wiped the blood from his lips as the milky white light around him only intensified, each of them gazing towards Noah trying to rationalize how this being who had yet to undergo Apexification had managed to dominate two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
Yet no answers came from him at this juncture as he looked towards the distance where the being who was chasing Aurelia and the others could be seen.
His face was that of a saint gracing these lands with his grandeur, his red robe fluttering calmly as his eyes contained immense power and possibilities.
Out of all beings here, this existence was the one that was most unknown and granted the most sense of danger.
A close second...was behind the Noblesse who had just spoken.
Noah turned towards this direction as he came to concentrate on the forces of the Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity behind the Noblesse.

Each of them seemed more powerful than the average Apex Aeonic Lifeforms present here, yet Noah was fearless in their appearance as he came to focus on the Apex Aeonic Noblesse that had spoken, his voice ringing out coldly and with regality against this being.
"I didn't already extinguish the souls of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms I grasped because I wanted to send a message."
His words caught the attention of all beings here as the eyes of Commander Vladic turned bloodshot.
A foreboding sensation permeated as his body wrapped in power, ready to make a move at any second as the voice of the existence who pulsed with an unfathomable Dynamis of Extremity continued!
"I want to show all those watching what happens when you fuck around with my people."
WAA!
As he spoke, his hand holding the mutilated body of Euryale rose as a spear wrapped in tendrils of black, gold, and cherry colored lights still remained impaled across her body!

"This pest here thought her status as an Apex Aeonic Lifeform distinguished her as she attacked to kill those who haven't even undergone Apexification freely. I want to let you all know that it doesn't matter whether you are an Apex Aeonic Lifeform...nor if you have reached Extremity."
BZZZT!

As he spoke, the arcs of light around the spear impaling a nonresponsive Euryale began to buzz, cherry colored flames erupting around it as what remained of her body and Aspects of Existence began to be broken down!
"If you touch my people...I will tear all the statuses you hold dear as no matter your Realm or power, this will be your only fate!"
"Don't! If you do this...if you do this!!!"
Commander Vladic's eyes raged with blood as he spoke threateningly while moving forward.
Aurelia and the Apex Aeonic Lernaeans behind Noah also buzzed with power as they prepared to fight if need be.
It was a critical moment in time where depending on the actions taken, a very unstable future could bloom.
And these actions lay in the hands of one man as he held the life of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform within his fingertips!
Far above this region, the Wills of two Hyperversal Extremities watched this as the red robed man had a smile on his face as he spoke.

"I dare not presume or impose on the task of the Adjudicator, but in the doctrines of the Investiture of Extremity, the punishment for acting to slay lesser Lifeforms was never death- with every Apex Aeonic Lifeform or Hyperversal Extremity being too vital of a force to simply erase. Is the Adjudicator not going to move to stop this being from taking the lives of not one, but two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms?"

His eyes shone with destruction and chaos as he couldn't hide his smile while he spoke, the Adjudicator of Dissolution not even turning towards his way and replying as she recalled what she had told this being below them not too long ago.
That she wouldn't interfere when others exploded with conflict against him!
Yet never was there an expectation that it would move on to be a conflict with Apex Aeonic Lifeforms merely minutes later.
Due to this, she coldly looked at the two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms in his hands as...their fates were shockingly decided.
She wouldn't interfere here.
But if the situation continued to head towards the direction she expected it to...
HOONG!
Essence and authority buzzed below them as a choice was made.
The True Emperor of Quintessence brought his hand to crush what he held within it as cherry colored flames rose torrentially!
They painted a beautiful and chaotic picture as for the first time in his life, the True Emperor of Quintessence killed an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!

chapters.title: Chapter 2486 The Spark Of A War! I
paragraphs: 2486 The Spark of a War! I
Life's firsts.
They were always special.
The first meal, the first birthday, the first love, the first job, the first child...
the first kill.
A lot of the time, firsts were special for the beings involved in them as they fundamentally marked a milestone and a change in one's life!
But there were firsts that didn't just affect a single person and the few beings closest to them.
There were firsts that could affect the very tilting of reality and cause an eruption of chaos that could have never been imagined!
The Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor grasped the life of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform in his hands as he crushed down and took such a life for the first time in his life.
His first kill of an existence supposedly much higher than him in power!
And the moment he did it, his words echoed out for all to hear.
"Apex Aeonic Lifeform or Hyperversal Extremity...this will be their fate when they stand against me and my people!"
BOOOM!
When he did this, apart from the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms that were already here, a few more auras began to appear from the horizon where tendrils of Ruin and Nullity were beginning to converge.
It was the forces of the Singularity Overseers who were looking for a very specific being who had run off with two Quasarians!
They arrived to see the soul of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform be extinguished.

And Noah's actions followed a sequence as an instant after he utterly crushed the residual soul of Euryale, he also crushed his left hand as cherry colored flames rose to extinguish what remained of Richard.

"OOOH!" And a guttural bellow followed his words and actions as Commander Vladic of the Noblesse showed immense pain on his face, tears of Crimson red leaking from his obsidian red eyes as he surged out like a comet towards Noah!
His actions were the actions of the other Apex Aeonic Noblesse as they also barreled forth with torrential grandeur.
Time felt like it slowed down Infinitely.
Noah's heart was at ease as from his initial state of fusion until now, 30 seconds had already passed.
And yet he did what he did as he was assured in his power and actions!
As multiple Apex Aeonic Lifeforms no doubt more powerful that Euryale and Richard charged towards him, he didn't sit still as if he was waiting for someone else to protect him.
He surged forward himself as his hands flickered, a Miniature Vacuous Hyperversal Domain blooming towards Commander Vladic who instantly stopped and moved back to evade the mass of darkness!

Yet the circular domain remained in space as an instant later, another one bloomed from a different direction as the other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms felt the trepidation with the authority contained within these domains as unlike Euryale and Richard, they were on high alert to make sure they weren't enveloped!
So without even a delay, Noah had begun throwing out attacks towards multiple Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
And yet another instant later...
HOONG!
All entities here had to raise a portion of their wills up as they felt the pristine and heavy authority of Extremity begin to descend.
Yet it wasn't singular!

Far above them, the Will of the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction was luminous as he smiled while spreading his aura out, intent on seeing what destruction would unfold as his voice began to echo out.
"O Great Adjudicator of Dissolution. Isn't interfering now a bit lackluster? I wanted to bask-"
BOOOM!

Before his words could even continue, his eyes flickered as before him, the veiled visage of the Adjudicator of Dissolution instantly exploded forth with such a suffocating and shocking authority that instantly overwhelmed everything he had spread out!

Shock rose within his eyes as he affirmed with disbelief that his Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity Authority was extinguished in an instant, this being before him seeming larger than anything he imagined her to be as her voice chillingly echoed out!
[This will be my only warning to you.]

Her words were akin to the ruling of the Haven itself as the eyes of the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction turned sharp, realizing he had greatly underestimated this existence before him as her grandeur extended down freely to halt everything that was occurring down below.
The pristine aura of Extremity descended along with an undeniable voice that rang out.

[Per the regulations of the Investiture of Extremity, no Apex Aeonic Lifeforms shall strike or death lower lifeforms. The debt that was sown with the previous conflict has been repaid as further conflict...is not allowed.]
WAA!
A voice of pristine undeniability rang out as all existences in this region came to a halt.
The eyes of many flashed with shocking brilliance as they were all distinguished beings.

They understood the intricacies in the words and authority of the Adjudicator of Dissolution as all eyes turned towards the existence who was freely conjuring out Domains of darkness that even Apex Aeonic Lifeforms had to evade!
This being...had yet to even undergo Apexification?!
The eyes of the Grand Elder Scion of Destruction in the far distance shone with blazing brilliance.
The Grand Genesis Elder Meiying arrived beside Commander Vladic as this Apex Aeonic Noblesse had eyes bulging with shock and anger while he gritted his teeth!
None of them wanted to believe these words, and yet they knew the grandeur of the Adjudicator of Dissolution as they couldn't deny them!
But still...
Commander Vladic's heart was unwilling.
The pain and loss he felt was too much!

So even amidst the grandeur of Extremity pressing down on them, he uttered out while pulling a Runestone shining with a stellar void filled light- his gaze moving from Noah and onto the Apex Aeonic Lernaeans floating behind him.

"O Adjudicator of Dissolution! On this day, two Apex Aeonic Noblesse have died by the hands of those belonging to the Lernaean Lineage. The differences we have are unresolvable as one cannot exist with the other under the same Haven!"
BOOOM!
His words were shocking as those around him instantly knew where he was taking this incomprehensible situation.
Grand Genesis Elder Meiying placed her hand on Commander Vladic's shoulders, but this being ignored all reason as he uttered out with solemnity.

"As the leading Commander of Noblesse, I call upon my right and the rights of my Lineage as inscribed in the Investiture of Extremity. Due to unresolvable differences and the flagrant murder of our Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, the Noblesse Lineage calls upon an Apex War against the Lernaean Lineage. An Apex War of Annihilation!"
WAA!
The skies seethed as tendrils of ruin and nullity ran rampant!

chapters.title: Chapter 2487 The Spark Of A War! II
paragraphs: 2487 The Spark of a War! II
An Apex War!
And not just any Apex War, but an Apex War of Annihilation.
Where the differences and hatred ran so deep that out of such a war, it resulted in the complete Wipeout and erasure of the other faction or Lineage!
The Victors of the Apex War held such a right of annihilation!

Apex Wars were called upon when differences ran so deep that conflict was the only solution, but it was something controlled as normally, the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms fought and absorbed the losing faction after blood had been spilled to a great extent.

When it came to Apex Wars of Annihilation, both sides had to agree to it in order for it to be carried out as this type of an Apex War granted the right of Complete annihilation that the Victors could carry out!
It was against everything that the Investiture of Extremity stood for as it was something that rarely ever took place.
After all, the lives of existences were precious!
Each Apex War had to be under the approval of the Adjudicator of said Haven as their job was to prevent conflict from ever rising to such a level in the first place.

The last few Apex Wars to occur in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution had ended with 80% of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the losing side being wiped out before the victors were crowned and attained everything.
They all happened in developed Havens that had already undergone Extremity Sanctification as if this Apex War went through...it would be the first in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution!

"Noblesse and Lernaeans have fought over the years and spilled much blood, but in the past days...a total of three Apex Aeonic Noblesse lost their lives to Lernaeans. We have cause. We have conflict. We have life force being spilled. Please, do not deny us our right!"
Commander Vladic gritted his teeth with bloodshot eyes as he mentioned the Apex Aeonic Noblesse killed by Orion during his escape, as well as Euryale and Richard just now.
He provided cause and conflict as the skies filling with Ruin and Nullity crackled silently, the pristine aura of Extremity silent.
Silent as if it was waiting for affirmation from a certain direction.
From a certain being!
HOONG!

Noah's visage shone with blinding radiance as the time to maintain his state of fusion trickled down, waving his hands behind him as he beckoned for Aurelia and the other Apex Aeonic Lernaeans to come float behind him.
His gaze was that of utmost coldness and apathy as he turned his head to the skies swirling with sources of chaos while he spoke.
"As the Lernaean Lineage Emperor, I accept the summons for an Apex War with the Noblesse Lineage. An Apex War of Annihilation!"
Aurelia and Orion's minds buzzed at Noah's words, their emotions and hearts telling them to do things very differently as in such a situation, they did not cut down Noah's authority.
After all, he was granted it not too long ago before he fully devoured all Lernaean Domains!
The silence in the surroundings was deafening as it was broken soon after with a voice filled with Extremity Authority.
[An Apex War is frowned upon across all Havens as it only further propagates bloodshed and the loss of life. Are you all sure of taking this path?]
The tone of the Hyperversal Extremity Authority pressing down held a hint of displeasure, and yet Commander Vladic was unfettered as he replied staunchly.
"Yes, Esteemed Adjudicator. This debt can only be repaid by blood!"
Beside him, Grand Genesis Elder Meiying sighed thoughtfully as she gazed towards the stellar form of the being wrapped in the Authority of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
His eyes were filled with apathy at this moment as he floated forward silently.

His visage was freely and without fear crossing the skies filled with raining tendrils of Ruin and Nullity, Apex Aeonic Lifeforms surrounding him on all sides as he looked like a magnificent celestial warrior walking upon a stellar battlefield!

He floated until he arrived right before the forces of the Apex Aeonic Noblesse, Grand Genesis Elder Meiying also seeing him closely as he spoke out while staring straight into the eyes of Commander Vladic.

"This war will end the differences between Lernaeans and Noblesse. And in this war...I shall take part as the Lernaean Lineage Emperor. Any Apex Aeonic Lifeforms can come settle their grudges with me as they like freely without worrying about the Investiture of Extremity!"
BOOM!
Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could strike or reap the lives of lower lifeforms.
But nothing said a lower life form couldn't target and butcher Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
After all, it wasn't even a possibility.
So Noah told them all that he would be there.
He looked at Commander Vladic and told him that he could settle any hatred with him free of worries!

The malice within Commander Vladic's eyes was potent as he seemed ready to move right then and there, the voice of the Hyperversal Extremity booming down thereafter as both sides came to an agreement.
[Very well. The Lernaeans that accepted the challenge of this Apex War of Annihilation retain the privilege of choosing the time within reasonable limits.]
A time when boundless chaos would kick off.
Noah's cold eyes were sharp as he voiced out with ease.
"Three days from now."
WAA!
At the time when he could fuse with the myriad parts of himself again!
The time was selected as it was a fairly short period of time, with prior histories of Apex Wars showing factions taking months or years to prepare.
[Within three days, the Apex War will be carried out privilege here. Confirm all your forces and those participating on behalf of your Lineages before that time. Now, disperse!]
Displeasure, disappointment, and a trace of anger was present in the voice of the Adjudicator of Dissolution as her words buzzed in the surroundings.
Her last words revealed another working of the Apex Wars.
The factions involved within...could invite other forces to fight with them!

Where the differences and hatred ran so deep that out of such a war, it resulted in the complete Wipeout and erasure of the other faction or Lineage!
The Victors of the Apex War held such a right of annihilation!

Apex Wars were called upon when differences ran so deep that conflict was the only solution, but it was something controlled as normally, the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms fought and absorbed the losing faction after blood had been spilled to a great extent.

When it came to Apex Wars of Annihilation, both sides had to agree to it in order for it to be carried out as this type of an Apex War granted the right of Complete annihilation that the Victors could carry out!
It was against everything that the Investiture of Extremity stood for as it was something that rarely ever took place.
After all, the lives of existences were precious!
Each Apex War had to be under the approval of the Adjudicator of said Haven as their job was to prevent conflict from ever rising to such a level in the first place.

The last few Apex Wars to occur in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution had ended with 80% of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the losing side being wiped out before the victors were crowned and attained everything.
They all happened in developed Havens that had already undergone Extremity Sanctification as if this Apex War went through...it would be the first in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution!
"Noblesse and Lernaeans have fought over the years and spilled much blood, but in the past days...a total of three Apex Aeonic Noblesse lost their lives to Lernaeans.
We have cause.
We have conflict.
We have life force being spilled.
Please, do not deny us our right!"
Commander Vladic gritted his teeth with bloodshot eyes as he mentioned the Apex Aeonic Noblesse killed by Orion during his escape, as well as Euryale and Richard just now.
He provided cause and conflict as the skies filling with Ruin and Nullity crackled silently, the pristine aura of Extremity silent.
Silent as if it was waiting for affirmation from a certain direction.
From a certain being!
HOONG!

Noah's visage shone with blinding radiance as the time to maintain his state of fusion trickled down, waving his hands behind him as he beckoned for Aurelia and the other Apex Aeonic Lernaeans to come float behind him.
His gaze was that of utmost coldness and apathy as he turned his head to the skies swirling with sources of chaos while he spoke.
"As the Lernaean Lineage Emperor, I accept the summons for an Apex War with the Noblesse Lineage.
An Apex War of Annihilation!"
Aurelia and Orion's minds buzzed at Noah's words, their emotions and hearts telling them to do things very differently as in such a situation, they did not cut down Noah's authority.
After all, he was granted it not too long ago before he fully devoured all Lernaean Domains!
The silence in the surroundings was deafening as it was broken soon after with a voice filled with Extremity Authority.
[An Apex War is frowned upon across all Havens as it only further propagates bloodshed and the loss of life.
Are you all sure of taking this path?]
The tone of the Hyperversal Extremity Authority pressing down held a hint of displeasure, and yet Commander Vladic was unfettered as he replied staunchly.
"Yes, Esteemed Adjudicator.
This debt can only be repaid by blood!"
Beside him, Grand Genesis Elder Meiying sighed thoughtfully as she gazed towards the stellar form of the being wrapped in the Authority of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
His eyes were filled with apathy at this moment as he floated forward silently.

His visage was freely and without fear crossing the skies filled with raining tendrils of Ruin and Nullity, Apex Aeonic Lifeforms surrounding him on all sides as he looked like a magnificent celestial warrior walking upon a stellar battlefield!

He floated until he arrived right before the forces of the Apex Aeonic Noblesse, Grand Genesis Elder Meiying also seeing him closely as he spoke out while staring straight into the eyes of Commander Vladic.
"This war will end the differences between Lernaeans and Noblesse.
And in this war...I shall take part as the Lernaean Lineage Emperor.
Any Apex Aeonic Lifeforms can come settle their grudges with me as they like freely without worrying about the Investiture of Extremity!"
BOOM!
Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could strike or reap the lives of lower lifeforms.
But nothing said a lower life form couldn't target and butcher Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
After all, it wasn't even a possibility.
So Noah told them all that he would be there.
He looked at Commander Vladic and told him that he could settle any hatred with him free of worries!

The malice within Commander Vladic's eyes was potent as he seemed ready to move right then and there, the voice of the Hyperversal Extremity booming down thereafter as both sides came to an agreement.
[Very well.
The Lernaeans that accepted the challenge of this Apex War of Annihilation retain the privilege of choosing the time within reasonable limits.]
A time when boundless chaos would kick off.
Noah's cold eyes were sharp as he voiced out with ease.
"Three days from now."
WAA!
At the time when he could fuse with the myriad parts of himself again!
The time was selected as it was a fairly short period of time, with prior histories of Apex Wars showing factions taking months or years to prepare.
[Within three days, the Apex War will be carried out privilege here.
Confirm all your forces and those participating on behalf of your Lineages before that time.
Now, disperse!]
Displeasure, disappointment, and a trace of anger was present in the voice of the Adjudicator of Dissolution as her words buzzed in the surroundings.
Her last words revealed another working of the Apex Wars.
The factions involved within...could invite other forces to fight with them!

chapters.title: Chapter 2488 The Spark Of A War! III
paragraphs: 2488 The Spark of a War! III
[...Now, disperse!]
The booming words of the Adjudicator of Dissolution echoed out.
The visage of the Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor stared down towards Commander Vladic coldly as Grand Genesis Elder Meiying motioned for him and others behind him to move out.

Far behind Noah, Aurelia and the others glared towards a direction where the red robed being who was attacking them still floated without a worry, their Wills also focusing back on Noah on the predicament he had placed all of them in.
On the predicament of a War!
In another direction, three Apex Aeonic Singularity Overseer Elders had just arrived to witness this scene as they sent a message to Grand Singularity Elder Zeitgeist who was still on his way over.
SHAA!
He shot forth like a burning comet on the Crimson silver skies.

He received memories of what the Elders he had sent forth had seen, his gaze tightening as the visage and likeness of the horned existence who had gotten into conflict with the Noblesse was exactly akin to the one who had taken away the existence with an Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation!
"You say the two sides just entered into an agreement for an Apex War?"
He confirmed with the Elder he was discussing with as after getting more memories and understanding the situation clearly, Zeitgeist made his choice.

"Okay. Approach the Noblesse and the Elders of the Genesis Institute of Extremity. Let them know our intention to assist them...so long as we get to question and obtain what we want from this Lernaean Lineage Emperor. Also, establish a line of communication with him personally. We shall see whether threats or riches work on someone like him..."
Zeitgeist was ready to play both sides as his forces began to move to achieve exactly what he wanted.
At the same time, his Soul buzzed as something close to his chest released pulsing sounds, his figure coming to a stop as he looked above him.
The pulsing was indicative of one thing as in the distance, space cracked and fissured while a force of nature stepped out of it. It was none other than his past Elder Brother making his arrival.
It was the Hyperversal Extremity Kabul who had come under the order of their Master to ensure everything went smoothly!
Zeitgeist's face hardened as he changed direction, floating upwards to welcome him and brief him on exactly what had occurred!
The Adjudicator of Dissolution had ordered for them to disperse.

The Apex Aeonic Lifeforms began to do just that as the calm figure of Grand Genesis Elder Meiying had tight command of her people, all Genesis Elders moving out soon after as after she motioned towards the Apex Aeonic Noblesse, they also began to move away as Commander Vladic was the last one to turn around!
As he did, one last message was sent forward only for Noah to hear.
"I will enjoy destroying everything you hold dear in a matter of days!"

The pain he felt from seeing Euryale die was still too strong as he muttered out, intending to leave as it wasn't before the voice of the True Emperor of Quintessence reverberated out- and it wasn't only for him to hear as it spread out across the skies!
"The message I sent didn't seem to have been received, so I will do to you all what I just did to those two worthless Lifeforms."
WAA!
His words caused blazing auras to blare, but Commander Vladic motioned with his hands with his rageful eyes as the Noblesse began to disappear!

Noah's body began to flicker as he turned around at this moment to face the Apex Aeonic Lernaeans, his eyes also gazing in the direction of the being who hunted them as before he could act, a blinding Singularity of light shot towards his direction.
It was without any authority as a bejeweled Medallion came to float before him from a direction where foreign Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were floating!
Noah's eyes were sharp as he took this Communication Medallion, his body beginning to fluctuate as prompts appeared before him.
[The fused state of the Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor has come to an end.]
[For the next day, all of your Values are weakened by half.]
[The profundity you experienced in your state of fusion has propelled you ever closer to Extremity.]
[The Convergence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity has reached 90%]
[The Convergence of the Aletheian Dynamis of Extremity has reached 45%]

Bountiful prompts cascaded over his eyes as his body reformed and sized down, his finger tapping the space before him as his connection to the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was roused to create a gateway.
"Let's go."
He spoke towards the main bodies of Aurelia, Orion, and the Apex Aeonic Lernaeans who followed them as with heavy eyes, they turned into streaks of light that delved into the gateway!

Noah's figure remained still as his will strongly gazed at the many eyes undoubtedly still here, a body draped in golden robes budding off from him soon after as his main body disappeared into the gateway himself.
It was time to take stock of what had just occurred and plunge into the states of his Son and affected people, as well as prepare for the shocking future!
Part of these preparations would include utilizing the benefits that came from his Wrath, with the prompts that rose when he took out Euryale and Richard being utterly stunning ones.
[You have obtained 10x Golden Singularities of Extremity.]
[You have obtained 10x Buds of Convergence.]
[You have obtained 10x Golden Havens Essentiality.]
Golden Singularities of Extremity, Buds of Convergence, and Golden Havens of Essentiality!
They were grandiose names of Loot new from Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, but Noah didn't focus on them right now as his mind held greater focus towards an entirely different direction.
As he returned to the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, his weakened body which had half of its strength looked just as vibrant as he put all other things on hold.
Aurelia and the others were put aside, Xiaomi and Caesar were put aside!
His figure warped towards the Prana Aletheian Haven that was filled with an overabundance of life.
Here, the figure of his son with his eyes closed could be seen floating next to dozens of small shining clusters of souls that were about to have their fates ascertained by Noah!

chapters.title: Chapter 2489 Reconstruction! I
paragraphs: 2489 Reconstruction! I
His coldness and apathy faded.
Around him, verdant vines shimmering with a layer of golden light formed a magical stellar garden, multicolored flowers filled with the very essence of Prana permeating all around.

The form of the Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor entirely faded as his fair skin was laid bare, a cosmic color flashing above its epidermal skin layer as he looked like an ancient warrior forged and born from the very stars!
His eyes showed an unfathomable light of thought and power as he floated before his son who had entirely been healed from his charred visage along with pulsing clusters of residual soul light.

Far away from them and in the periphery of this deepest part of the forming Prana Aletheian Haven, the figures of Adelaide, the Longest Dream, Amelia, and many others could be seen with somber expressions as they watched on to see what the result would be.

They held worry in their eyes, but they also held a profound sense of trust towards the being who had arrived before Henry's dormant figure and the clusters of residual souls that were people he knew.
Even in this time of uncertainty, they instinctively believed he would show them yet another wonder!
So they watched on with their hearts slightly at ease.

Even further from them outside of the Prana Aletheian Haven, the figures of Aurelia's and Orion's main bodies could be seen along with other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, the leading figures of Ancestral Lernaeans swirling around them while in the distance, Caesar held Xiaomi tightly as Noah had already told them to merely sit tight while he took care of something!

All of this and many more things were happening in the background, but Noah himself focused nearly all of himself in the center of the Prana Aletheian Haven as millions of thoughts flashed in his mind.
Possibilities on the paths that could be taken.

His son was okay, and yet his soul hadn't roused even now for him to open up his eyes while the clusters of souls that used to be Eowyn, Barbatos, Kazuhiko, the Emperor Penguin, and dozens more important beings in his life only had threads of what they used to be held together by his own soul that bound them as his Vassals!
When Noah calculated the options and followed the lead of Providence and Destiny, he arrived towards a few paths.
These paths were further derived as a few were eliminated, some were considered more on, and then a single golden path remained open as the only possibility before Noah!
HOONG!
His body pulsed as his stellar visage was soon covered by a cherry colored light.
The Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity.
It was born from concepts of the end and of beginnings.
His son and many others close to him who had nearly met their ends...he could likely raise them to be even grander than they used to be with this new beginning!
"But this alone isn't enough."
His voice was vibrant as it caused the life force in the surroundings to become even more dense.
The Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity alone wasn't enough!

And apart from this, there was also the fact of rectifying how all of this had happened in the first place as while a cherry-colored light covered his body, a myriad of other lights also rose as Noah called upon new concepts of Extremity he had just expanded.
Anima.
Body, Origin, Soul, Cloning, Reification, Unification, Separation!

Each of them were brought to the 9th Boundary Layer as their Seeds of Extremity had already been taken into respective Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds as they only waited for these seeds to bud for them to achieve their 10th Boundary Layers.
Twinkling lights that represented these Boundaries danced around Noah as he...took a breath.
He breathed in these Essences as they began to circulate through every part of him- his will being set on forging something new!
Each of the newly expanded concepts had its own distinctive layers that deserved further exploration.

But this would come at a later time when he further took their standing towards a more pristine level. What he needed to do now was to attain an even greater authority through their combination. Another Absolute Seed of Extremity!

It may be an unlikelihood for other beings, but his Quintessential breathing method and his binding of the Sources of Extremity along with a myriad of other factors that made him the anomaly that he was...all of it allowed him to take the grand actions he took!
[The Convergence of multiple concepts is occurring within your Aspects of Existence.]
[There is a Quintessential Resonance with the selected concepts!]
Anima, Body, Origin, Soul, Cloning, Reification, Unification, and Separation!
Noah circulated their essences as if they were each their own separate lines that gradually came together to fuse into a single one.
To birth a single seed!
[The Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation supports and enhances the birth of another Absolute Seed of Extremity.]
As the prompts came, so did Noah's commands.
"Add Quintessence and Manadynamics into the mix."
What he used with his first Absolute Seed of Extremity to stabilize different concepts.
It brought the number of circulating Boundary Essences to 10 as his body buzzed with grandeur!
He seemed like a forge that was creating a deadly shield or weapon, radiance shining from him in no time as his soul held enough space to allow for the blooming of a third Absolute Seed of Extremity!
[The cycling Boundary Essences have extremely high affinity and reinforcement!]
[The concepts of Anima, Body, Origin, Soul, Cloning, Reification, Unification, Separation, Manadynamics, and Quintessence are converging together to birth a third Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity!]
HOONG!
The colors melded and mixed.
The multicolored light of Quintessence was strong as it seemed to paint everything with it, while Manadynamics fought to paint everything blue!
Yet Reification, Separation, and Unification came into the picture.
Anima, Body, Origin, Soul, and Cloning declared their own dominance as they melded and called for their own color!

As if influenced by the heavy green around the Prana Aletheian Haven Noah was in- such a color began to bloom as shockingly, the lone Boundary of Prana was also pulled into circulation at this critical juncture- joining 10 other Boundaries as brilliant color shone!
It felt strong and pure.
It felt too bright for any single being to hold on to it!
It was...deeply emerald in color as Noah's stellar body was painted with such a light.
[Another Absolute Seed of Extremity has begun to be forged!]
[A Third Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity has been born!]
[The distinctive conditions and harmony of the concepts within the Third Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity have placed its rate of Convergence at 25%]
