chapters.title: Chapter 2490 Reconstruction! II
paragraphs: 2490 Reconstruction! II
A Third Absolute Dynamis of Extremity bloomed within Noah as his vibrant mind didn't waste any time on this one, his Will gazing at it as he bellowed out grandly.
"Vitalistic."
WAA!
"The Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity."
In the depths of what Noah was, a blinding seed burned and read [VITALISTIC]!
Vitalistic!
It was a word that more so pointed towards the vital impulse of life.
Life, and how different parts were used to bring it all together.

How the body and mind came unified and separated. How the beating heart acted as the core to pump energy across all systems. How all of these different parts joined together to bloom with the burning impulse of life...life that only came because everything was together, and also apart!
They were the same, and yet distinct as each had their own part to play!
Only when one realized how separate all the parts that made life were, could they truly unify them to bring together a true impulse of life!
[The Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity burns brightly in your Aspects of Existence.]
[The features of Existence Dissociation and Aspect Configuration have been born!]
A burning emerald light set Noah's body aflame as he looked like a kindling of lifeforce.
The cherry colored light of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity was also burning brightly as soon after, the black gold light of the Aletheian Dynamis of Extremity bloomed out!
And his voice thundered out as waves of information washed over him.
[Aspect Configuration].
[Realm Reconstruction].
Realm Reconstruction was known. But what about Aspect Configuration?
It was a wonder in itself!

[Aspect Configuration]:: With the authority of the Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity, you can configure the very Aspects that make up a living being in a direction you favor. The Body, Origin, and Soul come together in harmony to make all beings, and when one or all of them are altered in any way, the result is one that will make way for an entirely different Existence. With Aspect Configuration, an Existence can be directed on a path of Extreme as their Soul could be configured to make up 90% of their being, with their Body and Origin making up 10%...or any different Configurations between these three Aspects of Existence. With this action and imposed configurations, there is a high likelihood of causing the Aspects of Existence to undergo fundamental changes and Mutations that are capable of producing Entities with a Mutated Soul, Body, or Origin. The level of Configuration sought and the level of the selected existence will affect how many Soul Values are required for the Aspect Configuration...
Yes.
One of the features of the Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity was a simple yet dreadful one.
It allowed Noah to configure the very Aspects of Existence as with it...he could freely give rise to Mutated Entities!
Realm Reconstruction and Aspect Configuration were activated as the black gold light of the Aletheian Dynamis of Extremity and the emerald light of the Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity surged forward.
Amidst them, the essence that signified beginnings and ends snaked in with a heavy influence!

Noah's soul buzzed with an emerald and cherry colored light that expanded to cover everything before him, his mind drifting off into a myriad of currents of light that entered what remained of the minds of all beings before him!
The mind that he arrived in first...was none other than his son.

A blue sea stretched out endlessly in all directions as at its very center, the countenance of a young man with stellar black and blue strands of hair could be seen sitting down with a forlorn expression.
"My son."

Noah appeared beside him as he was adorned in a simple blue Emperor's Robe, his hair shining with a similar light as his son stared out into the expanse with an expression that seemed to contain countless thoughts clashing with each other!
His voice was light as it emanated out.
"Father...I dare not open my eyes as I am ashamed. Ashamed that I couldn't handle it. Ashamed that without you stepping in once again, everything would have fallen apart."
The young man stared out into the expanse of blue as he couldn't meet his father's gaze.
He felt as if he had let him down, as if he didn't deserve to sit beside him and have the same grandiose Quintessential blood coursing through him!
As if his father was a genuine blazing sun...and he was only a fraud.
A fraud that would never be able to amount to anything close to him.
As if Noah could read his emotions, he stared out into the same expanse of blue as his voice boomed from all around.

"Our Lineage is one that will be etched in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. One that will be uttered with respect and reverence from the mouths of the countless Inheritances of Extremity across the Seven Havens. From Apex Aeonic Lifeforms to Hyperversal Extremities...to the unknown enemies outside the scope of time and reality itself."
WAA!
The surrounding sea buzzed as he spoke, the authorities of emerald, black gold, and cherry colored lights permeating across the blue sea as immensity began to build up!

"All of them will tremble when our Lineage is merely uttered. You...are a part of that Lineage. You do not take away from it, you only add to its grandeur. But you do have to live in line with its brilliance. When we get knocked down or make a mistake, we do not wallow in our weakness. We rise from any adversity and burn ever brighter because of it."

"The future is unknown, but there may come a day when I will step out of the light and my reign will come to an end as you will have to rise and lead. If that day ever comes, you will have to embody Quintessence itself. You will have to illuminate reality itself with the grandeur of the Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor. It cannot be anything less!"
The endless cerulean Seas churned as they were painted with emerald, black gold, and cherry colored lights!
The Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor gazed at his son as he asked calmly.

"Now, there is an opportunity to reform not just the workings of your Realm, but a basic change in your Aspects of Existence themselves. What realm will you have? How much of your Existence do you want to be dominated by your Origin, Body, and Soul?"
Realm Reconstruction and Aspect Configuration were ready to be put to work.
The first Existence to experience them both was asked as Henry's visage rose!
He looked towards his father as his expression hardened, millions of thoughts crossing through his blue eyes.
On this day, he came to a realization that whatever adversity or enemies he faced in the future, none of them would compare to the challenge of climbing over his father's shadow!
It was too vast. Too radiant!
It could be considered an impossible challenge, and yet he couldn't back down as within his veins, Quintessence also flowed!
BOOM!
Within him, destiny seethed and erupted with brilliance.
With utmost respect, he kneeled before him while voicing out grandly.
"My Realm can be reconstructed based on Destiny. There would be Dimensional Realities of Destiny, Providence, Fate, Karma, Fortune, Kismet, Moirai, Wisdom...and Quintessence."
As he spoke, Noah's soul already moved as the vast seas around them rose, turning into pillars of light that sunk into Henry's created soul as grand changes were about to take place!

Any concepts Henry mentioned that weren't elevated to the 9th Boundary Layer by Noah were taken to such a stage at this moment until they formed the Seeds waiting to bloom and become 10th Boundary Layers.
While emerald, black gold, and cherry colored lights rushed into him, Henry's blue eyes reflected endless illusory blue skies as he continued.
"As for my Aspects of Existence...let them be composed entirely of my Soul!"
BOOM!
The Son of Destiny chose a extreme direction as his destiny took him in a shocking direction!
"I shall have no Origin nor Body. My Realm shall be forged within the depths of my soul!"
His endlessly blue eyes showed a light of fanaticism as he spoke, Noah gazing at his son's burning Will as his wide palm went on to grasp his head.
Thereafter, brilliance overflowed!

chapters.title: Chapter 2491 Mass Producing Mutated Entities! I
paragraphs: 2491 Mass Producing Mutated Entities! I
Henry had chosen an utterly drastic path as he sought to have all of his existence be made purely from his soul!
Realm Reconstruction reduced his power to absolutely nothing before Noah's will placed destiny at the very center of his existence.
But before his Realm was built back up, the emerald light of the Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity shone brightly.
Noah's sight changed as before him, he discerned three aspects equally proportioned to make a whole- to make the existence that was Henry Osmont.

This would be Noah's first time utilizing Aspect Configuration as with his will entrenched in Henry's Aspects of Existence...the light of Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity shone as it began to reduce the expansiveness of the Aspects of the Body and Origin, the bubble that signified the soul instead expanding!
Aspects of Existence purely made of the Soul.

Even Noah questioned the feasibility of this, but he had long since stopped doubting the authorities edging closer to Extremity as the test today...was just to what extent he could configure the Aspects of Existence.

The Soul became ever more expansive while the breadth of the Origin and Body reduced, Noah's soul values churning as the image of the three Aspects gradually changed to show a single massive bubble that was about to entirely swallow two distinct points of light!
The Aspect of the Soul became 98% of his total Aspects of Existence.
Only a sliver of the aspect of the body and origin remained as Noah's eyes gloriously focused on them, and yet...
They didn't diminish any further and disappear into oblivion!
A truth was affirmed by Noah as the emerald green light of the Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity stabilized the newly reconfigured Aspects of Existence.
The name of the reality altering feature was Aspect Configuration.
It was an Alteration or change of the proportions of Aspects that made an existence. It did not have within it the capability deletion of Aspects of Existence!

Henry's goal of making his Aspects of Existence be entirely made of his Soul was close, but a single percentage in the body and another percentage of his Origin prevented this complete and drastic transformation!

But he had attained an existence that was almost completely made up of his Soul- with this aspect needing to take the previous duties and forms of the Origin and Body as the result wasn't entirely known.
But at the time of its conception...brilliant emerald light shone as prompts thundered down.
[A Blank Soul Mutationem Embryo has bloomed within the target's origin.]
The blinding light showed a blooming mutation as the Aspects of Existence were stabilized!
But this wasn't all.
The Soul of the Son of Destiny took control!
[The target's soul has inherently chosen its mutation to be Soul Manipulation!]
[Soul Manipulation can now be a selected Soul Mutationem for any beings that have gone through Aspect Configuration with their Soul occupying at least 60% of their Existence.]

Henry's Soul released an incandescent gold radiance as the moment Noah affirmed its stability, Realm Reconstruction fully went underway as the tiny 1% of his Origin was centered within his soul- his soul that wrapped around this minuscule remnant of Origin as it began to build up...a brand new realm with the remnant Origin at the very center!
His soul would always reign supreme.
His barely existent Origin would be majorly formed by his soul, and the husk that was his body would also be mainly put together by his soul!
And thus, a profound process took place as a realm was constructed within the depths of his soul, the origin merely acting as a small seed as universes and Cosmos very quickly began to proliferate!
And when the Realm reached a high enough level...a Destiny Dimensional Reality was forged.
Halcyon brilliance covered all of Henry as thereafter, Providence, Fate, Karma, Fortune, Kismet, Moirai, Wisdom, and Quintessence were forged one after another!
[You have opened the path of the Immeasurable Destiny Extremity Foundation.]
[The Immeasurable Destiny Extremity Foundation has been established in Henry Osmont!]
Henry Osmont!]

[When all the resonated concepts and Dimensional Realities of the Immeasurable Destiny Extremity Foundation reach saturation, Henry Osmont can undergo Apexification with a 100% chance of ascending to become an Apex Aeonic Lifeform with an Immeasurable Destiny Meridian Apex Aeonic Foundation. With such a foundation, the vast knowledge and manipulation of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity can begin as an Absolute Seed of Extremity can easily be forged from the Convergence of the concepts at the core of this foundation...]
[The Convergence of the Aletheian Dynamis of Extremity has increased by 3%]
[The Convergence of the Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity has increased by 3%]
[The Convergence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity has increased by .5%]
A stupendous Foundation was unearthed by Noah yet again as it showed the future possibilities of another Absolute Seed of Extremity that integrated concepts like destiny and Providence!
This wasn't all as due to Noah going through Aspect Configuration and Realm Reconstruction, the respective Dynamis of Extremity of these features had their rates of Convergence further elevated.
Even the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity was roused as its authority added itself in every step!
HOONG!

The viewpoint of a manifestation of a soul in an expanded blue sea changed as back in the center of the Prana Aletheian Haven, Henry's visage could be seen beside his father as his body turned incorporeal.
A golden light covered him as he seemed to be made out of pure soul light, a sense of beauty and grandeur bouncing from him streaks of cerulean light coursed through his veins!
It was the birth of a unique being within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
It was the birth of a Mutated Entity!
And with the advent of the change that made his existence...
[Henry Osmont has attained a subcategory of the Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage known as the Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Emperor.]
[All Soul Parameters have a passive boost of 50%]
[The rate of progression towards Extremity, formation of Dynamis of Extremity, and Convergence of Dynamis of Extremity has a passive increase of 50%]

With his body shining gold and blue as his soul replaced the workings of much of his Origin and Body, the Son of the True Emperor of Quintessence opened his eyes as torrential seas of destiny opened with them!

chapters.title: Chapter 2492 Mass Producing Mutated Entities! II
paragraphs: 2492 Mass Producing Mutated Entities! II
Henry's transformation and transformations were stupendous, but he wasn't the only one going through them.

As he felt the grand changes and stabilized his Realm to properly understand just what intricate boons he attained due to his Aspects of Existence being made up 98% of his soul, others were also going through a similar procedure as him!

Noah's exuberant soul had gone to bathe not just Henry, but also all the residual souls floating before him as similar to the experience with Henry, different parts of Noah's will were conversing with all existences affected.

For those who held traces of their souls left bound to him as Vassals, Noah had to drench them in the authorities of the Three Absolute Dynamis of Extremity to spur greater lifeforce and sufficiently regenerate enough of their souls for their very identities to reform!
And after this occurred...
"Barbatos."
Noah's will called out as it was manifested in a space that showed mountains of bones rising and falling endlessly.

A massive throne of bones rose on the highest mountain as the devilishly small and robust figure of Barbatos opened her eyes atop it, her dark eyes blinking with understanding as she smiled and came to focus on Noah's figure floating above her endless mountains of bone.
Her smile was genuine, and yet it held within it traces of fear as she rose from the bony throne and floated towards Noah's will.
"Little Fish...do you know how scary the thought of complete darkness without ever being able to see you again was?"
She very rarely showed her emotions, much less a sense of fear- but she truly did fear never being able to wake to see this being before her again!
So her small figure jumped into his embrace and held him tightly, Noah's wide hands stroking her head shimmering with strands of dark light as she spoke while burying her head in his chest.
"Make me stronger, Little Fish. To the extent that I never have to worry if I'll ever see you again."
Her heart let itself be known freely as Noah gently pulled her head back, bending down to lock onto her dark eyes as he lovingly asked her.
"Then tell me what Realm you want. What you wish your Aspects of Existence to be..."

The mountains of bones below began to tremble as Barbatos made her choice, with variations of scenes like this occurring simultaneously with Noah's Wills as in another Manifestation, he was faced with an endless sandy gold sea where Eowyn stood waiting for him.
A world filled with darkness and swords as Kazuhiko tried to desperately hold onto them.
An expanse of purple flowers where Guinevere floated patiently!

And...an expanse of stellar blue auroras of light as another portion of Noah's will saw the scenes of his own massive visage floating in this stellar expanse with his eyes closed, and above the head of his manifested self- the figure of a bouncing Blue Slime could be seen smiling innocently.
It cheered with happiness and bounced even more at Noah's appearance, its path also being chosen!

Noah did all of this in the depths of the Prana Aletheian Haven as shocking changes were occurring all around him, and yet he configured the aspects of his heavily injured Vassals as just like Henry...
[The target's soul has inherently chosen its mutation to be Necropolis!]
[Necropolis can now be a selected Soul Mutationem for any beings that have gone through Aspect Configuration with their Soul occupying at least 60% of their Existence.]
[The target's soul has inherently chosen its mutation to be Endless Devourer!]
[The target's Origin has inherently chosen its mutation to be Essence Manipulation!]
[The target's Body has inherently chosen its mutation to be Unbreakable...]
Dozens of such prompts floated before Noah's eyes as freely and with glorious wonder- he was actually taking actions that mass produced one Mutated Entity after another.
In the Aeonic Havens of Extremity, powerful hegemonies conducted a great deal of experiments over billions of years to produce Engineered Entities.
From the Plum Sword of Extremity, Atlas had undergone Plum Soul Ablation like millions of other Disciples over the years- and he was one of the few survivors to have become a Mutated Entity!
It was dangerous, cruel, and often had a high mortality rate.
But not for Noah.
Not for the True Emperor of Quintessence!
In the junction between the Havens of Extremity.

The surrounding space was filled with coagulated authority that seemed to be a mixture of the nature of the very Havens themselves- this Authority being something that only Dynamis of Extremity or Hyperversal Extremity Authority could traverse!

One of Noah's bodies was moving with Grand Primeval Elder Silas towards the Aeonic Haven of Penumbra as he turned around with a sharp expression towards Noah- their surroundings buzzing with waves of darkness to keep the authority around them away.

"An Apex War of Annihilation against the Noblesse? Why would you seek such a thing when the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of the Lernaean Lineage are only subpar? And you won't just be facing the Noblesse as some of the Singularity Overseer Elders will likely join in to support them!"
Silas's gaze was difficult as Noah's eyes were indifferent at such a time, his hands waving calmly.
"None of the Primeval Shadow Elders need to participate. This is something I can take on myself."
WAA!
A war against Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
Noah would have to prepare a great deal for it as it was bound to be deadly, and yet he didn't seek the aid of any other forces!
Silas saw the indifference and assurance on his face as he took out a Communication Medallion while shaking his head.
"I'll confirm with the higher ups first but...the Cult of Endless Shadows cannot simply sit idle as an Apex War goes on with a force that is now affiliated with us!"
It was a small war involving two aboriginal Lineages of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.
And yet it seemed that a level of influence would be enforced by Inheritances of Extremity within this war!
Far away from this location. Within the depths of the Noblesse Lineage.

A crystalline obsidian floor stretched out for miles above billowing void clouds, an air of wonder and supremacy covering a ceiling that was littered with Cosmos and other stellar bodies as if they were ornaments.

Thrones and exquisite extended tables stretched out across the crystalline obsidian floor as this was within the center of the Imperial Void Planes Cluster where the core powers of the Noblesse would meet!
Commander Vladic could be seen with crimson black eyes debating something with a stern Grand Genesis Elder Meiying when the voice of a Noblesse Apex Aeonic Lifeforms interrupted them.
"Vladic, a delegation of Singularity Overseers has arrived..."
Commander Vladic's eyes shone at such words as he beckoned to grant access.
Kismet danced wildly around his heart as it told him another beneficial reality that would further ensure his Wrath would descend upon the Lernaeans after three days had arrived!

sentences.text: 2492 Mass Producing Mutated Entities!
II
Henry's transformation and transformations were stupendous, but he wasn't the only one going through them.

As he felt the grand changes and stabilized his Realm to properly understand just what intricate boons he attained due to his Aspects of Existence being made up 98% of his soul, others were also going through a similar procedure as him!

Noah's exuberant soul had gone to bathe not just Henry, but also all the residual souls floating before him as similar to the experience with Henry, different parts of Noah's will were conversing with all existences affected.

For those who held traces of their souls left bound to him as Vassals, Noah had to drench them in the authorities of the Three Absolute Dynamis of Extremity to spur greater lifeforce and sufficiently regenerate enough of their souls for their very identities to reform!
And after this occurred...
"Barbatos."
Noah's will called out as it was manifested in a space that showed mountains of bones rising and falling endlessly.

A massive throne of bones rose on the highest mountain as the devilishly small and robust figure of Barbatos opened her eyes atop it, her dark eyes blinking with understanding as she smiled and came to focus on Noah's figure floating above her endless mountains of bone.
Her smile was genuine, and yet it held within it traces of fear as she rose from the bony throne and floated towards Noah's will.
"Little Fish...do you know how scary the thought of complete darkness without ever being able to see you again was?"
She very rarely showed her emotions, much less a sense of fear- but she truly did fear never being able to wake to see this being before her again!
So her small figure jumped into his embrace and held him tightly, Noah's wide hands stroking her head shimmering with strands of dark light as she spoke while burying her head in his chest.
"Make me stronger, Little Fish.
To the extent that I never have to worry if I'll ever see you again."
Her heart let itself be known freely as Noah gently pulled her head back, bending down to lock onto her dark eyes as he lovingly asked her.
"Then tell me what Realm you want.
What you wish your Aspects of Existence to be..."

The mountains of bones below began to tremble as Barbatos made her choice, with variations of scenes like this occurring simultaneously with Noah's Wills as in another Manifestation, he was faced with an endless sandy gold sea where Eowyn stood waiting for him.
A world filled with darkness and swords as Kazuhiko tried to desperately hold onto them.
An expanse of purple flowers where Guinevere floated patiently!

And...an expanse of stellar blue auroras of light as another portion of Noah's will saw the scenes of his own massive visage floating in this stellar expanse with his eyes closed, and above the head of his manifested self- the figure of a bouncing Blue Slime could be seen smiling innocently.
It cheered with happiness and bounced even more at Noah's appearance, its path also being chosen!

Noah did all of this in the depths of the Prana Aletheian Haven as shocking changes were occurring all around him, and yet he configured the aspects of his heavily injured Vassals as just like Henry...
[The target's soul has inherently chosen its mutation to be Necropolis!]
[Necropolis can now be a selected Soul Mutationem for any beings that have gone through Aspect Configuration with their Soul occupying at least 60% of their Existence.]
[The target's soul has inherently chosen its mutation to be Endless Devourer!]
[The target's Origin has inherently chosen its mutation to be Essence Manipulation!]
[The target's Body has inherently chosen its mutation to be Unbreakable...]
Dozens of such prompts floated before Noah's eyes as freely and with glorious wonder- he was actually taking actions that mass produced one Mutated Entity after another.
In the Aeonic Havens of Extremity, powerful hegemonies conducted a great deal of experiments over billions of years to produce Engineered Entities.
From the Plum Sword of Extremity, Atlas had undergone Plum Soul Ablation like millions of other Disciples over the years- and he was one of the few survivors to have become a Mutated Entity!
It was dangerous, cruel, and often had a high mortality rate.
But not for Noah.
Not for the True Emperor of Quintessence!
In the junction between the Havens of Extremity.

The surrounding space was filled with coagulated authority that seemed to be a mixture of the nature of the very Havens themselves- this Authority being something that only Dynamis of Extremity or Hyperversal Extremity Authority could traverse!

One of Noah's bodies was moving with Grand Primeval Elder Silas towards the Aeonic Haven of Penumbra as he turned around with a sharp expression towards Noah- their surroundings buzzing with waves of darkness to keep the authority around them away.
"An Apex War of Annihilation against the Noblesse?
Why would you seek such a thing when the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of the Lernaean Lineage are only subpar?
And you won't just be facing the Noblesse as some of the Singularity Overseer Elders will likely join in to support them!"
Silas's gaze was difficult as Noah's eyes were indifferent at such a time, his hands waving calmly.
"None of the Primeval Shadow Elders need to participate.
This is something I can take on myself."
WAA!
A war against Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
Noah would have to prepare a great deal for it as it was bound to be deadly, and yet he didn't seek the aid of any other forces!
Silas saw the indifference and assurance on his face as he took out a Communication Medallion while shaking his head.
"I'll confirm with the higher ups first but...the Cult of Endless Shadows cannot simply sit idle as an Apex War goes on with a force that is now affiliated with us!"
It was a small war involving two aboriginal Lineages of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.
And yet it seemed that a level of influence would be enforced by Inheritances of Extremity within this war!
Far away from this location.
Within the depths of the Noblesse Lineage.

A crystalline obsidian floor stretched out for miles above billowing void clouds, an air of wonder and supremacy covering a ceiling that was littered with Cosmos and other stellar bodies as if they were ornaments.

Thrones and exquisite extended tables stretched out across the crystalline obsidian floor as this was within the center of the Imperial Void Planes Cluster where the core powers of the Noblesse would meet!

"Vladic, a delegation of Singularity Overseers has arrived..."
Commander Vladic's eyes shone at such words as he beckoned to grant access.

chapters.title: Chapter 2493 An Apex Seed Blooms! I
paragraphs: 2493 An Apex Seed Blooms! I
In the depths of roiling skies filled with tendrils of Ruin and Nullity.

Within the region where Noah had just eradicated Euryale and Richard, a clone floated amidst the sources of chaos calmly as while his main body undertook a tremendous job in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, this Clone had its own role here!

Before he could begin to move though, the blinding Communication Medallion that had shot towards his direction from the late arrivals who were existences from the Singularity Overseers began to pulse with life as a message came through.
"You seem to be in a predicament right now."
The voice was deep and full of power.
Yet it didn't cause Noah to bat an eye as he replied calmly.
"Oh?"

"Yes. And we can aid you in this predicament right now. You just have to let go of the father and daughter pair of Quasarians that escaped with you. Then an Oath can be sworn that the full force of Singularity Overseers will stand with the Lernaean Lineage in their Apex War of Annihilation."
WAA!

The voice stemmed from none other than Zeitgeist as Noah's expression remained placid, his gaze turning to the pulsing sources of chaos around him as he could no longer feel the gaze of the existence who was chasing Aurelia and the others!
"And if I don't let the father and daughter pair go?"
He replied freely to the Medallion as the voice coming from it became even more stern.

"A delegation of Singularity Overseer Elders is on the way towards the Noblesse right now. If you agree, it will be us pressuring the Genesis Institute of Extremity to not interfere. If you do not see reason and disagree...you can consider the force of Singularity Overseers in this Haven standing with the Noblesse Lineage against you in this coming Apex War!"
A threat as clear as day was made as Noah's face remained free of emotions, his voice cold as he began to crush the Medallion in his hands!
"Go ahead then. It will merely be adding more lambs to the upcoming slaughter!"
CRACK!
The dazzling medallion shattered and turned to dust in his hands as thereafter, his visage began to float upwards towards the thundering ruin and nullity.
His intent was clear as he was returning to the place he had inadvertently left to keep to the agreement he held with the very Adjudicator of this Haven!
And it didn't take long before a blinding light thundered down that instantly took his figure away.
The region returned to only being filled with tendrils of Ruin and Nullity as a distance away from it, towards the depths of the Noblesse Domains, a meeting was about to take place!
Within the center of the Imperial Void Planes Cluster

The figure of Grand Singularity Elder Zeitgeist could be seen floating towards Grand Genesis Elder Meiying and Commander Vladic with three other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms in tow, their bodies pulsing with grandeur as Meiying was the first one to speak.
"To what do we owe the great pleasure of having you all here?"

Her eyes were calm, and yet they held a powerful authority that Zeitgeist laughed off while gazing towards Commander Vladic- his eyes remembering the words Noah had said before the Communication Medallion was crushed as he proceeded with his threat!
"Nothing too extravagant. The Singularity Overseers just wanted to offer some of our Apex Aeonic Lifeforms to fight on behalf of the Noblesse in the coming Apex War..."
Words that caused Commander Vladic's brutal eyes to light up rose as his smile became an extremely welcoming one.
The auras of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms blazed brightly as short-lived alliances were made- with the beings in them each wanting different things...that were connected to the same person!
Towards the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.
Past the wide fissure of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution.
"Move in formation!"
A bellow could be heard from a group of Shadowlings as they scrambled to push away another squadron of Scions to attain two pulsing Golden Extremity Panaceas.
Every single being in the surroundings was rushing to get any Aeonic Treasure of Extremity as more and more beings delved deeper into the Extremity Vein!

In the past few minutes, the Shadowlings faced immense scrutiny as the powerful bodies of the beings leading them disappeared, and they finally entered brawls to fight for relics to forge their own Foundations.
They dearly missed the being who was unstoppable against all Scions here as before the situation could become even more chaotic...
SHIING!
Space twisted and tore as the stellar visage of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity appeared once more.

His stellar body looked just as stunning as even though he was expressing half of his power currently...the pressure he emanated outwards nearly caused the Scions in the surroundings to suffocate as even with half of the 1 Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Value Noah's Main body held- this Reified Source of Quintessence could display 9 times the power as ridiculously, Noah's half weakened state was the maddening pressure of 4.5 Apex Aeonic Soul Values!

It meant that the exploration of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution would be something of utter ease for him as Leviathans and Scions alike would be utterly shredded unless it was beings like Erikson or Atlas...and even they had to establish their Foundations and multiply their current selves many times over to even come close to standing next to his brilliance!
"Let's go."

His voice boomed out as more Reified Sources of Extremity materialized beside him, the Shadowlings showing happiness and euphoria as they followed the Arcane Haven Source Engine and other reified forms while Noah's Quintessential Emperor of Extremity turned into a glimmer of light that disappeared into the distance.
The next few days were extremely critical as many things had to fall into place before a massive war broke out.
Noah had a few goals already set that he had to meet before that time as there were a great deal of things he needed to do himself!
One was the thorough exploration of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution and obtaining the relics to aid in the Convergence and progression of Boundaries and whatever else they held.
The other goals...were all meant to come together to allow him to overwhelm the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms that would emerge in the coming Apex War of Annihilation!

chapters.title: Chapter 2494 An Apex Seed Blooms! II
paragraphs: 2494 An Apex Seed Blooms! II
His goals were crucial, and Noah had zero doubts in being able to complete them as things were already starting off with unbelievable progress and results so far in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

This was all due to him utilizing Realm Reconstruction and Aspect Configuration on his people, the results being shocking boons for them...but even greater boons for him as his three Dynamis of Extremity were experiencing a shocking acceleration in their rate of Convergence!
This...accomplished another one of Noah's goals.
His three Absolute Seeds of Extremity bloomed as he wanted to reach full Convergence and have the fully formed Absolute Dynamis of Extremity for him to wield before the Apex War.
And this was Infinitely close to being achieved by the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity that was already above 90%!
Then...came the question of how it was possible for Noah to continue spending his Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values for all of his people.
Even he should've been feeling the strain!
And yet, the answer to this came in the form of his expanded Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values, as well as...

[Quintessential Hyperversal Mana]:: The body of the True Emperor of Quintessence courses with an infinite amount of this immense authority as it holds all qualities of the prior Aeonic Mana of Extremity and further enhances them. When casting any features or abilities requiring the cost of any other Resource or Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values, this type of mana will be utilized first to cover 95% of the cost. This type of Mana has Quintessentially influenced the Quintessential Hyperversal Aletheian Reality Passages within your Origin as the forging Aletheian Havens of Extremity currently allows you to regenerate 100% of your Maximum Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values in 5 minutes. All features and abilities cast through this resource will exhibit 7.5% Absolute Hyperversal Authority Penetration, along with other unquantified boons that will only manifest as the Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation progresses even further....
His Quintessential Hyperversal Mana that was Infinite!

His essence usage would be nestled covered by this type of Mana as if an ability was ridiculous enough to cost 1 Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Value to cast, Noah would only need to utilize .05 Soul Values while his Mana would cover the other .95.
With it, he could manifest the Planar Domains of his Boundaries endlessly, and he could spam freely with the cost being kept to a minimum!
It allowed him to take crazy actions that were only supplemented by the fact that all of his soul values would regenerate to their maximum value in 5 minutes.

This was how in the past few minutes, Noah had continued to freely utilize Realm Reconstruction and Aspect Configuration in the depths of the Prana Aletheian Haven as from the cluster of residual souls, many bodies had formed.

Each one held their own chosen composition of their Aspects of Existence and their own Realms, Noah continuing to gain more proficiency in altering Aspects of Existence as his Convergence of Dynamis of Extremity...
[The Convergence of the Aletheian Dynamis of Extremity has increased to 80%]
[The Convergence of the Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity has increased to 60%]
[The Convergence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity has increased to 99.9%]
Aletheian and Vitalistic were rising steadily.
And yet the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity had reached 99.9%, and no matter how much more he used this dazzling cherry colored essence...this percentage did not rise up any further.
It was as if it told Noah that unless he had some profound epiphany about beginnings and ends, he wouldn't achieve full Convergence!
Now, if it were in the past, Noah would take his time as such an epiphany could come in a day or two.
If it were in the past.
BZZZT!
While a storm of essence surrounded him with his reborn vassals before his glorious visage in the Prana Aletheian Haven, his left hand beckoned as on it, a dynamic Loot materialized!
It was a Bud of Convergence.
One of the three types of Loot he had received from erasing Euryale and Richard!

It pulsed with a simple milky white light as it was in the form of a crystalline transparent white seed, sparks of authority bounding within it as one's Aspects of Existence would instinctively feel the need to devour it.

[Bud of Convergence]:: The combination of concepts of Extremity is an adversity that calls forth even greater adversity, with some never being able to overcome it. Extremity of one concept is already arduous enough, Extremity of multiple concepts under one definition is nearly an impossibility. This Bud of Convergence exists to bridge the gap of impossibility as it aids in the rate of Convergence of Dynamis of Extremity. An increase of 5% to the rate of Convergence can be obtained when aimed towards Aeonic Dynamis of Extremity, and an increase of 1% Convergence can be obtained when directed towards Absolute Dynamis of Extremity. When trying to achieve the impossible, Buds of Convergence are merely one of the many tools you will need...
A tool to overcome the impossible task one took when they forged a Dynamis of Extremity!
Noah's eyes were sharp as he opened his mouth to devour this Bud right away, directing it towards nothing other than the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity!
HOONG!
The Bud blossomed the moment it settled into his body as the authority within it was unleashed.
It went towards Noah's soul and surged to wrap around a budding Seed.
Around a runic seed that read [INDEFATIGABLE]!
It was akin to a jolt that caused the Absolute Seed of Extremity to surge to life, this seed beginning to release liquified cherry colored light as...it started to bloom.
An Absolute Seed of Extremity...was blooming in Noah's Soul!
Endless waves of cherry colored light blanketed everything.
The green light in the environs was nearly swallowed whole as an series of prompts started to descend.
[The Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity has reached 100% Convergence!]
[An Absolute Seed of Extremity has bloomed within your Soul!]
[A Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity is blooming within your Soul!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2495 A Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity! I
paragraphs: 2495 A Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity! I
[A Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity is blooming within your Soul!]
The prompt was a heavy one as it showed something utterly fantastical blooming in Noah's Soul.

The runic seed that was labeled [INDEFATIGABLE] bloomed into an incandescent tree that spread its root across Noah's Soul, the pristine pure aura of Hyperversal Extremity being felt from it ever so slightly as it showed even though this path was an extremely arduous one...it could grant something standing above all other concepts!
The Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity was lividus in color as its branches shone with the cherry colored light, fully embedded themselves within Noah's soul as his outside body was illuminated.

Its outer trunk seemed as small as an atom and as vast as a Haven at the same time, countless runes reading the word [INDEFATIGABLE] swirling across the magnificent Yggdrasil as the branches looked like cherry colored rivers of reality.

Even though it was occurring within his soul, the image of the Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity was manifested outwardly as far above Noah in the Prana Aletheian Haven, the glorious visage of a cherry colored Absolute Dynamis of Extremity showed itself!
It caused the existences in the surroundings to shudder as the Reverend Emperors and below felt an undeniable authority that caused their very Aspects of Existence to tremble.
And the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms that just entered the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...
Gazed towards the flowering Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity in utter shock as they felt an overwhelming sense of pressure from it!
As if it could surpass them and their power.
Aurelia, Orion, and the other Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms couldn't make heads or tails of it as their shock grew.

Caesar had a difficult expression as he stared towards the illusory image of the cherry colored tree, Xiaomi floating in front of him with a light of immense interest as her will was trying to understand everything they saw around them.
"Just what place have we come to, Father?"
Her voice was as thin as it could be as even the man behind her didn't truly have an idea!
Back in the Prana Aletheian Haven, Noah continued to experience the changes that came with the Complete Convergence of a Dynamis of Extremity as more prompts cascaded down.
[The flowering of the Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity indicates the start of a single definition composed of multiple concepts making its way towards Extremity.]
[The more advancements made in the individual concepts that compose the single definition of Indefatigable, the closer that this definition will be towards Extremity.]

[The increased usage of the authority of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity will also increase the progression of the individual concepts that make it up, where the moment that all of them attain the 18th Boundary Layer, the Extremity Boundary Layer, then the Indefatigable Dynamis will also attain Extremity.]
Why was the task of taking a single Dynamis of Extremity towards Extremity nearly an impossibility?

If a being stuck with a single concept, they could focus on it as over the years, they could define themselves with this single concept at Apexification and attain the 10th Boundary Layer- slowly continuing to put all three efforts of their Aspects of Existence into it as they grudgingly exceeded one Layer after another to reach the 18th Boundary Layer!
The Extremity Boundary Layer!
9 Layers to distinguish one level of lifeform, and 9 more Layers to distinguish Apex Aeonic Lifeforms seeking Extremity.
All of this had to occur for a single Concept to reach Extremity!
For a Dynamis of Extremity to reach Extremity itself...all the concepts it was composed of had to do so.
An Aeonic Dynamis of two or three concepts may still be manageable as one might take double the amount of time as a being focusing on a single concept.
An Absolute Dynamis of 9 Concepts? 10?
It was a heavy wall for one to climb as each Layer past the 10th Boundary Layer...was a wall more massive than all the previous Layers combined.
An impossible path.
This was what Noah had placed himself on.
And yet all of this impossibility...had its own rewards for the being who had managed to grasp onto it.

[Every day, the Indefatigable Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity will bud Indefatigable Fruits of Extremity equivalent to the number of concepts in its makeup. The Indefatigable Fruits of Extremity can be devoured as they are extremely conducive to raising the Boundary Layers of all Concepts of Extremity, with their effectiveness doubling when directed towards the progression of the concepts making up the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity.]

[Due to your Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation, the effects of the Indefatigable Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity are further enhanced as the Indefatigable Fruits of Extremity will bud twice in a single day!]
HOONG!
The boon of his foundation!
His body released waves of gorgeous cherry colored light as it was shown once more just why a powerful foundation was important.
It could truly influence the ease of one's journey towards Extremity!

But apart from this, the appearance of the Indefatigable Fruits of Extremity displayed why Inheritances of Extremity and Hyperversal Extremity Existences favored any Apex Aeonic Lifeform that was able to form an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
Why such a being was eventually guaranteed to reach Extremity?

Such beings were so special as only they...had access to a Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity that bloomed with Fruits of Extremity every single day. Fruits they could then use towards attaining Extremity in a Concept as for them...
there was no bottleneck!

If they lived for a long enough period of time, they would use the Fruits of Extremity until a Concept attained the 18th Boundary Layer. The Extremity Boundary Layer that gave access to Hyperversal Extremity Authority!
At this very moment, Noah felt the Indefatigable Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity vibrate as from its stellar cherry colored branches, 9 Buds already began to form.
They would normally take a full day to bloom, but because of Noah's Foundation, all 9 would bloom to become Indefatigable Fruits of Extremity in half a day as Noah could collect 18 of them daily!

chapters.title: Chapter 2496 A Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity! II
paragraphs: 2496 A Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity! II
This was the reward for his efforts.
This was the grandeur of Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
And it wasn't done.
[All features under the banner of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity are further enhanced.]

[Realm Reconstruction can now be utilized on existences whose Realm or understanding towards Extremity has exceeded yours by Layers, with their core essence being preserved and utilized when reconstructing their Realm from the very beginning.]

[Miniature Vacuous Hyperversal Domain allows you more leeway and control where now, you can induce the limited Vacuous Hyperversal Authority called within the Domain and control it in a very limited, basic fashion.]
[Vacuous Reality Absorption has the time it can be cast again shortened by half, with the limitation of usage being raised to when you have less than 25% of your Soul Values remaining.]
[The Indefatigable Absolute Planar Domain can now be cast.]
An array of prompts each more fantastical than the last!
Realm Reconstruction could now be used on even existences above him as it meant...Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were beings he could now experiment and modify.
Their power would even be set aside when their Realm was broken down as it could be used when it was being rebuilt into something else entirely!
Miniature Vacuous Hyperversal Domain and Vacuous Reality Absorption became even more dreadful as more than all this, there was the Indefatigable Planar Domain.
There were the Planar Domain of Sanguinity, Halcyon Plane of Loot, or Quintessential Hegemony of the Emperor among many other Planar Domains that Noah could call forth from Boundaries.

He could even manifest the Dimensional Realities that were now as grand as Minor Aeonic Havens in his Aletheian Havens of Extremity around him as they had the fantastical boon where unless they were destroyed, his body wouldn't be!
He had all of this...and now, the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity could also usher forth its own Planar Domain.
A plane of beginnings and ends.
How dreadful would it be when it was released on the battlefield?
This was a question that Apex Aeonic Lifeforms would soon get to experience as Noah continued preparing for them!
[Hyperversal Dignity has increased from .3 to .6]
[Hyperversal Mastery has increased from .3 to .6]

[The Authority of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity will course across your Aspects of Existence to fortify your Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation passively when utilizing your Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi, granting an increase in all your Hyperversal Values unceasingly.]

[The Authority of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity is counted collectively as a single authority, only taking a single slot out of the 24 Authorities of Boundaries that can be spread with every breath you take.]
His body was akin to a precious metal others shouldn't even gaze at as he breathed in.
OONG!

A grand symphony played at his mere breathing as essences and authorities circulated, the Indefatigable Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity vibrating with majesty and releasing its authority to proliferate through all of Noah's very atoms in a single breath as everything felt ever grander and filled with more life thereafter!

[The combination of your Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi, Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation, and the authority of the Indefatigable Absolute Dynamis of Extremity coursing through you has caused the strengthening and strengthening of your Aspects of Existence to reach an abnormal level, granting you an increase of +.5 Hyperversal Soul Values, +.5 Hyperversal Damage Values, +1.5 Hyperversal Defense Values, and +1.5 Hyperversal Vitality Values daily.]

After one completed Apexification and became an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, their power greatly varied based on how quickly they raised the concept that defined them towards Extremity, the latter Boundaries each holding shocking augmentation as depending on the Boundary, a single advancement in a layer could grant them 1, 20, or even 50 Apex Aeonic Soul/Damage/Defense Values for high tier Consummate Boundaries exceeding the 10th Boundary Layer.

And the more Boundaries one brought past the 10th layer, the stronger their Apex Values would grow as in addition to this, their Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi would allow for the circulation of their Boundaries and Dynamis of Extremity to inactively strengthen their Foundation and have their power increased on a daily basis!

But such a daily increase was negligible for average Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as too many years had to pass for the Foundations to bloom and inactively grant them tens or possibly hundreds of Apex Aeonic Values.

Terrifying Mutated Entities and Scions grew at a much faster rate as the longer they lived, the more dreadful their power became as they fortified and strengthened their Foundations with Boundaries advanced past the 10th Layers and Dynamis of Extremity as for them, exceeding 1,000 or 10,000 Apex Aeonic Soul Values could be done with ease after sufficient time passed- with others simply being monstrous as even the aforementioned numbers were nothing to them!
Then...there was Noah.
His Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation that pulsed with 81 Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds.
His Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi.
His Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!

All of it made it so that as he breathed every single day, he would gain a Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Value equivalent to half of the value of a common existence that had just undergone Apexification.
A Quintessential Hyperversal Vitality exceeding what a common existence that had just undergone Apexification could attain!
This was his Foundation.
This was his prize for forging an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity and the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi!

His body pulsed with utter grandiosity to the extent that the reforming figures of Henry, Barbatos, Eowyn, Kazuhiko, and all others who were receiving a reformation of their very existence...they all felt like they were rotating in the gravitational waves of a bright and luminous sun, their figures spinning in his magnificence as they rotated with every breath he took.

Their Aspects of Existence cheered with every breath he took as they felt themselves advancing in power by merely being near him- their minds not even being able to imagine how he was doing all of this!
All of this... was only part of Noah's preparations for the coming Apex War.
One of the goals was to have all three Dynamis of Extremity achieve full Convergence before the war.

Noah had just succeeded with the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity as these were the results, his eyes flashing opening at this moment as he continued to breathe calmly- the grand effects of his mere Breathing reducing just slightly as he focused on finishing the reforging of the Aspects of Existence of less than a dozen of his people.

The rest of them were already reborn into even grander versions of themselves as they had their eyes closed tightly while sensing and understanding their changes- their bodies rotating around Noah as if this whole region was a group of stars- melted emerald, black gold, and cherry colored rivers of authorities forming and still sinking into them as they were being forged into beings that could far outstrip even the most special Scions of Inheritances of Extremity!
Everything was flowing smoothly and in a grand order.
And there were still multiple parts that had to come into play before he was ready!

chapters.title: Chapter 2497 Winds of Change! I
paragraphs: 2497 Winds of Change! I
The illusory image of the cherry colored Indefatigable Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity remained stretched out around the Aletheian Havens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
The group of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms around Aurelia and Orion felt many things when gazing at it as one of them spoke at this moment.
"Is this why you didn't oppose him when he accepted an Apex War of Annihilation?"
The voice of this Apex Aeonic Lernaean was not directed to a particular being, and yet all eyes and Wills became focused on Aurelia as they knew to whom these words were directed to!
The strongest of the Apex Aeonic Lernaeans.
The one who had used her Forge to aid most of those here to reach the heights they now held.

The one who held more Extreme Power than any one of them- and the one who had contributed the most on keeping the dreadful enemy who attacked them until they ran into the battle that the Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor was waging against Noblesse!

The other Apex Aeonic Lernaeans didn't say a word when all of their lives were put on the line because she didn't! But as the atmosphere calmed and they truly realized what was ahead of them, they couldn't help but ponder.
And Aurelia...

"I was not opposed to the decision of the man who now shoulders all Lernaeans. You all still haven't gotten the chance to grasp how crucial he is. The Apex War was already set in stone anyways as now...we just have to survive it."
Her golden hair shone with radiance as Orion quietly watched the illusory cherry colored tree illuminating the stellar expanse.
But even with her words...there were still voices of logic that rang out!

"But an Apex War of Annihilation is one of Complete extinction and death. Our numbers are lesser, the Nobility have the Genesis Institute of Extremity behind them as their Elders were even there in person. We...we only have our fractured forces as the Cult of Endless Shadows didn't even show up, even now we don't know if they will support us by sending any forces. We would need a heavy and powerful force of a powerful Inheritance of Extremity to survive such a war as no matter how powerful a single being is...he is just one man."
WAA!

A man garbed in a light blue robe shared the hidden thoughts of many of the less than a dozen Apex Aeonic Lernaeans here as they didn't know much about the Master of the land they were in apart from what they had seen prior!
As if emboldened by the thought of their certain deaths in the coming war, a woman with dazzling red hair spoke up next.

"He alone took down two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, yes. He even seems to hold an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity. All of these are unbelievable achievements while he hasn't even undergone Apexification...but Sis Aurelia, that truly isn't enough to stand against tens of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms. Because that is likely what we'll face...especially the Elders and Grand Elder of the Genesis Institute of Extremity. I do not know why you have an unyielding belief in him, but in three days, even if he successfully undergoes Apexification...how will this give us even a high percentage of probability of coming out of this alive?"
A heavy atmosphere settled amidst all of this blinding radiance as the eyes of many Apex Aeonic Lernaeans showed their fear and hesitation!
The more they thought about it, the more it seemed like they were just thrown into a war to be butchered and destroyed along with all Lernaeans!
At such a juncture, Aurelia turned and gazed back at all of them with a sneer.
"This is why I stayed away from you lot. Weak with no damn backbone!"
WAA!

"What would you have had me do? Exclaim he wasn't part of the Lernaeans and deny this Apex War of Annihilation when he was just enthroned as Emperor and saved us? Or will you all run away now before the war even comes in fear? Intention you betray to the Nobility or other factions? Unless you have an plan worth a single shit, just stand back and shut up while we try to figure out this whole damn situation!"
Anger and disappointment could be felt in her voice as below them, Maximilian and other Reverend Lernaeans watched on silently.
They came to understand the whole fate of their Lineage hung in the balance!
Outside of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.
In a small corner within the Aeonic Haven of Genesis.
Near the Domains of the Genesis Institute of Extremity.
Rivers of reality created a floor that stretched out beautifully, these rivers falling down like waterfalls atop the peak of one of the many mountains in this area that shone with a majestic light.
This particular mountain was an abode reserved for a Grand Genesis Elder and the forces placed under him!
Around the peak of this mountain, stellar liquified streams of essence surged as snaking rivers of reality could be seen beautifully rising and falling every now and then.
It was a mystical and wondrous abode as towards the center of the mountain peak, above the floor made of rivers of reality, two powerful Supreme Divine Entities could be seen sitting.

Between them, a stellar board holding rounded white and black pieces could be seen as they seemed to be playing a game, and yet one could sense the authority of multiple Extreme Power coursing around every piece on the board as just moving one required the opposing being to lose in a contest of authority!

The two beings sitting opposite to each other were two men in their prime, one being the master of this mountain and adorned in a white robe as the other held a radiant violet robe- his voice echoing out calmly.

"I thought the commotion that the unknown Scion is causing in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution was enough to get a few Inheritances buzzing...but now there's also an Apex War? And you guys are involved in this as well? What's really happening, Demetrius?"

The violet robed being stroked his chin as he spoke of the messages sent over by the Scions of Inheritances in the Extremity Vein of Dissolution who came across the dreadful being who massacred a few hundred Scions and got off scot-free!
A few squadrons from the Genesis Institute of Extremity were even among them as the situation was extremely peculiar.
The white robed Grand Genesis Elder smiled as he replied while ushering his authority to move a white piece on the board.

"Oh yes, my dear friend Ophyr. Our communication channels have been lighting up with this as uniquely, it's being found out by those who tracked him since he entered the periphery of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution and from the accounts of aboriginals there...that he is an aboriginal tied to some weak Lernaean Lineage. And now this Apex War that Meiying has told us about...it also involves Lernaeans as from the images she's sent over and what our surviving Scions have sent over, it seems the same being is involved in both incidents!"

I
The illusory image of the cherry colored Indefatigable Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity remained stretched out around the Aletheian Havens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
The group of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms around Aurelia and Orion felt many things when gazing at it as one of them spoke at this moment.
"Is this why you didn't oppose him when he accepted an Apex War of Annihilation?"
The voice of this Apex Aeonic Lernaean was not directed to a particular being, and yet all eyes and Wills became focused on Aurelia as they knew to whom these words were directed to!
The strongest of the Apex Aeonic Lernaeans.
The one who had used her Forge to aid most of those here to reach the heights they now held.

The one who held more Extreme Power than any one of them- and the one who had contributed the most on keeping the dreadful enemy who attacked them until they ran into the battle that the Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor was waging against Noblesse!
The other Apex Aeonic Lernaeans didn't say a word when all of their lives were put on the line because she didn't!
But as the atmosphere calmed and they truly realized what was ahead of them, they couldn't help but ponder.
And Aurelia...
"I was not opposed to the decision of the man who now shoulders all Lernaeans.
You all still haven't gotten the chance to grasp how crucial he is.
The Apex War was already set in stone anyways as now...we just have to survive it."
Her golden hair shone with radiance as Orion quietly watched the illusory cherry colored tree illuminating the stellar expanse.
But even with her words...there were still voices of logic that rang out!
"But an Apex War of Annihilation is one of Complete extinction and death.
Our numbers are lesser, the Nobility have the Genesis Institute of Extremity behind them as their Elders were even there in person.
We...we only have our fractured forces as the Cult of Endless Shadows didn't even show up, even now we don't know if they will support us by sending any forces.
We would need a heavy and powerful force of a powerful Inheritance of Extremity to survive such a war as no matter how powerful a single being is...he is just one man."
WAA!

A man garbed in a light blue robe shared the hidden thoughts of many of the less than a dozen Apex Aeonic Lernaeans here as they didn't know much about the Master of the land they were in apart from what they had seen prior!
As if emboldened by the thought of their certain deaths in the coming war, a woman with dazzling red hair spoke up next.
"He alone took down two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, yes.
He even seems to hold an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
All of these are unbelievable achievements while he hasn't even undergone Apexification...but Sis Aurelia, that truly isn't enough to stand against tens of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
Because that is likely what we'll face...especially the Elders and Grand Elder of the Genesis Institute of Extremity.

I do not know why you have an unyielding belief in him, but in three days, even if he successfully undergoes Apexification...how will this give us even a high percentage of probability of coming out of this alive?"
A heavy atmosphere settled amidst all of this blinding radiance as the eyes of many Apex Aeonic Lernaeans showed their fear and hesitation!
The more they thought about it, the more it seemed like they were just thrown into a war to be butchered and destroyed along with all Lernaeans!
At such a juncture, Aurelia turned and gazed back at all of them with a sneer.
"This is why I stayed away from you lot.
Weak with no damn backbone!"
WAA!

Exclaim he wasn't part of the Lernaeans and deny this Apex War of Annihilation when he was just enthroned as Emperor and saved us?
Or will you all run away now before the war even comes in fear?
Intention you betray to the Nobility or other factions?
Unless you have an plan worth a single shit, just stand back and shut up while we try to figure out this whole damn situation!"
Anger and disappointment could be felt in her voice as below them, Maximilian and other Reverend Lernaeans watched on silently.
They came to understand the whole fate of their Lineage hung in the balance!
Outside of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.
In a small corner within the Aeonic Haven of Genesis.
Near the Domains of the Genesis Institute of Extremity.
Rivers of reality created a floor that stretched out beautifully, these rivers falling down like waterfalls atop the peak of one of the many mountains in this area that shone with a majestic light.
This particular mountain was an abode reserved for a Grand Genesis Elder and the forces placed under him!
Around the peak of this mountain, stellar liquified streams of essence surged as snaking rivers of reality could be seen beautifully rising and falling every now and then.
It was a mystical and wondrous abode as towards the center of the mountain peak, above the floor made of rivers of reality, two powerful Supreme Divine Entities could be seen sitting.

Between them, a stellar board holding rounded white and black pieces could be seen as they seemed to be playing a game, and yet one could sense the authority of multiple Extreme Power coursing around every piece on the board as just moving one required the opposing being to lose in a contest of authority!

chapters.title: Chapter 2498 Winds of Change! II
paragraphs: 2498 Winds of Change! II
Ophyr stared at his friend in surprise as he voiced out with sharp eyes!

"Oh? He's both dominating Scions in the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification and participating in fights with Apex Aeonic Lifeforms? What type of Mutated Entity is he? Any of the Seven Clans or Inheritances whose Scions he hasn't butchered would be interested in him."
Ophyr asked with intrigue as he moved a black piece with power and ferocity.

"He's apparently denied an invitation from the Scion of the Sima Clan already. But word is spreading about him after he received no punishment for killing a few hundred Scions, and now this Apex War that He's apparently participating in when he's not even an Apex Aeonic Lifeform...it's enough to rouse a few eyes as there are those who may not want such a talent to die. Especially with the intelligence that his power is due to him attaining an Absolute Seed of Extremity. Do you really think the Adjudicator of that Haven would allow such a being to die? Some Genesis Elders believe he was treated with favor by the Adjudicator, and that's why he faced no punishment after his actions!"
The white robe on Grand Genesis Elder Demetrius fluttered as his eyes showed a sharp and dangerous smile!

"A holder of an Absolute Seed of Extremity who is not even an Apex Aeonic Lifeform appearing in the Youngest and Last Haven to undergo Extremity Sanctification...he could be yet another sign of how many anomalies are about to rise from this event. You are planning on fighting for the boons there when the Culmination Step begins, yes?"
The Culmination Step!
The time when Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could join in as it would have much more interest and grandeur since tools to aid beings in achieving Extremity would be unfolding!
Demetrius nodded while waving his hands and continuing the game.

"Why of course. It should have been the calm before the storm in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution before the Culmination Step began, but this Apex War will draw in a few more eyes- especially on the fate of the holder of the Absolute Seed of Extremity. It seems the Cult of Endless Shadows is apparently backing them, but our contacts in the Haven of Penumbra haven't heard anything. When Meiying joins the fight in support of the aboriginal Noblesse...she's already been told to take the holder of the Absolute Seed of Extremity alive. Let's see, what was his name...ah, Osmont. Before the Scions of Inheritances, he has called himself the True Emperor of Quintessence!"
WAA!
The accounts of Scions spread.
The events that led up to the Initiation of the Apex War of Annihilation were shared!
From person to person, word would spread as gradually, more and more eyes would be drawn over to a certain Haven.
Ophyr listened to his friend before him calmly as he gazed out from the mountain peak they were on, his eyes filled with churning Dynamis of Extremity as he spoke in a deep voice.

"Quintessence...it is a unique concept. One that I haven't heard anyone attaining Hyperversal Extremity in, or a variation of it. It may just be another dead path that is never able to glance upon Extremity..."
Dead Paths!
Concepts too grand and simply too difficult to take towards the 18th Boundary Layer as throughout history, they were never able to attain Extremity!
One had to truly stand by the definition of their concepts as if there was even a shred of dissonance and disconnect, it would never attain the Extremity Boundary Layer.
No matter how many treasures one devoured.
No matter how many other Boundaries one sacrificed.
"Dead Paths...huh." Demetrius smiled at these two words as he placed his hands on his chest, feeling the concepts surging through him as a golden light covered his eyes.

"On my own path, I've still been stuck on the 16th Boundary Layer this whole time. But I can feel the winds of change being ushered by the last Extremity Sanctification. I'm not the only one as I know all Apex Aeonic Lifeforms in other Havens feel it too. Our chances of advancement and attaining Hyperversal Extremity Authority...may just lie in the Extremity Sanctification of Dissolution!"
WAA!
The mountain was suffused with brilliance as a calmness descended against the two beings.
They stared at the board they played on when suddenly, Ophyr spoke with a pondering frown.
"We could also bear the weight of an Obsidian or Crimson Haven Albatross and enter the Cracks of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority. A few prominent beings have attained Extremity in this manner."
"Hmph." Demetrius sneered at these words as he shook his head.

"For every single one that survived and attained Extremity, hundreds more died. Unless you have attained 'that' and you can at least survive in those regions, it is simply a death wish. Especially if you come across any of...
them."

A conversation that revealed many truths continued on the peak of a mountain, two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms going back and forth as ever so slowly, word spread to those involved or connected in any way to a certain being's actions.
Whispers of a small war in a far-off land.
Whispers of an existence who massacred hundreds of Scions freely.
Whispers of a being who attained an Absolute Seed of Extremity before Apexification!
SHIING!
Emerald brilliance shone as Vitalistic coursed endlessly within the Prana Aletheian Haven.
It blared out with more ferocity right now as the last being to undergo configuration was stabilizing their Realm, its authority seeming much more real as its Convergence rose greatly!

The remaining Vassals who also received Reconstruction and Configuration were rotating like stellar bodies around the True Emperor of Quintessence as he stared at the last round of prompts that arose from his actions.
[The Convergence of the Aletheian Dynamis of Extremity has increased to 91%]
[The Convergence of the Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity has increased to 83%]
The closer it was towards full Convergence, the harder the percentage was to raise.
But Noah had no doubt done the impossible to raise his rate of Convergence as quickly as he did, his eyes releasing torrents of light at this moment as he clenched his fist!
WAA!
The vibrant tendrils of his Dynamis of Extremity and other authorities receded into his body as the surroundings calmed.

The essence of Prana slowly became the dominant one once more as verdant dews filled with life began to coagulate around the bodies of his Vassals that stopped rotating around him and slowly began to open their eyes.

It was a glorious scene as Adelaide, The Longest Dream, Morgana, and others who weren't affected by Euryale's attacks and were watching Noah's actions in the past hour let out sighs of relief as they went forward to check how everyone was!
Sandy gold light shone as Eowyn's father appeared before her, his golden eyes lively as he let out a sigh while holding her close.

The blue haired figure of Adelaide with overpowering beauty and grace floated towards Noah and grasped his hand tightly, gazing deeply into his eyes as if she was trying to look for something...and she nodded soon after with a smile as if she found it!

Thereafter, one face after another began to turn towards Noah's visage as he seemed to shine as bright as a rising sun, Noah looking at the people he came across these past 2 years and how they all stood before him now.
With eyes shimmering with royalty and majesty, his voice began to resound in the surroundings.
"An oversight caused a brief storm of chaos and uncertainty...and it must be rectified right now before we can move forward."
"Your clones are meant to be your backup plans as you venture out into risky lands...and I will make sure they remain that way."
His left hand rose as an green glow shone brightly.
It was the glow of [Existence Dissociation]!
