chapters.title: Chapter 2499 Dissociation! I
paragraphs: 2499 Dissociation! I

[Existence Dissociation]:: One is only ever a singular Existence. Those capable can split their Existence into multiple parts that move autonomously, whether in the form of clones or reified versions of the concepts that make them. But ultimately, all these parts are still contained and inextricably linked to their singular Existence. The feature of Existence Dissociation utilizes the authority of the Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity to absolutely separate and dissociate your Existence into different parts, producing a single Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity. Such a clone is considered singular and not part of your Original Existence even though it shares the same consciousness soul. The Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity is duplicated from your current realm as it can cultivate thereafter by itself and ponder on your Concepts of Extremity, even being capable of ascending into an advanced form of life by itself as it will not affect the Main Existence...

[...Only when it is recalled back to rejoin the Main Existence will the gains it has made be assimilated. The Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity goes further to make the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity filled with the impulse of life, where even if it faces True Death, the Clone leaves behind a Vitalistic Seed of Rebirth that burns and blooms to reform the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity once in its lifetime. If the Clone faces True Death a second time, only then will it be entirely extinguished along with the part of your Existence that made it, any comprehensions, and any advancements. When you cast this feature with yourself as the target, your Quintessential Hyperversal Mana will pay for the entire cost of making your Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity. If it is cast with another existence as the target, the resources required will vary depending on the level of Existence targeted. Any being below the stage of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform will require 5% of your current Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values, while an Apex Aeonic Lifeform target will require 80% of your current Soul Values. A Vitalistic Clone of Extremity cannot call forth any additional clones or reified versions of itself or its concepts, with its life burning brightly, only advancing forward and waiting for the time it is recalled to the Main Existence...]
The dazzling feature showed itself before Noah's eyes as it was truly one of utter regality.
One of utter incredulity!

He could cast it on any beings below Apex Aeonic Lifeform for the cost of 5% of his maximum Soul Values, but of course, his Quintessential Hyperversal Mana would pay for 95% of this as Noah only had to pay .25% of his Maximum Soul Values.
Something utterly negligible when one looked at how in 5 minutes, he fully regenerated all of his Soul Values!

In 30 seconds, he regenerated 10% of his maximum Soul Values as by the time the surging waves of authority formed a new Vitalistic Clone of Extremity from his target, his Soul Values would be unchanged as if he hadn't even done anything.

He could ridiculously also set his targets to be Apex Aeonic Lifeforms for this ability as since the cost was 80% of his soul values, it actually meant he had to pay 4% after the ridiculous authority of his Quintessential Hyperversal Mana kicked in, and even this 4%...was utterly negligible to him as he could regain it in less than 15 seconds!
It was a wonder of majesty.
It was overpowered at its finest!
When Noah thought of the calculations of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, his gaze rose to stare at the figures of Aurelia and others in the far distance as he waved his hands.
The Prana Aletheian Haven around them began to churn as this region changed in geography, verdant floating land masses forming below them as above, stellar verdant Cosmos rotated serenely.
Noah's voice rang out at this time.
"I'll make a demonstration and present myself for those who do not know me, so gather around."
WAA!

He spoke in such a manner towards Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and those below them as the forms of Aurelia, Orion, and other Apex Aeonic Lernaeans had their eyes flash as they floated towards the expansive Prana Aletheian Haven that was far vaster than any Major Plane of Existence, going towards its very center where Noah and his closest people were located!

Caesar took Xiaomi's hands as they also came forward, with a few thousand pertinent Lernaeans under Maximilian also coming towards the periphery so that they could glimpse at the brilliance to unfold.

Noah was at the very center as Adelaide was beside him checking Henry's body with a sharp gaze, this mother seeing her Son who had nearly become a fully soul based lifeform as his body seemed physical in one moment and illusory in the next.

Barbatos, Eowyn, Kazuhiko, the Emperor Penguin, Blue Slime, Tiamat, and others were on the recently formed verdant landmasses a little bit further away as the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms came to stand on other verdant islands a little bit further away.
When all of them arrived, Noah's voice continued calmly.

"We are in our current reality because an Apex Aeonic Noblesse struck against the clones of my people here...her hit ultimately crossing space and time to appear before their main bodies as they nearly perished."

"Of course, that Apex Aeonic Noblesse has now died under my hands for her indiscretion, and this caused the emergence of the Apex War of Annihilation against Noblesse that shall begin in three days. Everyone here who almost perished from the actions of the Apex Aeonic Noblesse ...I reforged their Aspects of Existence while reconstructing their Realm until each of them attained...an Extremity Foundation."
WAA!
His words caused Caesar and Xiaomi to open their eyes wide while those apart from Aurelia and Orion had their mouths gaping in disbelief!
An Extremity Foundation!
This was something none of them held as they knew it came from extremely unique beings or those who had devoured treasures like the Extremity Panacea.
Yet this being...could grant others an Extremity Foundation at will?

"And now, I'll be fixing what made it possible for an Apex Aeonic Lifeform to kill the main bodies of my people through their clones. By using the authority of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, I shall make a replica that lives freely by itself as its own existence- one whose destiny would never have any effect on the main body! A clone just as powerful as the main body as in the event it ever faces real demise from even a Hyperversal Extremity, it can never have its True Source traced and destroyed as well!"
WAA!
Shocking words left his mouth as sharp lights of disbelief crossed all Apex Aeonic Lifeforms here.
As for his people, they didn't bat an eye at his absurd words as they took it as gospel!

Something utterly negligible when one looked at how in 5 minutes, he fully regenerated all of his Soul Values!

In 30 seconds, he regenerated 10% of his maximum Soul Values as by the time the surging waves of authority formed a new Vitalistic Clone of Extremity from his target, his Soul Values would be unchanged as if he hadn't even done anything.

He could ridiculously also set his targets to be Apex Aeonic Lifeforms for this ability as since the cost was 80% of his soul values, it actually meant he had to pay 4% after the ridiculous authority of his Quintessential Hyperversal Mana kicked in, and even this 4%...was utterly negligible to him as he could regain it in less than 15 seconds!
It was a wonder of majesty.
It was overpowered at its finest!
When Noah thought of the calculations of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, his gaze rose to stare at the figures of Aurelia and others in the far distance as he waved his hands.
The Prana Aletheian Haven around them began to churn as this region changed in geography, verdant floating land masses forming below them as above, stellar verdant Cosmos rotated serenely.
Noah's voice rang out at this time.
"I'll make a demonstration and present myself for those who do not know me, so gather around."
WAA!

He spoke in such a manner towards Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and those below them as the forms of Aurelia, Orion, and other Apex Aeonic Lernaeans had their eyes flash as they floated towards the expansive Prana Aletheian Haven that was far vaster than any Major Plane of Existence, going towards its very center where Noah and his closest people were located!

Caesar took Xiaomi's hands as they also came forward, with a few thousand pertinent Lernaeans under Maximilian also coming towards the periphery so that they could glimpse at the brilliance to unfold.

Noah was at the very center as Adelaide was beside him checking Henry's body with a sharp gaze, this mother seeing her Son who had nearly become a fully soul based lifeform as his body seemed physical in one moment and illusory in the next.

Barbatos, Eowyn, Kazuhiko, the Emperor Penguin, Blue Slime, Tiamat, and others were on the recently formed verdant landmasses a little bit further away as the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms came to stand on other verdant islands a little bit further away.
When all of them arrived, Noah's voice continued calmly.

"We are in our current reality because an Apex Aeonic Noblesse struck against the clones of my people here...her hit ultimately crossing space and time to appear before their main bodies as they nearly perished."
"Of course, that Apex Aeonic Noblesse has now died under my hands for her indiscretion, and this caused the emergence of the Apex War of Annihilation against Noblesse that shall begin in three days.

Everyone here who almost perished from the actions of the Apex Aeonic Noblesse ...I reforged their Aspects of Existence while reconstructing their Realm until each of them attained...an Extremity Foundation."
WAA!
His words caused Caesar and Xiaomi to open their eyes wide while those apart from Aurelia and Orion had their mouths gaping in disbelief!
An Extremity Foundation!
This was something none of them held as they knew it came from extremely unique beings or those who had devoured treasures like the Extremity Panacea.
Yet this being...could grant others an Extremity Foundation at will?
"And now, I'll be fixing what made it possible for an Apex Aeonic Lifeform to kill the main bodies of my people through their clones.
By using the authority of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, I shall make a replica that lives freely by itself as its own existence- one whose destiny would never have any effect on the main body!
A clone just as powerful as the main body as in the event it ever faces real demise from even a Hyperversal Extremity, it can never have its True Source traced and destroyed as well!"
WAA!
Shocking words left his mouth as sharp lights of disbelief crossed all Apex Aeonic Lifeforms here.
As for his people, they didn't bat an eye at his absurd words as they took it as gospel!

chapters.title: Chapter 2500 Dissociation! II
paragraphs: 2500 Dissociation! II
From their ranks, one being rose up as its sleek black fur radiated grandeur in the surroundings.
It came to float in front of the visage of the True Emperor of Quintessence as it spoke with reverence!
"Master, grant me the honor to be the first to experience and show off a hint of your majesty."
The Emperor Penguin bent its sleek head, golden beak, and flippers as Noah smiled with a nod.
The first one to experience Realm Reconstruction as it currently held the Nine Natures Extremity Foundation.
It would be the first to undergo Existence Dissociation as while gazing at the Emperor Penguin, Noah's finger tapped out.
HOONG!
Essence seethed and surged as emerald light bloomed.
The Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity filled the environment as those nearby felt their Boundaries tremble with happiness at only being near such a pristine authority!
And on the body of the Emperor Penguin...
"OOOH!"

A grand bellow released from it as a blinding emerald singularity bloomed and was then subsequently pulled out from its body, its bright luster momentarily fading as beside it, the emerald light formed into nothing else other than...the Vitalistic Seed of Rebirth.

A seed that released blinding radiance as it began to burn and released gorgeous emerald flames- flames that sought more qi and Vitality as this was where Noah's input of Soul and Mana Values came in.

And from him, essence flowed out freely as the burning Vitalistic Seed of Rebirth congealed to form an outline of the Emperor Penguin- his Aspects of Existence, Realm, foundation, and everything else about him being replicated in an extremely short period of time!
THUMP!
A symphony of grandeur rang out in the background as Xiaomi and a few others raised their heads around, wondering why the hell qi was causing sequences of symphonies to play out.

Yet before them, the sleek black-furred body of an Emperor Penguin formed, verdant streaks of fur painting over its body like an ancient vital tattoo as its golden beak had majestic emerald lines etched on it.
Its pupils emanated pure emerald light as it roared out, everything about it being exactly the same as the Original as the first Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity was born!
Just like the original, this body of the Emperor Penguin bowed to Noah as he nodded while speaking out.

"This second body is entirely dissociated from the Original one as it can be treated as an Experimental Body, being capable of cultivating and pondering on concepts of Extremity by itself as only when the Main Existence recalls it will its advancement and benefits be assimilated. With such a body, one can do many things..."
As he spoke, Noah focused on the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity of the Emperor Penguin as he asked a question that caused mouths to gape open in shock.
"Do you wish to be the first to undergo Apexification?"
He asked such a dreadfully ridiculous question as many mouths flung open and nearly dropped to the verdant floor!
Others proceeded with Apexification when they had built their Foundation and could not gain any more power in their current stage.
When they had confidence that their Foundation and Boundaries had prepared them enough.

When they swallowed an Extremity Panacea and attained an Extremity Foundation, their bodies would condense Meridians that affirmed their Foundation as the more Extremity Meridians there were, the stronger one was in their Foundation!
This was the progression for others.
Noah...he was still growing rapidly as there was no ceiling as he knew...there was still much he could do before undergoing Apexification.
It meant that when the time came for him to actually take this step, it would outstrip any beings who had undergone Apexification before!
He held 81 Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds.

Each one would bloom into a Meridian during Apexification as he needed to make sure each of these seeds held a Boundary that could be taken to the 10th Boundary Layer at the time of his Apexification.

He needed to increase his total number of Boundaries to 81 before anything could be done as he couldn't waste an easy pathway of taking Boundaries to the 10th Layer while also enacting a foundation nobody else had done before!
It meant that apart from Wrath in the Seven Deadly Sins, there other concepts would be getting elevated towards Extremity next.
It meant that other concepts that defined him in the past and a few new ones would be added to his roster!

As Noah gazed towards the Clone of the Emperor Penguin and put on this grand show that would express a glimpse of just what would be happening in the coming Apex War, his Soul was already sending multiple commands.
'Elevate Pride towards Extremity...and Gluttony, Devouring, Lust, Envy, and Sloth."
Deep within him, his Soul burned brightly as the remaining concepts of the Seven Deadly Sins were expanded to have Boundary Layers.
This wasn't all as to reach the 81 Boundaries number, Noah continued!
'Expand Commandment towards Extremity...along with Antediluvian, Cthulhu, Summoning, Runes, Smithing...'
Within him where nobody could see, a great deal of changes occurred as over a dozen concepts were expanded towards Extremity, many more to follow until Noah hit the number 81!
And at this time, the verdant gold beak of the Vitalistic Clone of Extremity bowed even further down as the Emperor Penguin replied with valor.
"May Master please grace me with this opportunity as well."
WAA!
The clone had the same fealty as the original as Noah began to release a pulse of his Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Value and Mana towards the Origin of this being that he forged himself!
An Origin that gave way to the Nine Natures Extremity Foundation forged from the 9 Natural Laws that stated the following prompt when it was first forged.

[...When all of the 9 Natures correlating to its Origin reach the 9th Boundary Layer and the 9 Planes of Nature reach complete saturation, the First Spiritual Beast can undergo Apexification with a 100% chance of rising to become an Apex Aeonic Lifeform with a Nine Natures Meridian Apex Aeonic Foundation...]
He used his qi to Reconstruct the realm of this being before him as an input of more of his essence could bring its 9 Planes of Nature within its Origin towards saturation.
The condition of the 9 Natural Laws achieving the 9th Boundary Layer was even easier!

It would directly meet all the prerequisites to birth an Apex Aeonic Lifeform with a 100% certainty, even though the soul of the Emperor Penguin and its Foundation could have spent a longer period of time making itself even more perfect before proceeding towards this step!
But...this was why the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity was here.
To do things the Main Body may not want to do yet.
As Noah was about to take an utterly magisterial action, his voice echoed once more.
"What I'm about to do is meant to show all those who were beginning to cower that in the Apex War to come, your presence will not even be required."
The faces of some Apex Aeonic Lernaeans changed and became dark as Noah continued.

"In the days and weeks to come, I will produce Apex Aeonic Lifeforms in my ranks that far exceed any of you, or any common Apex Aeonic Lifeforms. Those who wish to be a part of this grandeur can either bend the knee and follow ...or seek their opportunities elsewhere."
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 2501 Merely Forging An Apex Aeonic Lifeform! I
paragraphs: 2501 Merely Forging an Apex Aeonic Lifeform! I
His words were utterly ruthless towards the Apex Aeonic Lernaeans as he let them know that their presence here...was something that wasn't entirely required!

But if they did wish to embark on a glorious path unlike any other, they had to bend the knee towards an existence that had yet to undergo Apexification, and yet he claimed he could produce as many Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as he wished!
Aurelia and Orion were silent.

They had already seen too many things from this being as they wouldn't be quick to dismiss his words, but the moment they took them seriously...the sheer gravity and possibilities if he could actually do what he said he could...it was mind blowing to even speculate!

But the True Emperor of Quintessence didn't speculate or speak nonsense as the moment after he spoke, his authority surged from his body and entered the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity before him.
His pristine Quintessential Hyperversal Soul and Mana Values that held traces of Indefatigable, Aletheian, and Vitalistic authorities!
They flowed into the Nine Natures Extremity Foundation- the Nine Planes of the Clone of the Emperor Penguin as within them, tens of billions of Cosmos proliferated every second.
They expanded and became reinforced by his pristine essence as they grew ever larger, the existence that the clone of the Emperor Penguin released beginning to exceed the original!
And to top all of this, multiple streams of Sources of Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity flowed from Noah and entered the soul of the Vitalistic Clone.
Loot that would take his 9 Boundaries of Nature to the 9th Boundary Layer!

And in addition to this, Noah also sent the expanded concept of Pride into the Emperor Penguin for it to be brought to the 9th Boundary Layer- this being a concept that this existence had defined itself with all this time!
It would be up to him to decide where this would be the concept that defined him.
This would get all the necessary conditions to match as the process of making an Apex Aeonic Lifeform was not an easy one.
What Noah was doing now...was something similar to what Hyperversal Extremities of Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity and those from the Seven Clans did for their most prized Scions!

They would allow their Hyperversal Extremity Authority to flow into their bodies and refine their Aspects of Existence after the Scions had their Foundation pushed to the extremes, and they would aid them in their Apex Transformation as it was the safest way to do so.

What Noah was doing...was building the foundation and boundaries of the Emperor Penguin along with inputting his authority as it was through his means of Realm Restructuring that the Nine Natures Extremity Foundation which guaranteed a successful Apexification was born!
He did everything.
THUMP!

The Origin within the Emperor Penguin thumped like a beating heart as it enlarged and grew more radiant by the second, swallowing all of Noah's authority and going towards Full Capacity as on top of Noah...even the very surroundings had streams of Gravitation, Polarity, Weak Nuclear Force...
streams of the Nine Natural Laws flowed from the very Infinite Hyperversal Haven as this process was made all that much faster.
The Nine Natures Extremity Foundation became all that much more exemplary until...
SHIING!
Like a dazzling emerald sun, the body of the Vitalistic Clone of Extremity radiated pure authority.
The surrounding reality buzzed and resonated with it as this...was truly an Extremity Foundation based on the Laws of Nature!
The rulings that kept together Reality itself!
It wasn't something to be scoffed at as prompts rode before Noah's eyes.
[The Nine Planes of Nature within the target have absorbed Quintessential Dominance and reached a level of saturation.]
[The Nine Natural Laws relating to the Nine Planes of Nature within the target have also reached the set requirement.]
[The process of Apex Transformation with 100% success can now take place on the selected target.]
Brilliance shone before Noah as he spoke out with a thunderous voice towards the Aspects of Existence of the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity.
"Advance."
WAA!
Even after he spoke, some still didn't entirely believe him.
Off to a floating verdant island on the side, Caesar watched with a somber gaze while Xiaomi felt her soul buzz when she looked at the ongoing transformations.
She was a once in a trillion years genius even after her affliction as her eyes could see many things others couldn't.

There was one other person beside her who saw many more things compared to even the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms here, his visage being located in the back as he had a radiant white lab coat adorned on his body.
They all watched the grandiosity blooming before them as the clone of the Emperor Penguin bellowed out with a mighty roar!
"RAA!"
A piercing cry that shook the surrounding reality as to the pure incredulity of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, this being truly did start the process of Apexification.
But unlike how it was for all of them when they started it...this existence instantly illuminated with 9 dazzling Extremity Meridians the moment he decided to break through.
The Extremity Meridian was something called forth by one's own Boundaries when they sought a pathway past the 9th Boundary Layer.

The 9th Layer was a huge wall to pass as getting over it necessary the help of a Meridian- and if one's Foundation was great enough, many Meridians would be formed as an existence could successfully survive this process known as Apex Transformation as through it, they would attain another level as a lifeform!

If one's Foundation was weak, the called out Meridians would fracture and their very Aspects of Existence would be at risk of being destroyed- unless they held profound treasures or aid from more powerful existences.
When Caesar broke through, one Extremity Meridian had appeared as his Foundation made it possible for more and more to gradually form until he reached 9!
And yet for this being before them, 9 appeared right away as they seemed to resonate with the 9 Planes of Nature within its Origin!

chapters.title: Chapter 2502 Merely Forging An Apex Aeonic Lifeform! II
paragraphs: 2502 Merely Forging an Apex Aeonic Lifeform! II
It was the finalizing of a foundation in order to take it to an even greater stage.
Taking all of one's accomplishments and culminating them into a single concept through the ushered Extremity Meridians!
THUMP!
The body of the Vitalistic Clone pulsed as after the appearance of 9 Extremity Meridians, another 9 flashed into existence soon after.
They rose like pillars that made his body as their light reflected into the surroundings, preposterous levels of authority blaring out as not too long after...
THUMP!
Another 9 Meridians flashed into existence.
The Apex Aeonic Lifeforms watching this became extremely quiet.
Their eyes felt like they were lying to them as the number of Extremity Meridians they could see had long since exceeded what any of them had managed to forge!
The average number amongst them was 7 as even this figure was pushed higher because Aurelia had forged 18 Extremity Meridians while Orion had formed 15!
Yet this being before them had already forged 27 as by the time they blinked again...
THUMP!
Another resounding boom echoed from his body as yet another 9 Meridians showed themselves.

Utter silence was all that could be heard along with the pulsing of glorious authority, 36 Extremity Meridians swirling within the Emperor Penguin's body as an instant later...its existence began to be drawn into these Meridians.
[36 Nine Natures Extremity Meridians have been forged on the selected target.]
[Awaiting for the target to define their Existence.]
To define oneself.
Almost always, existences had to choose a single concept that suited who they were the most in order to proceed with their Apexification successfully.

If they chose a concept they weren't truly compatible with or didn't truly define them, or if they chose multiple concepts that their Meridians could in no way handle...the fracture of their Meridians and possible death was all that waited for them!
So the Emperor Penguin looked deep into himself, and then made his choice rather quickly as the path was already laid out before him by his Master.
"The Nine Natures shall define me."
WAA!
What his Origin and Foundation were made of.
The Emperor Penguin instinctively felt that his Meridians could handle such a definition- that his Nine Natures Extremity Meridians were made in order for him to define himself in such a manner!
But...he wasn't done as he also sought to define himself with something he had since the day he was born as the First Spiritual Beast.
"Pride."
"Pride shall also define me."
His 36 Meridians spun as a golden light blared forth.
His body began to disappear into glimmers of light that were absorbed into these Meridians.
His forged Origin flickered and was also absorbed into these Meridians!

chapters.title: Chapter 2503 Merely Forging An Apex Aeonic
paragraphs: Lifeform! III
[A Boundary you have expanded is being elevated past the 9th Boundary Layer in the Extremity Meridians of your Vassal!] ...!
The Clone of the Emperor Penguin had defined itself with Pride and the Nine Natural Laws!
Ultimately these were the boundaries being elevated from the 9th and into the 10th Boundary Layer as the Infinite Hyperversal Haven began to buzz with grandeur.
When the Nine Natural Laws went ever closer to Extremity, the Infinite Hyperversal Haven benefitted.

The only issue now was that the existence who bound their sources had them at the 9th Boundary Layer- contained in his Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds that were simply waiting to bloom, but his Vassal was taking them to the next layer right now as his Meridians were fully established!
[An Absolute Nature of Extremity is in conflict!]

[The 10th Layer of Extremity and above require an Extremity Meridian to manifest and be utilized by your Existence freely.] [Yet the authority of 10 Boundaries expanded by you exceeding the 9th Boundary Layer is occurring within your Vassal!]
A conflict on the flow of Extremity!
It occurred in a step by step manner as what was happening currently should not be a possibility.
Thus, a conflict was born as it needed to be corrected!

[The Boundary of Pride has attained the 10th Boundary Layer within your Vassal as even though you cannot grasp and manipulate its advanced authority, your 81 Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds absorb a portion of its authority!]
His body which was already magnificent radiated golden splendor.
His Foundation which held 81 dazzling seeds became even more exuberant as a wondrous light was seen being pulled within it!
[The absorbed authority of a Boundary that has achieved the 10th Layer will empower the 81 Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds.

When a sufficient amount of such authority is collected, there is a high probability that when a Meridian Seed Blooms, the concept contained within it will automatically cross the 10th and reach the 11th Boundary Layer.]
WAA!

As the glorious seeds of his foundation bathed in a unique authority, Noah received a massive potential boon for the future while the body of the Vitalistic Clone of Extremity before him only released a grander air of power!
And as this occurred...

[The Boundary of Gravitation has attained the 10th Boundary Layer within your Vassal as even though you cannot grasp and manipulate its advanced authority, your 81 Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds absorb a portion of its authority...]
[The Boundary of Polarity has attained the 10th Boundary Layer...] 9 more prompts came down after the first one of Pride as Noah drank in all of their power as well.
And towards the very end...

[The Infinite Hyperversal Haven has attained even greater authority due to its Natural Laws getting ever closer to Extremity, but it cannot express the full effect of such authority until the one who has bound their Source grasps this Authority themselves.] The Infinite Hyperversal Haven buzzed with bombastic waves of power as from this event, many sides made gains!

The suffocating might of an unrestrained Apex Aeonic Lifeform blazed out freely from the Emperor Penguin shining with black and gold fur, an emerald color covering his eyes and beak as he made himself known to all.
At such a juncture, Noah's piercing gaze turned towards Aurelia and Orion as he spoke calmly.
"Send one of the Apex Aeonic Lernaeans behind you forward."
"Huh?"
Amidst their shock at this being actually doing what he said he would do, their souls were roused as they gauged the situation before them.
Aurelia and Orion quickly understood the meaning of Noah's words as Orion sighed while voicing out loudly.
"Lucia...step forward."

A dazzling woman adorned in a pink battledress was among the few who would entirely listen to Orion, and her eyes hardened as she heeded his call and floated towards one of the few empty verdant floating islands in this area!
Noah nodded when he saw this as he waved his hands and made his intentions clear to all.
"Take a strike from my Vassal."
Not even fight.
He simply said for this Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who had set up herself for an unknown number of years...to only just see if she could take a strike from his Vassal!
From a being who had freshly finished their Apexification!
"RAA!"

The Emperor Penguin followed the commands of the True Emperor of Quintessence as it appeared above the island Lucia stood on, its right flipper rising up as above it...a blinding golden point of light began to form.
It seemed too grand and glorious in color as even though it was small, it held within it an immense amount of pride!

It began to enlarge as since an Apex Aeonic Lifeform's essence was forming it, it ballooned from a small point into a massive golden sun that entirely encompassed even the verdant landmass Lucia stood on- her gaze changing greatly as pink layers of defensive lights began to manifest around her.
Yet the halcyon sun of pure Pride that the Emperor Penguin had called out above his flipper melted and vaporized the rising defenses Lucia was making before it even began to descend!
It should have burned everything nearby, and yet the Emperor Penguin seemed to have utmost control as the blazing heat of Pride was only focused on the being and region below him.

"Ah..." And Lucia couldn't help but cry out as the defensive layers she was forming burnt faster than she could call them out, her form feeling like it was under the crushing vaporizing heat of a deadly Singularity as before the strike could even come down...
"I yield!"
The words left her mouth before she knew it as her bountiful chest heaved when facing the heat above. Her battle dress had nearly melted as before its pressure, she had nearly sunk to her knees!
The situation caused utter silence to descend as above her, the emerald gaze of the Emperor Penguin flashed gold as the sun instantly disappeared just as rapidly as it had appeared.
At a speed that those who weren't Apex Aeonic Lifeforms couldn't even follow!

chapters.title: Chapter 2504 A Setting Battlefield!
paragraphs: Silence.
The gazes of the Apex Aeonic Lernaeans were ashen as they looked at the scene ahead of them!
Xiaomi's eyes sparkled while beside her, her Father cursed inwardly at such a scene.

Because he very clearly remembered a promise he had made with the Man who had just forged an Apex Aeonic Lifeform that could dominate an established Apex Aeonic Lifeform- much less him who had just advanced!
Shock and incredulity spread all around as Noah's voice resounded out.
"This was a presentation to show some of you that Apex Aeonic Lifeforms even stronger than you can be produced at the wave of my hand."
Silence reigned as all eyes focused on him.
"And I can go much further to even reforge the Origin and Realms of Supreme Eternal Lifeforms."
Words that caused even Aurelia's and Orion's eyes to open wide in shock rang out.
And his gaze was moreso focused on them as he didn't seem to care much for the others!

"Did you advance without an Extremity Foundation? Do you actually wish to have a genuine chance of attaining Extremity? To have an Apex Foundation of Extreme Power that makes a possibility for you to form an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity? It's all possible for a small price!"
WAA!
A small price.
A price of their souls.
A price of fealty!
Brilliance shone as the situation developed into a fantastical path in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Meanwhile, in the area filled with tendrils of Ruin and Nullity where Noah had almost come to a full clash with the Noblesse Lineage.
This same location was determined to be where the Apex War would take place as it would be the Apex Battlefield!

Currently, there was an endless transparent veil that pierced up towards the skies and down towards a razed Crimson and silver earth as if it divided two sides. And it truly did so as above the skies of one side, an illusory blue runic character that read [LERNAEAN] was etched gorgeously as on the other side, an illusory black character that read [NOBLESSE] was carved wondrously.
And on the side shining with the blue light, one could see a cluster of 5 Primeval Shadow Ancients shrouded in darkness as their gazes were cold and somber.

This was because on the other side of the transparent barrier, they could see the figures of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms whom they recognized from their insignias and essence to be from the Genesis Institute of Extremity and Singularity Overseers!
They currently numbered 9 all together as their eyes were just as cold as theirs.

The parties that represented three Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity were all in a single location as before an Apex War began, any faction that wished to join in support of any side had to make it clear and have their forces stationed on the chosen side of the Apex Battlefield.

The 5 Primeval Shadow Ancients floated on the side of Lerneans as they had received much more information about the being that Grand Primeval Silas had made an unknown deal with- this buzz even reaching their Cult of Endless Shadows as their close allies had reached out to them to discern their relationship with the Scion that had forged an Ultimate Power of Extremity and massacred hundreds of other Scions in the ongoing Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification of Dissolution!

And in the last few minutes, they had received a command through their shared communication channel as it didn't even come from Grand Primeval Silas- it stemmed from a Hyperversal Extremity of their Cult of Endless Shadows.
The command was singular in nature.

[Stand by the side of the Lernaeans and wait for the time when the Adjudicator moves to save his life. After the dust has settled, we will have a Scion who attained an Absolute Seed of Extremity before even undergoing Apexification in our Cult. This will further cement our rise as an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity!]

A command that revealed many beings had the mindset that the one who called himself the True Emperor of Quintessence- a being who had forged an Ultimate Power of Extremity even before Apexification...most beings believed he wouldn't perish in this Apex War even if he wanted to!
He was a critical tool that if he really died under the watch of the current Adjudicator, it would bring their capabilities to question!
Existences who had become Supreme Eternal Lifeforms were the ones who delved and combined multiple Boundaries to forge Dynamis of Extremity.
Only the most powerful ones who had achieved the 16th and 17th Boundary Layers were lucky and powerful enough to forge Absolute Seeds of Extremity- and this number was low even amongst such beings!
It required someone truly special.
It was commonly Mutated Entities or existences with unheard of Extremity Foundations that rose across the Extremity
Sanctifications of the other 6 Havens.
And any such existences were protected in powerful Inheritances or part of the Seven Clans as they were guaranteed future Hyperversal Extremities!
Now, you have a being who managed to condense his Boundaries that hadn't even reached the 10th Layer, and converge nine of them or even more to produce an Absolute Seed of Extremity?
As far the the Primeval Shadow Ancients knew, such a thing wasn't Recorded in any history that could be verified!
Maybe rumors.
Maybe Whispers across the eons.
But never verified as it was for the being who had one of his bodies accompanied by Grand Primeval Silas as they went towards their Cult of Endless Shadows even now!
"He seems difficult to handle though...will everything unfold smoothly as expected?"
One of the Primeval Shadow Ancients remembered how the True Emperor of Quintessence had proclaimed himself when he came back with Silas and took the reins of the Lernaean Lineage.
Beside him, a woman shrouded in darkness replied with a sharp gaze.

"It doesn't matter. We are the only Inheritance he is thus far connected to, with our Shadowlings reporting that he even denied an Invitation from the Sima Clan! Now...we're no Sima Clan, so the prestige of having a Scion that even such a pristine behemoth would accept...Mmm, we shall see how it all unfolds."

Expectations were high as an Apex Battlefield was beginning to be filled with its combatants, unknown forces with their own thoughts moving behind the scenes as each person sought for their own ideal future!

Now, you have a being who managed to condense his Boundaries that hadn't even reached the 10th Layer, and converge nine of them or even more to produce an Absolute Seed of Extremity?
As far the the Primeval Shadow Ancients knew, such a thing wasn't Recorded in any history that could be verified!
Maybe rumors.
Maybe Whispers across the eons.
But never verified as it was for the being who had one of his bodies accompanied by Grand Primeval Silas as they went towards their Cult of Endless Shadows even now!
"He seems difficult to handle though...will everything unfold smoothly as expected?"
One of the Primeval Shadow Ancients remembered how the True Emperor of Quintessence had proclaimed himself when he came back with Silas and took the reins of the Lernaean Lineage.
Beside him, a woman shrouded in darkness replied with a sharp gaze.
"It doesn't matter.
We are the only Inheritance he is thus far connected to, with our Shadowlings reporting that he even denied an Invitation from the Sima Clan!
Now...we're no Sima Clan, so the prestige of having a Scion that even such a pristine behemoth would accept...Mmm, we shall see how it all unfolds."

Expectations were high as an Apex Battlefield was beginning to be filled with its combatants, unknown forces with their own thoughts moving behind the scenes as each person sought for their own ideal future!

chapters.title: Chapter 2505 Alexander King! I
paragraphs: Between the endless cracks of Havens.

Thick and heavy authority pressed all space in different directions as the grandeur of two Dynamis of Extremity wrapped around 2 beings, the leading one coming to a stop at this time as he turned around and stared at the one behind him.
"You've exceeded all my expectations."
Silas voiced out with sharp eyes as he stared at Noah's visage.

"So much so that you've caused a buzz when news of all that you had done circulated to us. Yet...I truly cannot understand some of your choices. An Apex War of Annihilation? Did you agree to it purely because of the belief that the Adjudicator of Dissolution would not let someone like you die?"
Silas felt many emotions when he stared at this being before him as all the accomplishments that were spreading about him so far were unsettling!
Especially when he had an Oath of Extremity with this being that he was now scrutinizing and beginning to ponder much more deeply on.
But some of the things he did like agreeing to an Apex War of Annihilation...it confused the minds of others!
And towards such a question, Noah stared calmly at Grand Primeval Elder Silas as the shadowy strands of hair of this being seemed to age just a few more years.
"I never enter battles that I cannot survive and win."
His eyes showed his confidence and conviction as he continued.
"Whether it be an Apex War of Annihilation or an Oath of Extremity against a Grand Elder of an Inheritance."
WAA!
Explosive words that pulled at Silas's mind rang out.
He stared at this being for a few seconds silently before he sighed, his authority of a Dynamis of Extremity erupting out as he began to move once more- albeit much slower this time around.
Noah raised his brows at this as before he could even ask, Silas's voice rang out.

"A Hyperversal Shadow Extremity will be coming to fetch us so that our journey may be even faster. We cannot stray too far from our current coordinates or run the risk of coming across any unsavory Entities when it has been realized your value is much different than anticipated."
To cross the indomitable walls of the Aeonic Havens of Extremity and into the Haven of Penumbra, it would have taken an Apex Aeonic Lifeform like Silas a few days!
Yet as the news of Noah spread to the Cult of Endless Shadows, an Esteemed Hyperversal Extremity was coming to fetch them as a level of importance was placed on the True Emperor of
Quintessence!
In a region above many of the grand locations in the Haven of Dissolution.
Transparent layers of clouds filled with potent Hyperversal Extremity Authority- much more than normal as the whole region seemed to be suffocating with such an authority at this moment!
At its core, the authority stemmed from the Adjudicator of Dissolution as the visage of the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction was nowhere to be seen!
Her lone grand figure stared towards the clone Noah had made which stood before her as she voiced out coldly.
"The small forces of two Aeonic Inheritances stand against you with the Noblesse while you have the backing of a lesser Inheritance.
This...is all part of your grand plan? A being as astute as you who forged an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity cannot be stupid, so I'm curious to hear why you chose this destructive path."
The veiled figure of Svetlana gazed towards Noah with cold eyes that seemed to be weighing him and whether she should be leaning towards disappointment!
Yet his gaze was calm.
Even while faced with the scrutiny of a Hyperversal Extremity, Noah's soul remained free as he replied while walking forward.
"Part of the reason why I gained access to Vacuous Hyperversal Authority and forged an Absolute Seed of Extremity is because of my nature."
"When enemies throw themselves at my feet, I grind them down and devour their power and years of cultivation to make it mine.
This Apex War...it will merely be a feeding ground for my
advancement towards Extremity!"
BOOM!
His words were filled with utmost surety.

The Adjudicator of Dissolution had her eyes became extremely sharp halfway through Noah's words as after staring at him intently for a few seconds, she spoke with a voice of gorgeous calmness and Extremity.
"Listening to you just now...you sound eerily similar to 'them'!"
Them!
Noah's own eyes became sharp as he questioned succinctly.
"Them?"
"The Vacuous Malignancies that butcher and devour Hyperversal Extremities." The voice of the Adjudicator of Dissolution was utterly cold as she spoke out while turning to gaze above into the unknown.
"The Vacuous Daimonikos who live outside of reality and time!"
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Noah's eyes were bright as he handled both conversing with multiple powerful beings in the Aeonic Havens of Extremity and his actions within his domain.
From the Adjudicator of Dissolution, he just heard a rumble of information about the unknown enemies who thrived outside of reality and time!
Vacuous Malignancies.
Vacous Daimonikos!

There were mere names and titles to Noah at this moment, with his clone in the Haven of Dissolution staying close to the Adjudicator to continue benefitting from her pure aura of Hyperversal Extremity Authority as his Will in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...it would focus on the many things that had to be done here!

His main body had just finished letting the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms here that he was capable of even altering their Realms- something none of them would have even thought to be possible as even they could gain an Extremity Foundation!
Even they had a chance to be reborn.
As their minds rattled from his words, Noah continued on doing what he had to as after seeing the impacts of the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity that was cast on the Emperor Penguin...
SHIING!
An emerald light began to shine with splendor as Noah tapped his own head and silently cast [Existence Dissociation]!

had reached the stage of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform...to the eyes of all others, he was simply an Apex Aeonic Lifeform with multiple bodies as he now had some of them utterly sweeping the stage where no beings like him should be!
The Adjudicator of Dissolution would pluck his Reified Sources away faster than he could even blink as due to this and Noah's own workings, he felt the need to call out one of his lost identities.
An identity that had fused with him what seemed like forever ago!
A blinding emerald light took a portion of himself as Noah watched it leave his body, his eyes as bright as ever as he called out silently.
'Come out once more...Alexander King.'
WAA!
The blinding point of emerald singularity shone as a storm of authority and essence far larger than what had occurred with the Emperor Penguin unfolded.
After all, it was Noah's Foundation that had to be replicated and reforged into this Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity!
Noah's Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation.
His Origin, body, and his Soul!
All of it...would be supplied by his Quintessential Hyperversal Mana as it wouldn't be of any cost to him.
As this storm of authority began and the emerald point of Singularity sucked everything in, Noah's Main Body pulsed once more as from it, 7 Aletheian Chassis came out.
There was much for him to do.
And Soul nor Mana Values were an issue!
While his Vitalistic Clone formed, his task for the days to come was to completely reform his forces into utterly powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.

He gained immense benefits just from the Emperor Penguin becoming one, with the authority of its Boundaries achieving the 10th Layer also being given to him as his 81 Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds devoured this authority to make it so that when a sufficient amount was gathered...Noah's Boundaries may add both the 10th and 11th Boundary Layers during the Apexification of his Main Body!
If he continued to turn more beings into Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, or even better yet- reforge the Realms of beings like Aurelia who no doubt had Layers at the very least exceeding 11...
The idea alone caused Noah's eyes to shine like Infinite suns as he began to move.
HOONG!
His hands motioned outwards multiple times as the environment began to change once more.
Space and time seemed to be twisting and distorting as circular domains were seemingly being carved out based on Noah's

chapters.title: Chapter 2506 Alexander King! II
paragraphs: Noah called forth an Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity for himself as it simply had too many boons for him not to, with the pathway he had to take being extremely clear at this moment.

His main body could continue accumulating power and bringing its foundation towards a shocking level, but this didn't mean he couldn't utilize the feature of the Vitalistic Clone to usher forth a version of himself with a potent amount of power.
There were so many positives with it- the only negative being the fact that no more clones or reified sources could emerge from the Vitalistic Clone of Extremity as it moved by itself!
He wouldn't be able to call forth the Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor fused form or any other
Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor form he could take with such a body as it had to rely purely on its base power.

But if he could replicate himself now and make such a clone undergo Apexification...it would be a being with an Unrecorded Extremity Foundation, multiple Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, and Soul Values exceeding even a newly advanced Apex Aeonic
Lifeform!

If the clone of the Emperor Penguin who only had 10 Boundaries reaching the 9th Boundary Layer and an Extremity Foundation Noah called forth himself could have the equivalence of 30 Apex Aeonic Soul Values...Noah's Clone was bound to be in the hundreds after Apexification- if not a ridiculous Value that even Noah himself didn't know of.
But this Clone couldn't be him.
In the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification, only those below the stage of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could participate.
If a few days from now, he displayed another version of him that commands, his Vassals being left in a domain that contained his main body.

The figures of Caesar and Xiaomi found themselves in their own domain as a verdant robed Aletheian Chassis moved towards this domain, while Aurelia and the other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were segmented into their own domains while Noah's voice rang out!
"Everyone can make their own choices without an audience. You will at the very least have your privacy no matter which path you take."
Land and space seemed to pull specific beings apart as Orion did not resist when he saw himself being isolated in his own domain, his eyes shining with a piercing light as he seemed deep in thought.

Aurelia was the same as her space was split to grant her own domain- the emerald light of a Dynamis of Extremity covering hers and all other domains with a thick circular wall filled with life as they were segmented across light years to different parts of the Prana Aletheian Haven!

When the dust settled, Orion found himself standing atop a lush verdant earth with the form of Noah gazing at him calmlyimpenetrable emerald walls erected all around them from afar as even the will of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform could not pierce it without having an equivalent Dynamis of Extremity.
Xiaomi and Caesar found themselves in their own separate domain with one of Noah's bodies, and so did Aurelia!

The only beings to remain in a cluster were the remaining Apex Aeonic Lernaeans as Noah has Lucia and the rest of them in a single domain, his gaze cold as his Quantum Aletheian Chassis voiced out coldly.
"Decide. A restructuring of your Realms and an Extremity Foundation, or a pathway out of here for you to follow your own path."
The eyes of prideful existences who should have been the Ancestors of this being before them shone with hesitation while some...already had their minds made up!
Within the isolated domain holding Aurelia.
"Is your mind really not made up? You are the True Emperor of Fortune, so I know you recognize what lies before you."
His words were much calmer as his form of the Elysium Aletheian Chassis talked to Aurelia who had sat down on the lush verdant grassland around her that pulsed with life.
Her eyes were filled with a hazy gold as she voiced out while moving her hands across the stellar grass around her.
"You are an enigma that every time I think I have you figured out, you prove me wrong yet again."
WAA!

"I've always wanted to live peacefully atop mountains of Loot without a worry in the world, but I am not naive enough to believe that peace comes so easily or freely. There is the very real possibility of me attaining that peace through your ridiculous capabilities, so..."
Her gaze rose up and locked onto Noah who had appeared a few inches away from her while adorned in grand golden robes.
His eyes were filled with a steady light as he nodded and spoke.
"And there's also the fact that I can reforge your Realm to be based on the concepts that made the Infinite Forge you saw in my soul.
An Extremity Foundation purely geared towards Loot as-"
BOOM!
Before his words even finished, the golden form of Aurelia rose up with power and bravery unadulterated majesty emanated from her!
"Say less."
"You had me at Extremity Foundation geared towards Loot."
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 2507 Alexander King! III
paragraphs: Aurelia's eyes twinkled as they shone with an exuberant light of gold, excitement visible within them!

Such a genuine expression of excitement was not something commonly seen on an Apex Aeonic Lifeform who had gone through years of life as it gave her an otherworldly sense of unattainable beauty and wonder.
"An Extremity Foundation based on Loot? That's all you had to say.
Mmm...what about my Boundaries and Dynamis of Extremity?
Layers above 9th cannot exist without Meridians as..."
Even with her giddiness when it came to Loot, her rationality was still there as Noah waved his hands while they began to shine with the lights of Realm Reconstruction and Aspect Configuration.
"Your Concepts and authority as an Apex Aeonic Lifeform will be set aside and utilized during the end of your Reconstruction. Nothing will be lost."
His abilities were ready to unfold.
Aurelia gazed at his hands pulsing with the authority of two different Absolute Dynamis of Extremity as she breathed out as if she prepared herself, shaking her head while voicing out.
"Alright, let's do it. My forge better be at least the same level as yours if not more pristine after all this!"
Aurelia of the Ancestral Lernaeans became the first Apex Aeonic Lifeform to choose which path she followed.
And Noah didn't delay as his authority moved like unstoppable tendrils of light of cherry and emerald lights that caused her golden hair to move wildly.

They sank into her body as this Apex Aeonic Lifeform didn't put up any defenses, allowing the essences of two Dynamis of Extremity to flow into her Aspects of Existence- wrapping around dazzling Extremity Meridians that supported her existences like pillars of supporting light.
They intricately wrapped around her very being as she granted Noah a profound level of access and control to the extent that he could shatter her very existence at this moment!
'How curious the fates of living beings are...'
Noah had such a passing thought as he thought of how just days ago, he was just grasping the 5th and 6th Boundary Layers while stepping into the Aeonic Havens of Extremity.
And now, here he was. He had eradicated two Apex Aeonic
Lifeforms not too long ago, and now he held the very Aspects of Existence of another such lifeform in his hands as...
BZZT...CRACK!
The undeniable authority of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity caused the Extremity Meridians of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform to crack along with the Origin of this being.
It wasn't so much a matter of Damage or Defense Values as it was the authority of [Realm Reconstruction] being carried out on a more powerful willing party!

"Ah..." Aurelia felt her life's work being broken at this moment as it was something any being would despair at, yet there was never even a thought that this was a mistake in her eyes as she watched the authority of the Broken Extremity Meridian that had her Boundaries coursing through them...she saw that even though they were broken down, everything about them was preserved and put aside!
The abundant authority of her lifeforce. Her Apex Aeonic Soul Values that had long since crossed the threshold of 200s. Her Forge in the very depths of her Soul.
Everything that made her was put aside to be utilized for later as her Realm was degraded to the lowest possible point!
Her vision slowly began to fade.
She didn't know how much time had passed, but after a certain point, she could only hear the voice of a single being.
"Fortune shall be at the very basis of your makeup, and your Realm shall be composed of Fortune, Loot, Providence, Genesis, Conquest, Forgemaster, Destiny, Kismet...and Quintessence."
His voice determined the new Planes of her Realm.
Planes that would go on to determine her Extremity Foundation!
When she came to again, she found her body being reforged as her golden eyes saw dazzling golden words appear out of thin air!

[The Master of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven is Reconstructing your Realm and Aspects of Being ever closer to Extremity.] [You have been set on the path of the Quintessential Loot Extremity Foundation.]
The words before her caused her eyes to widen as at this time, she felt the portion of her past self that was put aside begin to return to her.
They felt...foreign and not as pure as her current self.

She almost wanted to tell the being who was doing all this not to return the things from her past self when her will saw that everything returning back was being refined and reconstructed as well, her Realm beginning to rapidly reforge itself as her past accomplishments as an Supreme Aeonic Being were used as one of the many ingredients!
She then...felt the Forge that was locked away in her soul once more.
It seemed like a massive mountain of Loot as at its very core, her greatest treasure pulsed and radiated light at this moment.
Her Riviere of Fortune.

Her utmost treasure that she didn't even pull out on the deadly battle of an enemy more powerful than her and Orion who had chased them towards the Noblesse battlefield as she would only utilize it when she felt like there were no other options!
She felt the relic she had anchored into her Workshop since before she even became the True Emperor of Luck radiate wondrous light as...
[Your greatest creation resonates with the forming Quintessential Loot Extremity Foundation.]
[Your Workshop has begun basking in the light of Quintessential Spoils as it is transforming into a tool worthy of the Quintessential Loot Extremity Foundation!]
Her will lit up with utmost excitement as she felt a sea of golden Spoils light wash over her mountains of Relics, Gems, and Aeonic Treasures of Extremity.

She felt like she was finally on the path of truly understanding Luck and Spoils as her Soul didn't question any of the golden prompts appearing before her, fully delving into her changes and whatever they may bring!

sentences.text: Aurelia's eyes twinkled as they shone with an exuberant light of gold, excitement visible within them!

Such a genuine expression of excitement was not something commonly seen on an Apex Aeonic Lifeform who had gone through years of life as it gave her an otherworldly sense of unattainable beauty and wonder.
"An Extremity Foundation based on Loot?
That's all you had to say.
Mmm...what about my Boundaries and Dynamis of Extremity?
Layers above 9th cannot exist without Meridians as..."
Even with her giddiness when it came to Loot, her rationality was still there as Noah waved his hands while they began to shine with the lights of Realm Reconstruction and Aspect Configuration.
"Your Concepts and authority as an Apex Aeonic Lifeform will be set aside and utilized during the end of your Reconstruction.
Nothing will be lost."
His abilities were ready to unfold.
Aurelia gazed at his hands pulsing with the authority of two different Absolute Dynamis of Extremity as she breathed out as if she prepared herself, shaking her head while voicing out.
"Alright, let's do it.
My forge better be at least the same level as yours if not more pristine after all this!"
Aurelia of the Ancestral Lernaeans became the first Apex Aeonic Lifeform to choose which path she followed.
And Noah didn't delay as his authority moved like unstoppable tendrils of light of cherry and emerald lights that caused her golden hair to move wildly.

They sank into her body as this Apex Aeonic Lifeform didn't put up any defenses, allowing the essences of two Dynamis of Extremity to flow into her Aspects of Existence- wrapping around dazzling Extremity Meridians that supported her existences like pillars of supporting light.
They intricately wrapped around her very being as she granted Noah a profound level of access and control to the extent that he could shatter her very existence at this moment!
'How curious the fates of living beings are...'
Noah had such a passing thought as he thought of how just days ago, he was just grasping the 5th and 6th Boundary Layers while stepping into the Aeonic Havens of Extremity.
And now, here he was.
He had eradicated two Apex Aeonic
Lifeforms not too long ago, and now he held the very Aspects of Existence of another such lifeform in his hands as...
BZZT...CRACK!
The undeniable authority of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity caused the Extremity Meridians of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform to crack along with the Origin of this being.
It wasn't so much a matter of Damage or Defense Values as it was the authority of [Realm Reconstruction] being carried out on a more powerful willing party!

"Ah..." Aurelia felt her life's work being broken at this moment as it was something any being would despair at, yet there was never even a thought that this was a mistake in her eyes as she watched the authority of the Broken Extremity Meridian that had her Boundaries coursing through them...she saw that even though they were broken down, everything about them was preserved and put aside!
The abundant authority of her lifeforce.
Her Apex Aeonic Soul Values that had long since crossed the threshold of 200s.
Her Forge in the very depths of her Soul.
Everything that made her was put aside to be utilized for later as her Realm was degraded to the lowest possible point!
Her vision slowly began to fade.
She didn't know how much time had passed, but after a certain point, she could only hear the voice of a single being.
"Fortune shall be at the very basis of your makeup, and your Realm shall be composed of Fortune, Loot, Providence, Genesis, Conquest, Forgemaster, Destiny, Kismet...and Quintessence."
His voice determined the new Planes of her Realm.
Planes that would go on to determine her Extremity Foundation!
When she came to again, she found her body being reforged as her golden eyes saw dazzling golden words appear out of thin air!

[The Master of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven is Reconstructing your Realm and Aspects of Being ever closer to Extremity.] [You have been set on the path of the Quintessential Loot Extremity Foundation.]
The words before her caused her eyes to widen as at this time, she felt the portion of her past self that was put aside begin to return to her.
They felt...foreign and not as pure as her current self.

She almost wanted to tell the being who was doing all this not to return the things from her past self when her will saw that everything returning back was being refined and reconstructed as well, her Realm beginning to rapidly reforge itself as her past accomplishments as an Supreme Aeonic Being were used as one of the many ingredients!
She then...felt the Forge that was locked away in her soul once more.
It seemed like a massive mountain of Loot as at its very core, her greatest treasure pulsed and radiated light at this moment.
Her Riviere of Fortune.

Her utmost treasure that she didn't even pull out on the deadly battle of an enemy more powerful than her and Orion who had chased them towards the Noblesse battlefield as she would only utilize it when she felt like there were no other options!
She felt the relic she had anchored into her Workshop since before she even became the True Emperor of Luck radiate wondrous light as...
[Your greatest creation resonates with the forming Quintessential Loot Extremity Foundation.]
[Your Workshop has begun basking in the light of Quintessential Spoils as it is transforming into a tool worthy of the Quintessential Loot Extremity Foundation!]
Her will lit up with utmost excitement as she felt a sea of golden Spoils light wash over her mountains of Relics, Gems, and Aeonic Treasures of Extremity.

She felt like she was finally on the path of truly understanding Luck and Spoils as her Soul didn't question any of the golden prompts appearing before her, fully delving into her changes and whatever they may bring!

chapters.title: Chapter 2508 Alexander King! IV
paragraphs: As Aurelia did this, the person responsible for it all monitored everything occurring sharply as the transformation of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform was far faster than that of the Emperor Penguin during his initial Reconstruction.
The leftover essence that was being broken down and refined was so potent that her Realm and Foundation would be built and fully saturated in the coming seconds, and she could undergo

Apexification once more with an Extremity Foundation thereafter as when one put into account her Boundaries that Noah actually found the highest to be Fortune at the 14th Boundary Layer during the Reconstruction...he knew that her Apex Aeonic Soul Values were about to be utterly dreadful after her transformation!
But this was her.
Her choice here was not a singular one as in another enclosed domain, Orion- the True Emperor of Genesis, had made the same choice as her as he would experience a similar transformation.
Many others would undoubtedly become unimaginable versions of themselves, but this was not where Noah directed the attention of his main body.
Back in the domain holding his main body and his closest people, the emerald light shone brightly as another version of Noah had come to fruition.
Dense waves of authority still sank into him every second, but his pristine face was clear to all as it was distinctively different from Noah.
He seemed like an older version of the face of Alexander King in the past- with his face being more pristinely sculpted and carrying rugged devilish handsomeness.
Lush dark hair flowed from his head as streaks of Vitalistic emerald added to grant the total of 81 that would pristinely match with his 81 Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds, the process of
Apexification for Alexander King would begin.
"And at such a time, the breadth of this soul will be much greater as it can handle another Absolute Seed of Extremity or two..."
The deep voice of Alexander thundered out as he breathed in.

The Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi surged within his body as the Indefatigable, Aletheian, and Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity were hidden deep within- other sources of Essences beginning to circulate within his as he began mixing dreadful and deathly authorities!

He was already setting the stage for the birth of yet another Absolute Seed of Extremity after he completed Apexification as this one would contain the Boundaries of Necromancy, Summoning, Apocalypse, Death, Pride, Gluttony, Sloth, Envy, Greed, Lust, and Wrath!
The myriad of authorities began to cycle across his very atoms as a devilish glint began to radiate from him.
"Good!"
Noah nodded at this fantastical sight as his gaze then turned towards the rest of his people.
Towards his son who shone with golden brilliance. Towards Athena, Kazuhiko, Barbatos, and the many others who gazed towards him with a profound light of eagerness.
"The stage of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms is open to all as it is only a matter of who will go after the Emperor Penguin."
Many were excited for it, but none moved forward as they would follow whichever sequence Noah chose to follow!
A fortunate light shone as Noah smiled and looked around, his gaze being taken towards a figure with observant eyes in the back.
Adorned in a stellar white labcoat, golden strands of hair nearly reached his shoulders as it was none other than...
"Dr. Hall, it seems you hold something fortunate to share."
WAA!
Many eyes and gazes landed on him as he didn't falter or buckle from them!
His golden eyes hardened as he nodded and began to float towards Noah's visage.
"Can we...expand the Boundary of Medicine? I seek to put this at the very center and lead forces that can heal our people endlessly and even stop the advancement of True Death."

chapters.title: Chapter 2509 Raising a Dreadful Army! I
paragraphs: In the depths of the Noblesse Domains.
Commander Vladic's expression was an ugly one to look at currently.
This was because he had picked up on the whispers of his enemy from the Elders of Genesis Institute of Extremity as he learned of the identity this being held!

A holder of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity even before undergoing Apexification as it was even the consensus among the Genesis Elders that even after the Lernaeans were annihilated in the Apex War of Annihilation, the one known as Osmont would likely be saved by the very Adjudicator of Dissolution!
This utterly destroyed the whole purpose for him to incur this war as it was all for killing the one who took Euryale from him right before his eyes.
Even if all the Lernaeans were destroyed as they finally put to rest a long-standing grudge...so what?!
He had to have his due.
And his Will buzzed as he sought for a way.
A way out of such an unfair reality where he couldn't even get his full revenge because of forces more powerful than him!

While his enemies plotted and planned, Noah systematically continued his preparations as he had multiple bodies moving in conjunction with his Will- covering all aspects of what had to be done as his main body and a few other clones were contained in the emerald domain that held most of his important people.
He was looking towards the dashing golden haired Dr. Hall at this moment as he thought of the word this being had just said.
"Medicine...huh?"

The Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity was already one that was filled with the impulse of life and Vitality as Noah had no doubt ridiculous and newer capabilities would arise once it was fully converged.
But the field Dr. Hall wanted to delve into had its own merits as Noah allowed it!
"Very well. Medicine shall be expanded, and your Realm shall be constructed."
WAA!
His permission was given as a new concept began to shine with brilliance, Dr. Hall nodding as he felt his Origin begin a fantastical process- his voice still continuing!
"Yes, Master. Some additional concepts that may be useful to include in this endeavor are Biochemistry, Epidemiology, Essensology, and Pharmacology."
This being was bold as he sought many more concepts from the True Emperor of Quintessence!

And Noah only smiled as his soul buzzed with the Sources of Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity, each of the aforementioned concepts being expanded towards Extremity as many new fields of interest opened up in his mind!
His main body then proceeded with the process of Realm
Reconstruction and Aspect Configuration just like he had done before- grand lights beginning to bloom as a similar process repeated.
But....there were other bodies here besides his main one.

His Aletheian Chassis came forward as one pointed towards Barbatos and Katelyn, another pointing towards Kazuhiko as they already had their Realms reconstructed and configured, and they would be opening their pathway of the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity as their clones would then proceed towards
Apexification!
It was Noah efficiently beginning a process of producing an army of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms among his own people.
The process of raising a dreadful army that would far outstrip what any of the aboriginal Lineages of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution had!

This process would be a long one as it would be among the things that would make the coming hours pass by wondrously, the threeday counter already underway before an utterly fantastical reality unfolded.

And while all of this occurred, the visage of Alexander King was surrounded by crackling waves of essence- his foundation and Origin being taken to a sublime point as with a few more expanded concepts, his 81 Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds would be filled as this body of Noah's...it would also undergo Apexification!
In another region within the Prana Aletheian Haven.
Enclosed in their own verdant domain with walls nobody could peer across, one of Noah's bodies stared at a father and daughter as he spoke with a smile.

"It seems you truly didn't understand your daughter, Caesar. The Singularity Overseers are so desperate for her that they offered me their support for turning you over, and now they're going to be fighting with the Noblesse after I told them to fuck off."
The eyes of the Mad Apex Emperor constricted as his hands formed into buzzing fists.
He looked towards Noah with countless thoughts crossing through them as ultimately, he shook his head and sighed.
"All of that can be put aside for now. I just want to make sure Xiaomi can be fully healed first. My deal with you still stands as it seems you will be the clear victor, so-"
"No."
A clear and sonorous voice rang out while the two men were talking.
The dazzling figure of Xiaomi who was made of up of pure stellar quasars spoke with undeniable conviction as the eyes of Noah and Caesar came to focus on her.
"I am my own person. So whatever deal was made with my father, I will take it's weight on myself to fulfill it."

"Xiaomi..." Caesar had a troubled look as he tried to speak, but Xiaomi came to wrap her small stellar arms around him in an embrace as her slender and developed stature came up to half her father's height!
"You've always taken care of me and know what a good set of eyes I have. Trust me in this and let me finally take on responsibility for myself again."
Her words rang out clearly as they didn't have any leeway of denial!
Caesar looked at his daughter with bright eyes as she pulled away from him and spoke without even looking back.
"I will make and fulfill my choice in my own isolated domain."
Her words were straightforward as the space around them twisted, paternal figure and daughter being pulled into different directions as an emerald wall rose up between them!
Soon enough, Caesar was left alone in this realm as a second later, another one of Noah's bodies appeared not too far from him.
His eyes locked onto his as with a glare, the fury and protectiveness of the Mad Apex Emperor rose as he spoke out slowly.
"If you do anything untoward to my daughter..."
His defensiveness towards his daughter would never even after another billion years as he would do anything for her!
Noah waved his hands at such words as he spoke with a smile.

"Don't get suspicious now. Will you follow the route other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms have taken in here and have your Realm Reconstructed with an Extremity Foundation? You would gain genuine power to protect your daughter- strength to also fight against the military of the Genesis Institute of Extremity who forced you to undergo Apexification not too long ago since they will be engaging in this Apex War as well."
WAA!
