chapters.title: Chapter 2510 Raising a Dreadful Army! II
paragraphs: Noah's words caused the Mad Apex Emperor to burn with a grand light as he turned up to stare into the verdant expanse.
Then...
"Do it."
His resolve shone brightly as he made his choice!
And the light of Realm Reconstruction and Aspect Configuration shone as Noah's Soul blazed with brilliance.

The more existences continued to utilize his authority of Dynamis of Extremity on- especially Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, the faster they went towards complete Convergence as Aletheian and Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity would soon follow the path of Indefatigable and blood with a Yggdrasil of Extremity!
In another region of space far from the one where yet another Apex Aeonic Lifeform had fallen into Noah's hands.
The figure of Xiaomi shone with stellar brilliance as she stared closely at Noah.
Her eyes had always been able to see things others could not easily discern as she was currently trying to formulate an understanding of this being before her!

Even though she was afflicted with a condition as her lifeforce was very faint, her beauty was unrivaled among many others as the way trillions of quasars came together to form her body made her seem like an innocent stellar flower that even Kings and Emperors could only gaze at from afar.

She knew that her father and herself had already fallen into the grasp of this being before her as she didn't need to take on any responsibility, but she wanted to understand him better, and thus she did what she did.
And she was the first one to speak.

"When the Elder of the Singularity Overseers landed his eyes on me, his whole demeanor changed as after learning to what extent they're still trying to go through for me, I've theorized with 99% certainty that he must have seen something within my body that someone even more powerful than him wants."

"And it has to be someone more powerful than him, otherwise he wouldn't be able to mobilize all of the forces of Singularity Overseers in Dissolution to look for me. This means that whatever he saw was of interest to someone at the very peak of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms...or a Hyperversal Extremity. The only thing such beings would be interested in are possibly Mutated Aspects of
Existence...or an Innate Foundation that even its holder wasn't aware of."
WAA!
She spoke rapidly as Noah gazed towards her with an interested smile, nodding along the way as she continued.
"And connecting the dots to the whole incident with RUIN that put me in my current state, I can only assume there is a secret foundation within me I was not able to grasp and control in time.

Something that even a peak Apex Aeonic Lifeform or Hyperversal Extremity wants to devour as it means it is a foundation potent enough to easily or quickly attain Extremity. Now...nobody would stop trying to get their hands on such a thing as this is where you come in."
Her gaze was brilliant.
She began walking towards Noah as the verdant grassland below her swayed with happiness.
"Someone like you who hasn't attained Extremity...did not show the same devouring light of greed as the Singularity Overseer Elder.
Where even now as I speak of an opportunity of reaching Extremity, you are unphased by it."
"Why of course." Noah's resonant voice rang out at such a juncture as he spoke calmly.
"I have too many ways to reach Extremity, unlike others. What I do have though, is curiosity for what exactly it is that very likely...a Hyperversal Extremity wants from you."
The possibility that it was a very powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeform seeking what Xiaomi had was stricken out.
And...
"No. It is not just curiosity you hold."
Xiaomi's sonorous voice rang out as she came a few inches away from Noah.
"My eyes can see many things that others couldn't, and from your eyes...I see the light of possessiveness."
"You may not want to harm me or devour what I have, but you have a light of wanting to make my very being yours. It may not be easy for others to notice, but I can."
Her eyes didn't hold any hint of fear as she spoke, Noah's lips forming a calm smile at them as she continued!

"Now, among the options of suitors in the Aeonic Haven of Extremity, there are some dirt poor options of being devoured by a Hyperversal Extremity for whatever I have or a Quasarian Prince with poor prospects. Or...there is an enigmatic being like you who can raise Apex Aeonic Lifeforms before even undergoing

Apexification yourself. I would like to get to know a being like you better as all I want is your help in me getting the strength to protect myself from the Hyperversal Extremity wishing to devour me. And then..."

Inches from Noah, weak waves of Essence coiled around her feet as her figure floated forward with her arms behind her back, her dazzling face coming closer as her small lips lightly landed on Noah's before she pulled back!
"...you can satiate that possessive light in your eyes by taking whatever you want from me."
Bravado and brilliance were apparent in her eyes, but the arms behind her back showed her fingers trembling with nervousness as they betrayed the strong front this being was putting up!

Noah glanced at the Quasarian before his eyes as his right hand flashed- bountiful lifeforce and an aura of Extremity bubbling from it as a celestial obsidian crystalline flower that was nothing other than an Obsidian Extremity Panacea.
His Reified Sources of Extremity in the Extremity Vein of Dissolution were making stupendous advancements from

massacred Leviathans of Dissolution and obtaining more Sources of Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity among other burning quantities of the Light of Loot, and obtaining Golden and Obsidian Extremity Panaceas only came easier after that as the exploration of this wondrous location continued!
What was even more stunning was that in the deeper areas, the golden lights of treasures unlike Panaceas had begun to shine.
They were things that likely allowed one to converge a Dynamis easier or the progression of Boundaries past the 9th Layer!
Noah smiled as he thought of what was to come, focusing back on the young woman before him as he spoke out.
"We can leave everything else for later as we now have to understand why someone who has already attained Hyperversal Extremity Authority would want from you."
HOONG!
The light of the Obsidian Extremity Panacea began to blaze, turning into stellar black flames under Noah's hands that flowed into the body of Xiaomi.

Like many other healing panaceas in the past, Xiaomi's body was about to reject it as a pained expression rose on her face, Noah stabilizing her as the three authorities of his Dynamis of Extremity also surged out and coursed through her body!
Her vasculature was dried and filled with dead vessels that arched with the essence of Ruin.
Her very Foundation seemed feeble and about to die, and yet when the essence of the Extremity Panacea reached into it, it began to buzz and come back to life ever so slowly.

The Obsidian Extremity Panacea should have been a tool to aid one in forging an Extremity Foundation, and yet its essence was being drawn into the seemingly weakened Foundation in the depths of Xiaomi's body as it wasn't used to forge a foundation!
It seemed like it was simply going towards causing the current one to shine with even more brilliance.
BOOM!
An explosive boom of authority erupted as Noah's visage was nearly pushed away.
A dreadful and pristine aura began to ride from Xiaomi as her dead vasculature began to come back to life!
And it returned even greater and more immaculate than before as it had swallowed the burning light of an Obsidian Extremity Panacea!
More than this though, even Noah was surprised to find that from the aura blazing from Xiaomi, he could sense a similar grandeur compared to his own.
He could sense...
"Hyperversal...?"
WAA!
As soon as his words ended, prompts began to rise before him.
[You have unearthed the Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation of Ruin!]

[Destined to disappear into oblivion after its holder failed to control its core essence, you have reversed its course and even directed it towards a grander path with the rejuvenation of a type of Natal Extremity Authority!]
Natal Extremity Authority.
This was the type of energy contained in an Obsidian Extremity Panacea!
So the Crimson Extremity Panacea Noah swallowed that aided in him obtaining the Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation... maybe something even greater!
[Due to a confluence of factors, the Unrecorded Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos has been born in the selected target!]

[The sole purpose of the Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation of Ruin was to elevate the concept of Ruin towards Extremity in the shortest possible time. The Unrecorded Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos can now elevate 8 other Sources of Chaos apart from Ruin towards Extremity in an incredibly short period of time.]
Dazzling prompts appeared before both Noah and Xiaomi.
Her slender, bountiful, and gorgeous visage pulsed as around the verdant domain, dense origins of chaos began to gather!
Along with this...
[The Sources of Chaos within your own foundation begin to resonate with the Unrecorded Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos.]

[As the one who unearthed this Unrecorded Foundation from facing oblivion, you are granted a distinctive authority to benefit from the same Sources of Chaos the holder of this Foundation raises towards Extremity!]

[Cultivating near or with the Holder of the Unrecorded Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos will increase the rate of advancement of select Boundaries connected to Sources of Chaos by 10,000% to 100,000%!]
A dazzling notification appeared before Noah's eyes.
And before the stellar quasarian eyes of Xiaomi who felt her entire Aspects of Existence undergo a revolution...

[As an existence holding the Unrecorded Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos, cultivating near or with the Holder of the Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation will increase the rate of advancement of all your Boundaries connected to Sources of Chaos by 100,000% to 1,000,000%.]
The 11th, 12th, 13th, 14th, 15th, 16th, 17th, and the final 18th Extremity Boundary Layer were immensely difficult to cross, each one being hundreds of times more difficult than the one prior.

Due to her Innate Foundation and the changes it had just gone through, connected with the being of a being that truly shouldn't exist with the Foundation that he held...Xiaomi was one of the few, rare existences that may just be able to traverse across the arduous upper Boundary Layers with utmost ease!

Existence...or an Innate Foundation that even its holder wasn't aware of."
WAA!

"And connecting the dots to the whole incident with RUIN that put me in my current state, I can only assume there is a secret foundation within me I was not able to grasp and control in time.

Now...nobody would stop trying to get their hands on such a thing as this is where you come in."
Her gaze was brilliant.
She began walking towards Noah as the verdant grassland below her swayed with happiness.
"Someone like you who hasn't attained Extremity...did not show the same devouring light of greed as the Singularity Overseer Elder.

"I have too many ways to reach Extremity, unlike others.
What I do have though, is curiosity for what exactly it is that very likely...a Hyperversal Extremity wants from you."
The possibility that it was a very powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeform seeking what Xiaomi had was stricken out.
And...
"No.
It is not just curiosity you hold."
Xiaomi's sonorous voice rang out as she came a few inches away from Noah.
"My eyes can see many things that others couldn't, and from your eyes...I see the light of possessiveness."
"You may not want to harm me or devour what I have, but you have a light of wanting to make my very being yours.
It may not be easy for others to notice, but I can."
Her eyes didn't hold any hint of fear as she spoke, Noah's lips forming a calm smile at them as she continued!

Apexification yourself.
I would like to get to know a being like you better as all I want is your help in me getting the strength to protect myself from the Hyperversal Extremity wishing to devour me.
And then..."

"...you can satiate that possessive light in your eyes by taking whatever you want from me."
Bravado and brilliance were apparent in her eyes, but the arms behind her back showed her fingers trembling with nervousness as they betrayed the strong front this being was putting up!

His Reified Sources of Extremity in the Extremity Vein of Dissolution were making stupendous advancements from

massacred Leviathans of Dissolution and obtaining more Sources of Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity among other burning quantities of the Light of Loot, and obtaining Golden and Obsidian Extremity Panaceas only came easier after that as the exploration of this wondrous location continued!

chapters.title: Chapter 2511 Raising a Dreadful Army! III
paragraphs: 2511 Raising a Dreadful Army! III
Each of the trillions of quasars that made her felt like they were filled with boundless potential.
Her Aspects of Existence buzzed as they felt the unique authority coursing through them.
The same authority that nearly killed her.
The same authority that the moment it was being corrected...
[The 7th Boundary Layer of Ruin has been achieved.]
[The 8th Boundary Layer of Ruin has been achieved.]
Crimson gold words like these rose multiple times over as the tendrils of Ruin that had been wrecking her body all these years suddenly turned docile!
[The 9th Boundary Layer of Ruin has been achieved.]
[Enough understanding of Ruin by your Foundation still remains as it seeks your Extremity Meridians to progress even further.]
She felt it meld into her very soul as if she could control it to the finest threads!
As if her soul was meant just for this.
This...was her Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation that nearly killed her!
It allowed her to absorb and turn the ruin that was killing her into pure understanding that only stopped at the 9th Boundary Layer because it couldn't go on any further.
This...was the ridiculous pace of progression she could make with her Foundation!
Her eyes fluttered with astonishment as she contained her nervousness when she gazed at the being who had made this change possible.
If she cultivated near him, or...did 'that' with him, her progression could go up to 1,000,000% faster!
Didn't this mean Extremity would be achieved in a ridiculously short period of time?
But when she thought about the action that would require such a thing, her stellar face reddened!
She may talk big and analyze things calmly, with her mind choosing the most opportune paths in dangerous scenarios, but her true timid nature that even her father had rarely seen was still there.

Since she fell from the high pedestal as a genius of the Quasarian Bloodline, she had resigned herself to death as never in her wildest dreams did she think a man like this would appear to solve everything.
He was nothing like the stellar knight in shining armor she always dreamed of. He was more like a celestial beast whose eyes clearly told her he wanted to possess everything about her entirely!
She realized she had been blankly staring at him inches away while thinking all this as she collected herself an instant later and uttered out.

"It...seems that whatever Hyperversal Extremity is in contact with the Singularity Overseers wanted to get a hold of my Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation. We can continue and see how much more powerful it'll be once I undergo Apexification!"
She didn't even mention the crimson gold words she saw as she chose to entirely move on for now.
He wouldn't have out anything about it anyway, right?
Before her figure, he smiled devilishly as his finger tapped out, authority flowing into her body as like many others- she was pushed towards Apexification!
This was Noah's goal as for such a thing...hours passed.
His authority of Dynamis of Extremity was utilized a great deal for the emergence of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as the gains he made were far too valuable.

In a matter of hours, the changes that would occur in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven were so drastic that if someone said a genuine Hyperversal Extremity was the one responsible for such changes...they wouldn't be believed!
The first day before the promised Apex War of Annihilation was passing swiftly for some and strangely slow for others.
But some beings were above the bindings of space and time itself.

Within the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution, near a region filled with molten mountains in the skies and the earth, tendrils of a dark state of verisimilitude bursting from the mountain peaks as they seemed potent enough to burn the very Souls of Lifeforms.
The few regions of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution occupied by Lernaeans and Noblesse were filled with Ruin and Nullity across it, but this wasn't the case for many other regions of this Haven.

The unexplored regions held their own dangers and natural phenomena as the current region with molten mountains covering the skies and earth had a massively radiant black crack that seemed to be swallowing the very surrounding space constantly!
It was filled with Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.

If someone with sufficient power was able to enter this region, they would find that it was a specific zone of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority where in its very center, two figures could be seen floating freely without any concerns or care!

One sat in a meditative position as Vacuous Hyperversal Authority pulsed around his body, the other standing behind this being as dense and potent Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Destruction flowed from him freely.
It was the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction and his Scion that had been giving chase to Aurelia and the other Lernaeans!
"Do you feel any closer?"
The voice of the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction rang out as his disciple shook his head with a sigh.

"The 17th Boundary Layer of Destruction seems further than ever. I feel like I am lacking in my soul, even after spending all these years surrounded by Vacous Hyperversal Authority, it is still not sufficient."

Slight regret could be felt from this disciple as his Master laughed with a cognizant light, his Hyperversal Extremity Authority receding after he completed what many Hyperversal Extremities do for their Clans and Inheritances!

They bathed their Apex Aeonic Lifeforms with their unique Hyperversal Authority- with those having the support of truly powerful Extremities that could impart their power and time with ease being capable of reaching the upper Boundaries towards Extremity with relative ease.

"For you, it is not sufficient anymore to simply feel the end goal of Destruction from me. You need to experience a unique type of Destruction in order to advance to the 17th Boundary Layer. For me, it only came after I destroyed the Foundations of my Elder Brother who at the time already held the 17th Boundary Layer of Light. A once in a lifetime talent that nearly had an Absolute Seed of Extremity forged...and I snuffed his light just like that. I advanced the instant I did so."

"Destruction can come in many forms, my dear disciple, but the destruction of an existence that has forged an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity and dipped his fingers into Vacous Hyperversal Authority even before Apexification...that is a type of Destruction that may take your Boundary Layer to the 17th level!"
WAA!
A glorious statement was made as the eyes of Ahpuch glittered with brilliance.

chapters.title: Chapter 2512 Raising a Dreadful Army! IV
paragraphs: "It will be a loss for the Seven Havens for such a being to die, yes, but it will be a win for you. And I won't lie...this would be a heavy ordeal for you as this Osmont is in no way simple, and the Adjudicator should be very inclined to him. There may even be a relationship there that we aren't aware of."
Dangerous words were said as these two beings floated serenely amidst dangerous Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.

"If you do succeed amidst the chaos though, you will incur her Wrath as even with my appearance, she will likely force you with multiple Obsidian Haven Albatrosses or a Crimson Haven Albatrossafter all, you are also a crucial being who has attained 'that' which even some Hyperversal Extremities do not have, Svetlana would never dare to even put her hands on you personally. There are no true losses you can incur so...head towards the little mice known as Noblesse. You and your Junior Brothers will fight on their side during this. Your goal will only be destruction- whatever form that may take."
BOOM!
The Vacuous Hyperversal Authority pulsed around them as the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction made his will known towards his disciple- Ahpuch!
The seconds were like stellar dust that drifted into minutes.
Minutes turned into hours.
Different existences used this time in their own ways as some utilized it in a fashion that most wouldn't even be able to imagine.

Half the time before the Apex War of Annihilation that was being talked about with frequency had passed, with the chosen Apex Battlefield being filled with Legions of Noblesse led by Unequaled Dynamis of Extremity.
Among Noah's Vassals, there seemed to be something all of them were singularly missing.
It wasn't due to their souls being weak or their Foundations being faulty.
They were among the most perfectly clean newly advanced Apex Aeonic Lifeforms there could be across the Havens of Extremity!
Yet it seemed like there was an impossible to overcome wall ahead of them whenever they even thought of forming an Absolute Seed of Extremity.
Noah's Wills gazed at the dozens of auras of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms around him as he knew the issue.
He knew it well as his gaze turned towards his left.
There, across the veils of emerald light, was the domain that Aurelia was contained in along with one of his bodies.

And her figure was a stunning one as it seemed to be dripping with pure gold liquid light that hugged her curves and blessings, her expression that of shock as she spoke in disbelief while opening her eyes to lock onto Noah.
She had returned to being an Apex Aeonic Lifeform as in her body, the flash of 54 golden Extremity Meridians shone.
And every few seconds, they would flash with even greater brilliance as she couldn't help but look at the man responsible for this and say even more extreme words.
"I...I think I may actually be able to converge enough Boundaries to form a Seed. An Absolute Seed!"
Pure disbelief was all she felt as she breathed in once more.
And...
She felt 24 essences course within her as some in particular seemed to be getting ever closer together with every breath.
She couldn't believe it.
She locked her eyes with the existence before her that had taught her this ridiculous breathing method not too long ago as she had no words.

Her golden hair danced wondrously on her bare fair shoulders while the rest of her dazzling figure was encased in liquified golden light, her calm eyes becoming more serious than ever before as she looked at the man before her while uttering out.
"Who...no, what are you, really?"
WAA!
She seemed to be asking out of pure curiosity and need as she continued.
"None of this is normal. Even in the bounds of abnormal, it is even more abnormal. Just..."
She didn't have any words.
And the being before her smiled as even though she should be immensely more powerful than him currently, she felt like she was gazing at an immovable force that was many times greater than her.
Such an outlook didn't make sense as her power now...was not something her past self could even fathom!
Yet this being before her still seemed as if he could snuff her out if he wished for it at any time.
And he looked at her with a stellar smile as he replied calmly.
"I am simply a man who moves with purpose. And my purpose for you...is Extremity."
Extremity.
For her, not even for him.
Why did he want Extremity for her?
As if he could read her gaze, he continued.

"It is so that I can taste Extremity with my own lips as you head towards it and achieve it. I am basking in the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of an Esteemed Extremity right now, but I want to do more than bask in it. You can feel the beginnings of an Absolute Seed of Extremity, and your Fortune reached the 15th Boundary Layer after all these transformations, yes?"
His gaze was so deep that she swallowed while nodding blankly, her eyes opening wide as she finally understood some of this being's purpose.
"Good. Then I shall bring you ever closer to Extremity as we will focus on forming your Absolute Seed of Extremity first."
He called towards her.

Her golden hair flitted as she blinked a few times, her body finding itself going towards him instinctively as even now, she felt like she was floating towards an unfathomably powerful existence that held more mysteries than she could even imagine!

There may even be a relationship there that we aren't aware of."
Dangerous words were said as these two beings floated serenely amidst dangerous Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.

"If you do succeed amidst the chaos though, you will incur her Wrath as even with my appearance, she will likely force you with multiple Obsidian Haven Albatrosses or a Crimson Haven Albatrossafter all, you are also a crucial being who has attained 'that' which even some Hyperversal Extremities do not have, Svetlana would never dare to even put her hands on you personally.
There are no true losses you can incur so...head towards the little mice known as Noblesse.
You and your Junior Brothers will fight on their side during this.
Your goal will only be destruction- whatever form that may take."
BOOM!
The Vacuous Hyperversal Authority pulsed around them as the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction made his will known towards his disciple- Ahpuch!
The seconds were like stellar dust that drifted into minutes.
Minutes turned into hours.
Different existences used this time in their own ways as some utilized it in a fashion that most wouldn't even be able to imagine.

Half the time before the Apex War of Annihilation that was being talked about with frequency had passed, with the chosen Apex Battlefield being filled with Legions of Noblesse led by Unequaled Dynamis of Extremity.
Among Noah's Vassals, there seemed to be something all of them were singularly missing.
It wasn't due to their souls being weak or their Foundations being faulty.
They were among the most perfectly clean newly advanced Apex Aeonic Lifeforms there could be across the Havens of Extremity!
Yet it seemed like there was an impossible to overcome wall ahead of them whenever they even thought of forming an Absolute Seed of Extremity.
Noah's Wills gazed at the dozens of auras of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms around him as he knew the issue.
He knew it well as his gaze turned towards his left.
There, across the veils of emerald light, was the domain that Aurelia was contained in along with one of his bodies.

And her figure was a stunning one as it seemed to be dripping with pure gold liquid light that hugged her curves and blessings, her expression that of shock as she spoke in disbelief while opening her eyes to lock onto Noah.
She had returned to being an Apex Aeonic Lifeform as in her body, the flash of 54 golden Extremity Meridians shone.
And every few seconds, they would flash with even greater brilliance as she couldn't help but look at the man responsible for this and say even more extreme words.
"I...I think I may actually be able to converge enough Boundaries to form a Seed.
An Absolute Seed!"
Pure disbelief was all she felt as she breathed in once more.
And...
She felt 24 essences course within her as some in particular seemed to be getting ever closer together with every breath.
She couldn't believe it.
She locked her eyes with the existence before her that had taught her this ridiculous breathing method not too long ago as she had no words.

Her golden hair danced wondrously on her bare fair shoulders while the rest of her dazzling figure was encased in liquified golden light, her calm eyes becoming more serious than ever before as she looked at the man before her while uttering out.
"Who...no, what are you, really?"
WAA!
She seemed to be asking out of pure curiosity and need as she continued.
"None of this is normal.
Even in the bounds of abnormal, it is even more abnormal.
Just..."
She didn't have any words.
And the being before her smiled as even though she should be immensely more powerful than him currently, she felt like she was gazing at an immovable force that was many times greater than her.
Such an outlook didn't make sense as her power now...was not something her past self could even fathom!
Yet this being before her still seemed as if he could snuff her out if he wished for it at any time.
And he looked at her with a stellar smile as he replied calmly.
"I am simply a man who moves with purpose.
And my purpose for you...is Extremity."
Extremity.
For her, not even for him.
Why did he want Extremity for her?
As if he could read her gaze, he continued.
"It is so that I can taste Extremity with my own lips as you head towards it and achieve it.
I am basking in the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of an Esteemed Extremity right now, but I want to do more than bask in it.
You can feel the beginnings of an Absolute Seed of Extremity, and your Fortune reached the 15th Boundary Layer after all these transformations, yes?"
His gaze was so deep that she swallowed while nodding blankly, her eyes opening wide as she finally understood some of this being's purpose.
"Good.
Then I shall bring you ever closer to Extremity as we will focus on forming your Absolute Seed of Extremity first."
He called towards her.

Her golden hair flitted as she blinked a few times, her body finding itself going towards him instinctively as even now, she felt like she was floating towards an unfathomably powerful existence that held more mysteries than she could even imagine!

chapters.title: Chapter 2513 Alexander King’s Apexification! I
paragraphs: His eyes were serene and yet filled with a powerful light as he stared at the figure of Aurelia.
Her exquisite figure was literally adorned in the molten authority of Loot as her golden hair danced on her fair shoulders, her eyes empty as she came forward due to his words.
The True Emperor of an Age long past his as she was an Ancestor of a whole Lineage!
He would elevate her to an even grander stature as he voiced out towards her while gazing at her stat panel.
"Don't already be dazed for this. I need you to be fully focused on what we're about to do."
[Name]:: Caterina Aurelia Dismukes
[Realm]:: Boundary Expansion(Third Aeonic Loot Haven)
[Lineage]:: Lernaean
[Titles]:: The True Emperor of Fortune, The Power Behind the Shadows, Holder of the Reverie, The Seeker of Fortune, The Loot Fanatic...
[Loot Apex Mana Value]:: 1,250
[Loot Apex Vitality Value]:: 1,250
[Loot Apex Soul Value]:: 1,350
[Loot Apex Defense Value]:: 1,150
[Loot Apex Damage Value]:: 1,350
[Dynamis of Extremity]:: Gilded, Redeemer, Auriferous, Languorous [Boundaries of Extremity]:: Fortune, Loot, Providence, Fate, Karma, Destiny...
Destiny...

Her achievements were already grand beforehand, and with Noah's Realm Reconstruction and Aspect Configuration...her values exploded to a ridiculous level as in terms of her Values, she currently exceeded all others in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
Of course, these values were already inflated as they were not the numbers of a newly risen Apex Aeonic Lifeform.
All of Aurelia's past achievements were utilized in her Reconstruction as her Realm was greatly advanced, along with a number of boosts from her Boundaries that had reached Layers past 10th!

And with her Foundation, it was now even easier to raise her Boundaries towards higher layers as by the time she consolidated her new boundaries and forged an Absolute Seed of Extremity, her foundation would be even more pristine as her Values would continue scaling upwards.
His words took her out of her stupor as her fair skin shone with a stellar radiance.
"You...can't you at least be subtle? For some of us, this is the first time going through these experiences."
Her golden eyes danced with power as they actually felt wronged at this moment!
All the years she had lived, she secluded herself from others as with her Golden Forge, she had no need to ever step foot outside her domain to go on any adventures or anything of that nature.
The only man she ever had prolonged contact with was Genesis as even then, she found his demeanor and self hatred of his past actions to be too bland for her tastes.
Yet this unfathomable being before her...she didn't even know what to expect as towards her words, he smiled as if he had found something amusing to play with as his voice echoed out.
"There is nothing subtle in what we're about to do. During it though, try to keep your focus as best as you can on the Boundary of Fortune and the Absolute Seed of Extremity."
HOONG!
Stellar golden and verdant mist surged and covered everything in the surroundings as Aurelia snorted at this moment.
He may be unfathomable, but she could instinctively feel that she was stronger than him at this moment.
Would he really be the only one pushing her around, or could she teach him a lesson before one of his bodies underwent
Apexification?
Apexification!
To prepare for such a thing with his Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity that was Alexander King, Noah had spared no efforts in the past day and a half!

The eyes of Alexander turned towards the direction where one of his Clones was about to begin a different type of battle with Aurelia, this battle being something that Noah would truly benefit from with the appearance of Alexander as an Apex Aeonic Lifeform.

This was because his Boundaries would be able to continue climbing upwards as an Apex Aeonic Lifeform- the practice of Dual Cultivation being something that would be most useful in elevating his Boundaries if he were doing it with someone like Aurelia who had reached the 15th Boundary Layer, or an existence like Xiaomi who would make Noah's Boundaries relating to Sources of Chaos climb at such a rapid pace that they would leave behind even Quintessence!
But all of these things could only truly be savored when one of his bodies became an Apex Aeonic Lifeform.
When Alexander King took this step!
And he had achieved all his requirements.
Over 81 Boundaries were expanded towards Extremity as Noah added the Boundaries of Life, Esuriance, Impermanence, Archetypes, Chronos, Aether, Destruction, Slaughter, Fealty, and Annihilation.

Some Boundaries that were favored more than others were placed within the 81 Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds while others were removed, with the appearance of Alexander now being ready to proceed forward with his Origin only saturated at the Third Aletheian Haven of Extremity!
For an Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity, Noah had already over prepared by doing all this.

His main body would continue doing its utmost to build an even more exemplary foundation as among many things in progress for the past day and a half, the elevation of his Boundaries from Golden Consummate had begun as Noah put to use the Light of Conquest gathered by the domination of the Lernaean Domains and his own elevated Soul Value in being capable of altering his Recorded History in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
His main body would take the reigns of building the most Quintessential Foundation before Apexification.

For the purposes of the upcoming war and domination of local Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity placing their fingers into the Haven of Dissolution, Alexander King's current foundation would be more than enough!
"Proceed."
WAA!
His main body commanded.

Apart from all the overpreparation, there was also an unmentioned sense of urgency that pushed Noah to seek Apexification as soon as possible for at least his clone- and this dealt with his own calculations and possibilities he had thought of in the illusory trillions of years within Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!

chapters.title: Chapter 2514 Alexander King’s Apexification! II
paragraphs: Existence Dissociation that gave birth to the Absolute Vitalistic Clones of Extremity was one of the parts of the puzzles that guarded Noah and his Vassals from any real danger while facing Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
But...it wasn't something that was enough for Hyperversal Extremity Authority!

Existences that had reached Extremity had terrifying ways of moving that Noah was only getting glimpses of through his Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation, and the things he was able to understand and see as his access into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity increased!

After the actions of Euryale and the repercussions they had, Noah did not just want to be reactive to what may possibly happen or not happen in the future as the Apexification of Alexander King was another method of protection.
Protection against existences that had even reached Extremity!
He wouldn't be inactive and simply believe that the Adjudicator of Dissolution would move to protect him if a Hyperversal Extremity attacked him whether hiddenly or in the open.
She had already failed to do so once as she could always do it again.
No. As always, one had to depend on themselves!
And one of Noah's solutions at keeping threats from even Hyperversal Extremities at bay...involved forging an Absolute Seed of Extremity geared towards areas that such beings were most adept at.
Ways of attacking that others couldn't even see coming!
Through Destiny, Fate, Providence, or any other similar concepts.
Through the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
It was a task for Alexander King to design yet another Absolute Seed of Extremity apart from the one filled with devilish destruction and horrors that he had been experimenting with!
And the concepts for the aforementioned Seed of Extremity were already set in stone as things only had to be implemented.
And so...Alexander King moved forward.
"Come."
His voice was deep and resolute as it made a calling.
A calling to the dazzling 81 Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds that were only waiting for such a call!
And...
BOOM!
An explosive shockwave emanated out as immense and utterly wild seas of authority began to rage around Alexander King like a torrential storm of majesty.
His body already held the seeds as the moment after he called them, they enlarged with a blinding light to become radiant stanchions of light that bloomed across his Aspects of Existence!
[The Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds in your body are advancing to become Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians!]
The Process of Apexification fully began as 81 pillars of light began to appear and illuminate Noah's body.
Other beings would start with 1 or 9 and continue building up more, but Noah straight away achieved 81 Extremity Meridians in one sitting as this was what his Foundation boasted!
81 radiant Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians formed as his Aspects of Existence began to be drawn and devoured into them, even more prompts rising along the way.

[The Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation is burning with the light of Apexification.] [The Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation asks you to define yourself.]
The definition of Noah Osmont's will within the rising Alexander King.
It could be nothing else other than...
"Quintessential."
THUMP!
Like a beating heart, one of the Extremity Meridians pulsed and turned into an utterly bright pillar of light.
And it wasn't over.
Because the True Emperor of Quintessence...had only just begun to define himself with more concepts!
"Providence, Manadynamics, Loot, Blood, Body, Origin, Soul, Apocalypse, Impermanence..."
One word after another, multiple defining concepts were uttered out as an Extremity Meridian shone after every single utterance.
And as this process began, the part of Noah's soul contained within Alexander King began to go utterly wild as its Soul Values started to exponentially surge upwards!
And the moment this process began...
[The Process of Apexification is spurring Quintessential changes to your soul.]
[The Process of Apexification has spurred the remaining sliver of Convergence of your Dynamis of Extremity forward.]
The Convergence of his two Dynamis of Extremity!

They had reached 99.99% after being used so much these past few days as they didn't budge thereafter, with Noah waiting exactly for this time as he didn't even utilize any Loot to finish the last remaining percentage- not a single Bud of Convergence!
Such Loot was reserved for the quick Convergence of Dynamis that were about to form.
But at this glorious juncture...
[The Aletheian Dynamis of Extremity has reached 100%
Convergence.]
[The Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity has reached 100%
Convergence.]
A heavy presence erupted from his main body as the changes of concepts like Dynamis were simultaneously expressed in Noah's Soul.
One runic seed that read [ALETHEIAN] and another that read [VITALISTIC] shone with splendor as they began to bloom a moment later!
[An Aletheian Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity is blooming within your Soul!]
[A Vitslistic Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity is blooming within your Soul!]
A black gold Yggdrasil and another of emerald grandeur sprouted within his soul and caused its Soul Values to be elevated to an even more ridiculous level, profound changes continuing to take place!
Each of the blooming trees had trunks as radiant as cylindrical Havens while their branches glimmered like black gold or emerald rivers of stellar Realities that stretched out across Noah's body.

[Due to the enhancements of your Foundation, every half a day, the Aletheian and Vitalistic Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity will bud Aletheian and Vitalistic Fruits of Extremity equivalent to the number of concepts in their makeup.]

Across Noah's Aspects of Existence, the first established Indefatigable Perennial Yggdrasil dominantly stood as one could see 27 dazzling stellar cherry colored Singularity already formed at the tips of some of its branches.
27 Indefatigable Fruits of Extremity were already born during the past day and a half as now, Aletheian and Vitalistic would join the fray to add their own grandeur!
[All features under the banner of the Aletheian and Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity are further enhanced.]
[The Aletheian and Vitalistic Absolute Planar Domains can now be cast.]

On a corner of his eyes, lines of golden prompts passed as they delved into the fantastical enhancements of the features of the elevated Dynamis of Extremity as well as even new ones, but Noah set these aside to look at later as he gazed at two final prompts before turning his gaze towards the process of Apexification!

[The Authority of the Aletheian and Vitalistic Dynamis of Extremity will flow across your Aspects of Existence to strengthen your Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation passively when utilizing your Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi, granting an increase in all your Hyperversal Values unceasingly.]

[The combination of your Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi, Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation, and the authority of the Indefatigable, Aletheian, and Vitalistic Absolute Dynamis of Extremity coursing through you has caused the strengthening and strengthening of your Aspects of Existence to reach an even more abnormal level, granting you an increase of +2.5 Hyperversal Soul Values, +2.5 Hyperversal Damage Values, +7.5 Hyperversal Defense Values, and +7.5 Hyperversal Vitality Values daily.]
Pristine beauty displayed itself as other beings would truly cry just at seeing it be a reality.

And yet it was there as the authority of three fully converged Absolute Dynamis of Extremity granted him massive enhancements to his power in addition to not yet quantified changes brought about due to the full Convergence of all Boundaries- his Aspects of Existence currently all being strengthened!
But...Noah had to bring his attention onto the visage of Alexander.
He had to because the 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians budding within his body had blazed with a shocking message the moment that he finished defining himself with all 81 concepts.

[The Boundary Layers of all Concepts of Extremity placed within the 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians will be determined by the highest Boundary Layer you have achieved in any single Concept of Extremity up to the 17th Boundary Layer.] ...!
BOOM!

And yet it was there as the authority of three fully converged Absolute Dynamis of Extremity granted him massive enhancements to his power in addition to not yet quantified changes brought about due to the full Convergence of all Boundaries- his Aspects of Existence currently all being strengthened!
But...Noah had to bring his attention onto the visage of Alexander.
He had to because the 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians budding within his body had blazed with a shocking message the moment that he finished defining himself with all 81 concepts.

[The Boundary Layers of all Concepts of Extremity placed within the 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians will be determined by the highest Boundary Layer you have achieved in any single Concept of Extremity up to the 17th Boundary Layer.] ...!
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2515 Alexander King’s Apexification! III
paragraphs: [The Boundary Layers of all Concepts of Extremity placed within the 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians will be determined by the highest Boundary Layer you have achieved in any single Concept of Extremity up to the 17th Boundary Layer.] ...!
Oh!
An utterly broken prompt unfolded before Noah's will whole the 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity swallowed everything about his old body.
They remained floating serenely in the verdant space as they pulsed with utmost dominance, his people inadvertently coming out of their traces to watch the grandeur.
The grandeur that commenced with two Dynamis of Extremity reaching full Convergence and continued with a single prompt that truly proved what the Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential
Hyperversal Extremity Foundation was about!
When the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity that was Alexander was forged, it had access to Noah's Concepts of Extremity and the authority of Dynamis that were branded on their collective soul.

The utilization and authority of these Authorities was one of the few things that could be shared and employed by both main body and Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity through the shared souland it was why the process of Apexification spurred the Dynamis of Extremity Alexander had access to as Noah's Main Body was able to gain this benefit simultaneously!

It meant that when new Dynamis of Extremity were formed by one portion of Noah's soul within Alexander...his main body would be able to get strengthened by an obscene amount as it pulled upon the authorities of these newly forged Dynamis- forcefully expanding his soul within the main body and building an ever grander foundation before it underwent Apexification.

The only limitation was that whatever high Soul Values the portion of soul contained in Alexander came out to be in the near future, Noah couldn't simply take or display this same power unless he chose to assimilate with the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremitythen he would attain everything.
Even in this broken reality he was enacting, there was still some semblance of balance.
But then, there was the prompt that utterly gave a middle finger to all other existences working hard to expand even a few boundaries towards the Extremity Layer.
It proposed that all of his Boundaries...would have their Layers reflect whatever his highest Layer was in any of the other Boundaries within the 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians!
This meant that if Quintessence reached the 13th Boundary Layer, all the 80 other Boundaries would also reach the 13th Boundary Layer.
If Quintessence was brought up to the 17th Layer, all the 80 other Boundaries would also reach the 17th Boundary Layer!
It was a dreadful feature that slightly dimmed the authority that Noah's Main Body had been attaining when his Vassals underwent Apexification and achieved their own 10th Boundary Layers.
But when it truly came to just how such a ridiculous feature could be abused...it had to be with what single Boundary Noah could raise the fastest.
At this point in time, it actually wasn't Quintessence!
It was any one of the Sources of Chaos boosted by the range of 10,000% to 100,000% increased rate of progression that could be gained through Xiaomi!

He just had to proceed rapidly in one while he focused his Indefatigable, Vitalistic, Aletheian, and any other Fruits of Extremity that he would receive from the multiple Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity into a single Boundary and ascend at a speed even Hyperversal Extremities could fathom.

And there were many sources of such Loot as within the Vein of Dissolution, Noah's Reified Sources along with other Scions had pierced into the more dangerous lands over the past day and a half as their hands were beginning to be filled with all sorts of treasures.
Treasures that could aid in the Convergence of Dynamis of Extremity, and those that aided in the advancement of Boundaries towards Extremity!
And profoundly connected to all of this...was something else deeply entrenched in Noah's Soul.
No matter the division between him and Alexander King.
He and those he granted access to could only enter it through his Soul!
It was none other than Infinite Forge of Extremity where at its very core...lay a Relic that had one of its main purposes being the multiplication of Loot.
BOOOM!
The 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians released a multicolored pulse as from it, a new form of life began to bloom.
[The Culmination of all the accomplishments of the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity are being utilized to forge an Apex Aeonic Lifeform.]
A body commenced to be built with the 81 Quintessential
Hyperversal Extremity Meridians as the skeletal support.
Since its Soul Values already exceeded what a newly advanced Apex Aeonic Lifeform would have even before undergoing
Apexification...just how inflated would they be when this process was complete?!
HOONG!
New Aspects of Existence took shape.
And with them, a portion of Noah's soul experienced the most ridiculous explosion of strength yet.
Alongside it...
[The 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians illuminate the Concepts contained within them.]
[The 10th Boundary Layer of Quintessence has been achieved.] [The 10th Boundary Layer of Loot has been achieved.]
[The 10th Boundary Layer of Manadynamics has been achieved...] 81 blazing golden prompts.
One after another, they came as with each one, the newly forming visage of Alexander became ever more magisterial!

Since the Meridian Seeds became Extremity Meridians, the 10th Boundary Layer could be supported by the soul taking the identity of Alexander, but Noah's Main Body wouldn't be able to express the authorities of these layers until he formed Extremity Meridians of his own.
But Alexander King could display all of it as with every Boundary attaining a new layer, brilliance overflowed along with abundant information for each new layer!
Until...
[The transforming soul of the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity is resonating with the construct of the Infinite System accessible within its very depths.]
[A Quintessential amount of authority has begun flowing into the Infinite System and its constructs.]
Fantastical and all around change bloomed as many things were altered!

chapters.title: Chapter 2516 Alexander King’s Apexification! IV
paragraphs: A Relic floated in the midst of radiant white gold brilliance as it was in a humanoid form.

It shone with crimson and gold light while bathing in waves of profound Loot Light, the air it gave off putting most Apex Aeonic Relics to shame as it had been refined and elevated by endless Loot Light within the Infinite Forge over the past days!

Amidst the liquefied essences flowing around it and the stellar infinity symbols covering dense rotating Loot that seemed like stellar bodies around her, one could barely see a raised smile on the lips of this Relic as its will thought finally...it could be of use to its Master once more.
But then...
HOOONG!

The forge trembled an instant later as the infinity symbols spinning and releasing waves of loot light trembled, a dominant authority being infused into them as they instantly doubled in size while their brilliance became even more potent!

And it didn't stop there as they still seemed to be expanding, torrential waves of Loot Light beginning to flow down from them as the sentient relic at the very center was alarmed to find seas of Loot Light even more potent than what it had been bathing in this whole tike behind to swarm towards her on all sides!
It was Ruination experiencing an even more profound baptism and elevation due to the Apexification of a portion of Noah's soul!
Ancient groves of trees floated in space, their roots sinking and melding into stellar space as they seemed connected with the very reality of this region.

They shone in pronounced colors of stellar obsidian light as they were composed of layers of cosmos, clusters of such groves of trees stretched throughout this region that didn't seem to have a sky or earth.

In one area, a destroyed grove could be seen along with a massive body of a Prion Armadillo split open, the visage of the ever so radiant Reified Source of Quintessence being seen next to this dead Leviathan of Dissolution as from the grove of trees, he plucked out a Crimson gold hyphae herb that shone with brilliance!

[Blazing Hyphae of Extremity]:: An Aeonic Treasure of Extremity that is conducive in aiding the progression of Boundaries geared towards heat and flames. The potent light of Extremity within it seems capable of aiding one up to the 13th Boundary Layer...

Such treasures were the ones Noah and many others were finding as they roamed the Extremity Vein of Dissolution, with Noah's Quintessential Emperor of Extremity form remaining in this area briefly after attaining the artifact as a subtle brilliance could be seen on his stellar skin.
The reason for this was none other than the fact that Quintessence had reached the 10th Boundary Layer with a portion of Noah's soul!
For the reified source, it felt as if it had attained an even grander stage, and at the same time not as the portion of Noah's soul it stemmed from could not express the authority of the 10th
Boundary Layer.
It was delving into this incongruency when an instant later...
"Oh? Osmont!"
The booming voice of Erikson was heard as this wild being appeared from the side.
His tan visage seemed to glow with strength as he had grasped his own Extremity Foundation, his beach shirt radiating stellar radiance as he held his slippers in his hands instead of his feet.
Further behind him, Scions who had also achieved their own Extremity Foundation followed him, each one adorned in sleek suits as it seemed Erikson had rejoined with his forces.
He came beside Noah's Reified Source of Quintessence freely while whistling out at the sheer aura he radiated, his voice echoing out.

"My people tell me some inconsequential Lineage sought an Apex War with you and your people as a few dredges of Inheritances are standing beside them. Do you want me to send out an Obsidian Sima Legion or two to stand beside your Lineage? I have enough power to mobilize them."
Obsidian Sima Legions!
One of the core forces of the Sima Clan as they stood just below the Crimson Sima Legions and above the Golden Sima Legions.
Within a single Obsidian Sima Legion...24 Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were at the lead! For Erikson to have the power of mobilizing multiple of such forces, his identity was not a simple one!
Towards his words, Noah stretched his neck while replying.

"No. I want all my enemies to myself. And any Inheritances supporting my enemies...are only setting themselves to be ruined groups that will no longer be able to call themselves Inheritances in the very near future."
WAA!
His will could be felt radiantly in his words as in the distance, the eyes of Eirkson's underlings shook with brilliance!
Erikson smiled as if he expected this answer, his eyes wildly gazing into the distance as his words continued.

"You are a hard one to understand. But let me know of anything that I can do in order to bring you over to the Sima Clan. We do more than quarrel about power and standing as we know the real threat out there. Fostering and supporting unique existences like you is only our duty."
A heavy sense of responsibility raged with his words, giving a stark contrast to the carefree way he dressed and moved!
He didn't stay long as after watching the river of stellar black blood leaking from the Prion Armadillo before Noah, he shouted out into the distance while leaving one last resonant message.

"I received word from a Hyperversal Extremity of Foreordination of the Sima Clan that the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification we're in will be abnormally short, even possibly ending over the next few days as the Culmination Step will be ushered in with a surge of even more chaos."
A communication standing by itself as it was only directed towards Noah while Erikson disappeared, his retinue following behind him as Noah only smiled at such a message.
Of course the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification was ending in an abnormally short period of time.
After all, his Reified Sources of Extremity were sweeping away enormous numbers of treasures like the [Blazing Hyphae of Extremity] across the endless area of the Vein of Dissolution!
And in the Culmination Step to come where Apex Aeonic Lifeforms joined the fray...he would be even more ready for such a stage as a part of him was finishing up the process of Apexification!

chapters.title: Chapter 2517 Obscene Values! I
paragraphs: An extended banquet table filled with trays pulsing with the aura of EPOCH Relics could be seen, vibrant and mouth watering meats from ancient Beasts cooked under the flames of Boundaries seen filling these radiant trays.

The laughter of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could be heard as on seats that looked like thrones, the figures of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Singularity Overseers, Genesis Institute of Extremity, and Noblesse could be seen mingling and enjoying a grand feast.

Noblesse Reverend Emperors with pristine beauty, men and women alike, could be seen moving around the stellar banquet table and constantly refilling drinks and foods that shimmered with the aura of Aeonic Treasures of Extremity.
Everyone here were Allies in the upcoming war as they cordially got together to discuss everything to do with this war and the ongoing Extremity Sanctification of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution!
At this moment, a burst of boisterous laughter rang out from one side of the table that showed a scowling Singularity Elder beside Zeitgeist speaking.

"Haha, so it really seems this genius has condemned his whole Bloodline to death. So what if he attained an Absolute Seed of Extremity? The weight of all that blood on his shoulders would be more than enough to prevent him from even reaching the 17th Boundary Layer!"
A light of jealousy and distaste could be felt within his words and eyes as those around him laughed ruefully.
Each of them dearly wished for an Absolute Seed of Extremity, but most felt that it would be forever outside their grasp as they couldn't help but lament!
When knowing that a Mutated Entity who could attain such a thing even before Apexification existed, they couldn't help but envy!
"Didn't I hear rumors that the Singularity Overseers welcomed another Hyperversal Extremity not too long ago with an Absolute Seed of Extremity? Comparing that to a being who..."
Discussions continued with harmony as these Lifeforms talked about their Inheritances and any pertinent issues.
Towards the center of the table, Commander Vladic sat beside Grand Genesis Elder Meiying as his expression was visibly darkand he wasn't participating in any of the festivities!
How could he when much of it involved disparaging the one being he could not kill in this Apex War?
Even now, his mind buzzed with possibilities as he sought for a way in what seemed like an impossible situation!
Meiying saw this as she sighed while speaking to him mentally.

"Sometimes, the powers that be make it impossible for things you consider fair to occur. You will simply need to let it go and allow the Annihilation of his Lineage to serve as a recompense, otherwise-"
BOOM!

Before Grand Genesis Elder Meiying could finish her words, their surroundings buzzed as the illusory dome above them cracked to reveal stellar bodies littered in the distance, the forms of 5 Apex Aeonic Lifeforms floating above the cracks of the domain!
The number was very low compared to all the Apex Aeonic
Lifeforms here, but their auras were simply maddening to feelespecially the red robed being at the lead of this force.
His body rhythmically with a heavy force of haki that made even Grand Singularity Elder Zeitgeist and Grand Genesis Elder Meiying change their gazes and become entirely somber.
His aura alone let them know he was many times more powerful than them!
His eyes were sharp as within them, Destruction danced freely.
As he saw the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms below him rise and their Dynamis surge out protectively, Ahpuch smiled and spoke calmly.
"Why hello there, friends. I don't suppose you would deny any extra help for this Apex War of Annihilation? Since the quality of Lifeforms here seems really lackluster!"
WAA!
The gazes of most of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms here changed at his provocative words.
Most.

Commander Vladic's heart pulsed with joy as when he felt the oppressive aura of this being that seemed many times more suffocating than Meiying, he rose up to welcome him happily as it felt like his prayers were getting answered!
[The Tenth Boundary Layer of Quintessence]:: An important threshold has been crossed as with it comes the stage of a new life.

The closer you get towards Extremity, the more that Quintessence has to live up to its distinction. The 10th Boundary Layer is one such distinction as any Concept of Extremity you personally begin expanding will instantly be elevated to the 9th Boundary Layer.

Upto 81 Boundaries can now be deemed Quintessential, with the limitation of the Quintessential Apocryphal Layers being applied only to the highest Boundary Layer that Quintessence itself has reached being abolished. Now, any Concepts of Extremity deemed Quintessential will also be afforded the authority to expand from the 10th and into the 11th Boundary Layer at no cost to the user...] [...Your standing as a Quintessential Aeonic Curator is further strengthened as you can now alter your Recorded History of Extremity, including but not limited to the editing of the usage of Boundary Layers of any concept apart from Quintessence. You can now peer into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity of other existences with lesser soul values, and you can edit their own Recorded History at the cost of your Soul Values. At this new stage, Quintessence also ponders to you a question. After Golden, Obsidian, and Consummate Boundaries, is the next stage truly only limited to Extremity Boundaries?]
Before Noah's eyes, there was a group of too much information.
Information about the body being forged from the 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians.
Information about the 10th Boundary Layers of 81 Boundaries!
There was an excess of such information as Noah sorted through all of it while pulling up the Boundary Layer of Quintessence first!

This was now a Crimson Consummate Boundary as its abilities became even more obscene, with something as ridiculous as the fact that due to Quintessence...any concept that Noah expanded from now on would instantly be raised to the 9th Boundary Layer.
No need for any Aeonic Treasures of Extremity.
No need for Sources of Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity.
No need to ponder or spend years like others!

He could choose a concept and expand it towards Extremity with a beckoning of his soul as moments after, it would attain the highest that Boundary Expansion Realm experts could attain before Apexification.
This was Quintessence.
This was a distinguished 10th Boundary Layer!

Each of them dearly wished for an Absolute Seed of Extremity, but most felt that it would be forever outside their grasp as they couldn't help but lament!
When knowing that a Mutated Entity who could attain such a thing even before Apexification existed, they couldn't help but envy!
"Didn't I hear rumors that the Singularity Overseers welcomed another Hyperversal Extremity not too long ago with an Absolute Seed of Extremity?
Comparing that to a being who..."
Discussions continued with harmony as these Lifeforms talked about their Inheritances and any pertinent issues.
Towards the center of the table, Commander Vladic sat beside Grand Genesis Elder Meiying as his expression was visibly darkand he wasn't participating in any of the festivities!
How could he when much of it involved disparaging the one being he could not kill in this Apex War?
Even now, his mind buzzed with possibilities as he sought for a way in what seemed like an impossible situation!
Meiying saw this as she sighed while speaking to him mentally.
"Sometimes, the powers that be make it impossible for things you consider fair to occur.
You will simply need to let it go and allow the Annihilation of his Lineage to serve as a recompense, otherwise-"
BOOM!

Before Grand Genesis Elder Meiying could finish her words, their surroundings buzzed as the illusory dome above them cracked to reveal stellar bodies littered in the distance, the forms of 5 Apex Aeonic Lifeforms floating above the cracks of the domain!
The number was very low compared to all the Apex Aeonic
Lifeforms here, but their auras were simply maddening to feelespecially the red robed being at the lead of this force.
His body rhythmically with a heavy force of haki that made even Grand Singularity Elder Zeitgeist and Grand Genesis Elder Meiying change their gazes and become entirely somber.
His aura alone let them know he was many times more powerful than them!
His eyes were sharp as within them, Destruction danced freely.
As he saw the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms below him rise and their Dynamis surge out protectively, Ahpuch smiled and spoke calmly.
"Why hello there, friends.
I don't suppose you would deny any extra help for this Apex War of Annihilation?
Since the quality of Lifeforms here seems really lackluster!"
WAA!
The gazes of most of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms here changed at his provocative words.
Most.

Commander Vladic's heart pulsed with joy as when he felt the oppressive aura of this being that seemed many times more suffocating than Meiying, he rose up to welcome him happily as it felt like his prayers were getting answered!
[The Tenth Boundary Layer of Quintessence]:: An important threshold has been crossed as with it comes the stage of a new life.
The closer you get towards Extremity, the more that Quintessence has to live up to its distinction.
The 10th Boundary Layer is one such distinction as any Concept of Extremity you personally begin expanding will instantly be elevated to the 9th Boundary Layer.

Upto 81 Boundaries can now be deemed Quintessential, with the limitation of the Quintessential Apocryphal Layers being applied only to the highest Boundary Layer that Quintessence itself has reached being abolished.

Now, any Concepts of Extremity deemed Quintessential will also be afforded the authority to expand from the 10th and into the 11th Boundary Layer at no cost to the user...] [...Your standing as a Quintessential Aeonic Curator is further strengthened as you can now alter your Recorded History of Extremity, including but not limited to the editing of the usage of Boundary Layers of any concept apart from Quintessence.
You can now peer into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity of other existences with lesser soul values, and you can edit their own Recorded History at the cost of your Soul Values.
At this new stage, Quintessence also ponders to you a question.
After Golden, Obsidian, and Consummate Boundaries, is the next stage truly only limited to Extremity Boundaries?]
Before Noah's eyes, there was a group of too much information.
Information about the body being forged from the 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians.
Information about the 10th Boundary Layers of 81 Boundaries!
There was an excess of such information as Noah sorted through all of it while pulling up the Boundary Layer of Quintessence first!

This was now a Crimson Consummate Boundary as its abilities became even more obscene, with something as ridiculous as the fact that due to Quintessence...any concept that Noah expanded from now on would instantly be raised to the 9th Boundary Layer.
No need for any Aeonic Treasures of Extremity.
No need for Sources of Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity.
No need to ponder or spend years like others!

He could choose a concept and expand it towards Extremity with a beckoning of his soul as moments after, it would attain the highest that Boundary Expansion Realm experts could attain before Apexification.
This was Quintessence.
This was a distinguished 10th Boundary Layer!

chapters.title: Chapter 2518 Obscene Values! II
paragraphs: 2518 Obscene Values! II

The effects of the 10th Boundary Layer of Quintessence were astounding, but Noah knew they were only this obscene for him as the same Layer expanded by his Vassals...would in no way grant the same boons.

Apart from automatically taking any concept Noah expanded as a Boundary to the 9th Layer, Quintessence alone made it so that 81 concepts could be deemed Quintessential as they would even be taken to the 11th Boundary Layer through this!

Noah simply had to express this authority for Quintessence itself and any other Boundary deemed Quintessential as when the 11th Boundary Layer was attained for one...the effects of the 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians would kick in and take the rest of the boundaries to this Layer as well.
It was simply an obscene reality for any other beings to watch.
The description of the 10th Boundary Layer of Quintessence even ended with a question as it seemed to indicate that after Crimson Consummate Boundaries and before a Boundary reached
Extremity...there should still be something grand that Noah could attain as the answer may just lie with Quintessence!
Only time would tell.
But for now...Noah continued perusing the dazzling swathes of information regarding Boundaries while the Apexification of a part of him continued!
The overbearing pressure of Dissolution and Penumbra mixed in to clutter everything in the surroundings.
It would even make breathing difficult if one didn't have a Dynamis of Extremity or a form of even greater authority backing them up!

A figure of another one of Noah's body was in such a region that consisted of cracks between Havens, where he had traversed far enough that currently, the authority of Dissolution and Penumbra were the two most pressing ones here.
But he and Grand Primeval Elder Silas did not move too much further in the past day as they were being located by someone much more powerful than them, and at this moment...
SHIING!

A runestone pulsed within the body of Grand Primeval Elder Silas as his eyes quickly opened with respect, gazing above them as the overbearing authority which seemed like it could crush Reverends parted ways like nothing, a bright shadow filled with stellar light coming in as it materialized into a figure pulsing with thick authority of a Hyperversal Extremity!
"Esteemed Shadow Extremity..."
Even before the figure was unveiled, Silas rose and bowed down with utmost reverence while a peal of clear laughter rang out along with a serene feminine voice.
[At ease, Silas. We're here for a happy occasion after all.] ...!
The voice caused him to become shocked as Silas bowed down even further, his eyes burning with a light of intense respect and even a hint of fanaticism as he called out.
"Extremity Gabriella...I thought Master was the one making his way here."
Hyperversal Extremity of Shadows, Gabriella!

For Grand Primeval Elder Silas to be acting like this, it was only because this was the being who had singularly changed the fate of the Cult of Endless Shadows by locating and obtaining one of the 81 Armaments of Extremity hidden across history by the Hyperversal Extremity of Steel- the Shadow Sword!
For her to come here just to fetch them...he didn't think they were worthy of such an honor.

[I told your master to rest his old bones so I could come see the hotshot causing a buzz and putting himself in the center of the storm of an extremely chaotic Extremity Sanctification. Noah Osmont, was it?]
Her figure fully unveiled itself as Noah gazed at her descending from above.

A glowing black gold silk armament wrapped around her visage as thick Hyperversal Extremity Authority spilled out from it constantly in the form of Shadows, her face being the first Hyperversal Extremity Noah to see revealed as...
'Ridiculous...'
It seemed to break all bounds of realistic standards- as if all the authority of this being reaching Extremity had gone towards making her exceedingly beautiful and of majestic standing!

Bountiful dark hair cascaded way past her shoulders as it seemed to turn into stellar shadows below her, with her fair skin radiating power as on her forehead, a dark three pointed star was etched gloriously.
Her eyes held confidence and grandeur as her pupils infinitely swirled with darkness, with an existence like Silas not even daring to meet her eyes lest he be lost in them for the years to come!
But Noah...
His body pulsed with the grandeur of a being with an Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation as he gazed at her eyes calmly while nodding.
"Yes. I didn't expect the reception of the Cult of Endless Shadows to be so welcoming."
[Mmm...for you to speak so freely towards me- it seems you're really special. Alright, let's go.]
BZZZT!
Their surroundings seethed as all authority here was instantly replaced with a sparkling darkness of shadows.
Silas showed reverence at this pristine authority while Noah...his eyes became sharper as he felt how his current self wasn't able to do too much against such an authority!
It wrapped around them fully as the dreadful pressure of
Dissolution and Penumbra around them seemed to all but
disappear, the very space around them shifting and being displaced as before even a second passed...
Everything calmed again.
Noah gazed at their surroundings as the glowing darkness receded, and he saw that they were no longer in the cracks between Havens.

Behind them, massive churning tendrils of darkness rose up infinitely to form a wall they couldn't see the ends of, the space around them filled with dredges of broken stellar bodies and even split Planes of Existence that were unrecognizable.
With a single move, Extremity Gabriella had taken them within the cracks of Havens and into a brand new land.
[Thie should be your first time here, so let me welcome you...to the Aeonic Haven of Penumbra.]

Roiling dark clouds appeared below their feet as they were wrapped in Hyperversal Extremity Authority, their figures being pulled forward at a rapid speed as when Noah's will spread out, he found a stunning scene!

Extremely far in the distance...he could see that the skies and earth were filled with billowing darkness as across them...a crystalline Vein seemed to have risen from the earth below as it weaved across the skies endlessly, insanity-inducing power stemming from it as it was the Extremity Vein of Penumbra!
It had risen from whatever Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands it stemmed from as this was a Haven...that had long since been in the Extremity Step of Extremity Sanctification.

Noah's first arrival here was hastened by the arrival of a Hyperversal Extremity- an existence that had her will examining him ever since she appeared as she spoke with a smile while they barreled deeper into this Haven.

[In this Haven, there are countless shadows and darkness that reveal one's true heart. Osmont...what darkness hides behind your heart? Why did you wrap Silas here in an Oath as you now stand on the precipice of an Apex War?]
The words of a Hyperversal Extremity flowed freely as even though she was smiling, Noah could feel a feral sense of danger that caused his soul to burn fiercely with tyranny and Quintessence.
He didn't reply to her question as his soul sent messages to spur the portion undergoing Apexification at this very moment.

He sent a message to spur Alexander King to begin making the Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that would even mask and protect him from Hyperversal Extremities as a meeting with another one whose intentions could not be easily discerned made him move even faster!
