chapters.title: Chapter 2519 Obscene Values! III
paragraphs: Her eyes fluttered open.
And how could they not when she felt his will become focused on her?
Her surroundings were filled with bright golden seas of Loot Light as far, far above her, she could see 81 infinity symbols shining with a myriad of different colors of light.

Each of them acted like a conduit as they released rivers of liquified golden Loot light- light that had the vast majority of it concentrated on her all this time as even now, it continued to flow into her and made her ever more pristine!

Her eyes had fluttered open amidst all of this as she felt the Will of the one being she wanted to always be of use to- her Crimson gold pupils coming to see his manifested form before her floating with a light smile.
"Are you ready?"
His gaze was far reaching as his words seemed to be asking her about many things.
Was she ready to step back into the limelight? Was she ready to bear the weight of all things to come? Was she ready to act at this very moment?!
She knew with surety what the answer was.
"Yes, Master."
Ruination replied with confidence as one of the first things Noah was doing simultaneously at this moment included Ruination playing a big part!
After the grand authority of Apexification coursed through Noah's Infinite Forge of Extremity, she was worthy of playing many big parts.
Noah knew this very well as he stared at the Entity before him.
[Name]:: Ruination(Ruined Blade of Quintessential Extremity) [Lineage]:: Hyperversal Apex I Relic
[Titles]:: Ruination, Multiplicator, Emperor's Armament...
[Ruined Hyperversal Apex Mana Value]:: 1,000
[Ruined Hyperversal Apex Durability Value]:: Infinite
[Ruined Hyperversal Apex Soul Value]:: 1,000
[Ruined Hyperversal Apex Defense Value]:: 1,000
[Ruined Hyperversal Apex Damage Value]:: 1,000
[Features]:: Hyperversal Proliferation, Hyperversal Armament Replication, Hyperversal Outburst...
[Miscellaneous]:: A unique relic that supercedes normal Apex Relics by a large margin. As a Hyperversal Apex Relic, it is already setting its sights to become an Armament of Extremity...
His weapon alone that benefitted from the Apexification of half of his soul...it held the capabilities to unleash 1,000 Ruined Hyperversal Apex Damage Values with every swing!
And not just that. It held Infinite Durability.
It was a weapon that could not be broken!
It held a great deal of profound wonders to peruse through, but Noah's soul urged for him to complete his task as he focused on a single one of her features.
Hyperversal Proliferation.
Without a word, his hands waved out as before him, 9 vibrant buds that shone like singularities bloomed.
He currently held 9 Buds of Convergence that aided in the Convergence of Dynamis of Extremity.
For an Absolute Seed of Extremity, a single Bud of Convergence only granted 1% towards the rate of Convergence.
This was not enough for Noah to instantly achieve 100%
Convergence on a Dynamis he hadn't repeatedly used the
characteristics of like Indefatigable, Aletheian, and Vitalistic!
And one of the answers to this was Ruination.
The moment she saw the 9 Buds of Convergence, she smiled and waved her hands towards them as they came to swirl around her majestically.

Her body was suffused by a vibrant glow as her authority erupted out and wrapped around the Buds of Convergence, Noah watching with his own eyes as while the 9 Singularities whirled around her in one moment...9 more appeared soon after.
18 of such dazzling Loot had appeared and continued to swim around her as another instant later, the 18 pulsed and became 36!
HOONG!

An astonishing light gathered around her as her expression became stern, her Crimson gold figure radiating pure grandeur as she brought her hands together and clasped her palms before her blessed chest.
"YAA!"
A valiant cry echoed out from her as another 36 blinding Buds of Convergence appeared!

And the intensity of authority around her only became more concentrated as her figure blazed with halcyon crimson light, yet another 36 Buds of Convergence blooming as a total of 108 now whirled around her.

"Haa..." She breathed out a sigh of triumph as she gazed towards Noah with an innocent smile- a smile of a being looking to get praised for what she had done as Noah appeared in front of her and patted her head.
The terrifying Loot of Buds of Convergence were multiplied 12 times as it showed off the capability of [Hyperversal Proliferation] that Ruination could now do!

Something distinctive with this feature was that the factor by which a targeted Loot was multiplied by wasn't always the same- with this number varying depending on the type of Loot and its tier as the factor could be much greater...or much lower.
But the formed Buds were more than enough for Noah's purposes right now as they disappeared from the Infinite Forge.
Outside of the Forge hidden within the depths of Noah's soul, the visage of Alexander King could be seen with his musculature being formed by the 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians.
Even before all parts of him fully formed to finish Apexification, his right hand rose and pressed towards his chest where a
multicolored organ was forming.
And as it did so...a pulse erupted out as it thumped, oceans of essence rushing as the chest expanded because he had taken a Quintessential Breath!
He took a breath as many essences coursed through the body of a forming Apex Aeonic Lifeform as if it was coursing through paved roads.
Faster.
Stronger.
And much more inclined towards Extremity!
"Providence and Destiny..."
Alexander began to call out specific Boundaries as their authorities were brought close together, a halcyon light beginning to radiate from him as close by, Henry's figure observed intently!

After Providence and Destiny, the authorities of Pathfinder, Moirai, Fate, Karma, Fortune, Kismet, Wisdom, and Quintessence followed as they became like glowing lines that coursed through the forming body of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform- intent on forming an Absolute Seed of Extremity even before the process of Apexification fully finished!

chapters.title: Chapter 2520 Obscene Values! IV
paragraphs: Around the same time Noah enacted a new Dynamis of Extremity with a portion of his soul.
Within the Quasarian Lands, the figure of Grand Singularity Elder Zeitgeist returned from a banquet that just had powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms join.
Others returned to their abodes to prepare while he moved into what used to be the hidden domain where a young woman used to be.
In this hidden domain, the sea of abundant treasures filled with lifeforce still remained as currently, there was a maddeningly powerful aura floating at its very center!

It was the aura of a Hyperversal Extremity- and it was none other than Hyperversal Extremity Kabul who was dispatched here by the Hyperversal Extremity of Devouring yo ensure success in achieving the being with the Innate Pellucid Extremity Foundation!
"Brother Kabul."
Zeitgeist called out with reservation as he had already sent back the intelligence of all that occured in the banquet between the Inheritances.
The Hyperversal Extremity before him only nodded without even turning back as he spoke out serenely while gazing at the sea below him brimming with lifeforce.
[Zeitgeist, do you know the first thing that happens when a being attains Extremity?]
WAA!

He began with a question as Zeitgeist nearly rolled his eyes, knowing the tendency of this older brother of his to ask questions that he didn't really want answers to as he continued himself soon after..

[Their very existence- the records of their achievements and their very being become their own for them to manipulate. Their records become things that are erased from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity where other beings can freely access. But those who haven't...traces of their Existence will be found everywhere. And such traces can be utilized to do many things...]
As he spoke, Kabul's Hyperversal Extremity Authority seethed and spilled out from him, Zeitgeist becoming shocked as he asked to clarify.
"Brother Kabul, are you...are you moving to act against this being personally? I thought Master agreed with thr method of the Apex War and-"
[Zeitgeist.]
HUUM!
A single word stopped him in his tracks.
[The Methodology of this Apex War is muddy. Too many
ambiguities can occur as it is best to make a move before all of it unfolds.]
Zeitgeist had many thoughts crossing his mind as he pondered just what this Older Brother of his was thinking.

"Wouldn't something like this affect you adversely? The Adjudicator of Dissolution would be able to find out that it was the work of a Hyperversal Extremity as this could even ignite a conflict between her and Master. This is..."
He shouldn't have spoken. He didn't want to speak against it.
But...there seemed to be too many things at stake as Hyperversal Extremity Kabul smiled at the worry he showed, statung shocking words thereafter.
[These are actually the commands of Master. It seems the oh so great Adjudicator of Dissolution had long since sowed

dissatisfaction amongst others. For someone of lesser blood to hold such a distinction and her actions in the past...it seems others are planning on using this opportunity as a chance to shake the pillars that support her.]
WAA!
Shocking words left his mouth as his authority continued to spill over!

[But...you don't need to know too much about this right now. Just watch and learn what can be done with Hyperversal Extremity Authority as right now...I shall find histories of this Osmont and be able to track him down- a single shockwave of my soul being enough to cause the extinction of him and all records surrounding him. But of course...we shall talk first.]
Kabul.

He was decorated in a black Armament that was littered with three flat rotating planes of Existence. His dark hair was nicely trimmed with a fade as his eyes danced with wildness and age, his will diving into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity at this moment while focused on a single being!
While focused on Noah Osmont!
Before his eyes, countless lights bloomed as if a database holding the histories of all living beings was blooming before his eyes.
But his authority focused on a single being as the vastness of the Records was reduced, his will seeing trillions of Quintillions of bubbles of lights unfolding before him.
Each one represented someone's records.
Most shone with a white light as they seemed like clustered stars in a far away space, their size small and insignificant to show their worth and achievements in their Recorded History.
Some were darkening and disappearing even as Hyperversal Extremity Kabul watched at thus very moment!
And all this...was just focused on the Recorded Histories pertinent to the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution!
Kabul had seen scenes like this too many times as his authority burned ever brighter, his will using it to hone in on the identity that was Noah Osmont.
His vision fluttered across many white points of history as he was pulled ever deeper into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
'Hmm?'

This surprised him as it meant the accomplishments of this being were a bit more than above average, where the deeper in Kabul went...the sizes of the bubbles of light increased gradually until some that even shone with a radiant blue could be seen!
HOONG!

His Hyperversal Extremity Authority pulsed at this moment as it told him to gaze a certain direction, his target being right there as the nearby bubbles of light disappeared from his sight while he delved into a certain direction.
When the scene changed, the light around this region of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity had changed as Hyperversal Extremity Kabul felt a glow of crimson and gold light in thr surroundings.
This should mean he was deep in the Annals as...
'Where...'
His brows frowned as he didn't see a dense clusters of bubbles before him.
It seemed that only the aurora of crimson and gold light could be seen ahead as when Kabul expanded his will and looked up...
His mind buzzed.
He realized why he couldn't see any other bubbles of recorded history!

He hadn't arrived in the deepest parts of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity that radiated crimson and gold light as when he gazed up, he saw the far away edge of a massive bubble that shone with a glorious crimson gold light!
It's size was utterly massive.
Incomparable to any of the Recorded Histories he had seen in his lifetime.

As Kabul's will expanded outwards, he was able to capture it more with its entirety as he saw the scene of an immeasurably huge halcyon crimson bubble, dense blue and gold bubbles swimming around it as it occupied a region where trillions of other Recorded Histories could be!
And as Hyperversal Extremity Kabul stared and focused on it, his Will roared out in surprise as he felt the massive bubble of Recorded History before him fluctuate.
As if it had sensed something.
As Kabul stared towards this incandescent history...he felt as if he was staring into an endless abyss.
And the abyss...was staring back at him!

chapters.title: Chapter 2521 Obscene Values! V
paragraphs: 2521 Obscene Values! V
A massive crimson gold bubble of light taking the space of trillions of other Recorded Histories!
It represented an obscene amount of achievements worthy of being recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
It represented a being taking an obscene amount of space that showed his possible influence not just on himself, but the region his history was entrenched in.
With a size like this, Hyperversal Extremity Kabul would have assumed he was looking at a Hyperversal Extremity who had built up legends over countless years!

What he didn't know was that the existence who history was recorded here...even though he didn't have Hyperversal Extremity Authority, he already held an Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation.
He had already opened the pathway to multiple seeds of Extremity.
He had even created Extremity Foundations on many beings and paved open their pathways towards Extremity!
These were just a few of his achievements as they contributed to the obscene might that Kabul saw!
[Another Absolute Seed of Extremity has begun to be forged!]
For others, it was immensely hard unless they were extremely close to Extremity, or they had attained Extremity themselves.

Only at such a juncture would existences be able of forming Absolute Seeds of Extremity with their shocking Foundations and souls that had achieved or were close to attaining Hyperversal Extremity Authority!

But multiple factors came together as just when the strings of multiple authorities were about to converge into a single factor, the origin of Alexander King blazed as an Aletheian Haven of Extremity within cried out for inclusion.
The Will of the True Emperor of Quintessence gazed at it only briefly before he made his decision as Elysium burned with a halcyon light and joined the fray.
It didn't cause any disharmony as it complemented everything there and even made this forming Seed of Extremity ever closer to Noah!
And an instant after, the golden light of Elysium completed a forging Singularity as it turned into a bright Seed that waited for definition.
[A Fourth Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity has been born!]
[The unique conditions and resonance of the concepts within the Fourth Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity have placed its rate of Convergence at 30%]
A resonance of concepts that granted the greatest initial rate of Convergence so far.
But Noah was not able to enjoy it.
Because the moment this Dynamis formed, whether by Fate, Destiny, Karma, Fortune....or whatever else it may be, Noah felt a burning sense of disharmony as part of a vision of his soul changed.

This change was actually wrapped by the liquid halcyon light of the newly formed Fourth Unknown Dynamis of Extremity as Noah felt like he crossed countless light years, boundless information coursing through him with every passing glimmer of light as he realized he had deeply peered across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!

And a foggy vision cleared up until a radiant scene displayed itself to him, a scene of what represented who he was and all the records he had made...being gazed at by a horrifically more powerful gaze.
A gaze of a Hyperversal Extremity!
The will of this being seemed surprised at this moment as Noah's will was extremely calm in such a situation.
This was why he had urged himself to form a new Dynamis of Extremity that would even be capable of protecting himself against existences exceeding Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
This was why he couldn't depend on others like the Adjudicator of Dissolution to simply be there to protect him!
This was why at this moment, there was the advent of...
'Oraculum.'
BZZZT!
[The Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity burns brightly in your Aspects of Existence.]
His soul buzzed as he named the Dynamis that had even given him the ability to see the current scene before him.
The Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity!
Oraculum was a word that could closely be translated into a destined declaration or a prophetic decree.
Noah called it so as he wished for this Boundary to be something that could utilize Destiny, Fate...and all the other concepts included in it to decree and guarantee a destiny most befitting to him!
And oh did it serve him well right at its conception.
[The features of Adumbrative Viewpoint and Oracular Annals Curator have been born!]
A prompt that he perused through now, even though one of its abilities had passively initiated to bring him where he currently was.
Within the depths of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, it was [Oracular Annals Curator] that had allowed him to feel the seeking gaze of a Hyperversal Extremity and be capable of gazing back at him!
But...this wasn't enough.

So before the surprise from the Hyperversal Extremity before him faded, Noah had already taken his next move as 70 Buds of Convergence were instantly devoured by his soul- everything about them surging towards the just recently budding Oraculum Seed of Extremity as it shone with an utterly halcyon light!
[An astonishing Quintessential Achievement worthy of being documented in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!]

The first prompt came as Noah felt it closely reflected his size in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity- his vast edge seemingly increasing ever so slightly as he instantly took a Dynamis that had formed in less than a few seconds and took it towards full Convergence.
[The Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity has reached 100% Convergence!]
[An Absolute Seed of Extremity has bloomed within your Soul!]
[The Oraculum Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity is blossoming within your Soul!]
[The Oraculum Absolute Planar Domain can now be cast.]
[The feature of Oraculum Emperor's Touch has been born!]
[The features of Adumbrative Viewpoint and Oracular Annals Curator have been Quintessentially enhanced.]
A fourth Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity bloomed as now...
Now Noah felt like he was ready- activating Oracular Annals Curator right away!

His soul buzzed with power as what he had cast was born not too long ago as it allowed him to perceive a Hyperversal Extremity gazing at him, and now...it was boosted even further by the completion of the Convergence of the Dynamis of Extremity as he could now do more than just watch!

paragraphs: 2522 Obscene Values! VI

[Oracular Annals Curator]:: The authority of the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity has entirely changed your relationship with the Aeonic Annals of Extremity and your own standing to it as you are now aware of the breadth of your Recorded History, and its utilization to benefit you. You are now able to traverse across the Recorded Histories of other beings without their knowledge so long as their souls are lesser to yours in Value. Upon further enhancement, the feature can also entirely mask your Recorded History and the Recorded History of those connected to you within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity for the cost of 10% of your Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values every minute- allowing you to attain a right normally reserved for those who have achieved Hyperversal Extremity Authority...
A feature that was simple in its description and grand in its workings.

A feature that Noah activated the moment it was selected as before the Hyperversal Extremity before him could come out of his stupor, his Recorded History and everything that represented him and his people began to disappear!
BZZZT!
And at such a juncture, the will of the Hyperversal Extremity was roused as the visage of Hyperversal Extremity Kabul sharpened his eyes and instantly moved.

He suspended his disbelief and acted first as the massive crimson gold bubble he saw rapidly retreated, becoming a small point of light an instant later as the rest of the bubbles around it disappeared entirely!
Abilities of Absolute Dynamis of Extremity were things that Hyperversal Extremities commonly delved into as their workings were mysterious for each being.

Even at this moment, the Hyperversal Extremity Authority Kabul was utilizing stemmed from the very first Absolute Dynamis of Extremity he had managed to forge after attaining Extremity in Devouring with the efforts of his Master!
The abilities had their distinction in the name.
They were Absolute.
So why was a single dwindling point of crimson gold light still there after Noah had used [Ocular Annals Curator]?
Why was there a part of him not being able to be hidden away to the extent that the will of the Hyperversal Extremity Authority Kabul reached into it?!
The answer was a dazzling one.

[Every day, the Oraculum Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity will bud Oraculum Fruits of Extremity equivalent to the number of concepts in its makeup. The Oraculum Fruits of Extremity can be devoured as they are extremely conducive to raising the Boundary Layers of all...]
After the complete Convergence of the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity, its prompts continued to descend even though Noah's were currently filled with a blinding cold light of tyranny!

There was supposedly an Investiture of Extremity that all beings were bound by that made it so Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and Hyperversal Extremities could not freely massacre or interfere negatively against lower lifeforms.
And yet everything that had occurred so far showed loopholes and unfairness as simply...it seemed like a load of bull!
One could not depend on any set constructs, laws, or people as they had to depend on themselves.
Noah would depend on himself...but he would also use the set laws for his gains.

[The Authority of the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity will course across your Aspects of Existence to fortify your Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation passively when utilizing your Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi, granting an increase in all your Hyperversal Values unceasingly.]

[The combination of your Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi, Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation, and the authorities of the Indefatigable, Aletheian, Vitalistic, and Oraculum Absolute Dynamis of Extremity coursing through you has caused the strengthening and strengthening of your Aspects of Existence to reach an even more abnormal level, granting you an increase of +25 Hyperversal Soul Values, +25 Hyperversal Damage Values, +75 Hyperversal Defense Values, and +75 Hyperversal Vitality Values daily.]
Set in weaving grand plans, even Noah had to come to a stop on this particular prompt.
One of the True usages of the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity unveiled itself.

Noah's Main Body was not able to support another Dynamis of Extremity before Apexification as even with all of his terrifying methods, he wouldn't have been able to greatly increase his daily increase of Hyperversal Soul Values from +.5.

Yet after the completion of Vitalistic and Aletheian Dynamis of Extremity brought it to 2.5....the addition of Oraculum brought the daily increase of his power to an even more abnormal level as Noah's Main Body could now gain an equivalent of 25 Values of a newly advanced weak Apex Aeonic Lifeform!
The Defense and Vitality Values were even more obscene.

The elevation of the clone of Alexander King would open up unimaginable pathways for Noah's Main Body as his Foundation would likely grow to be something that utterly exceeded any possible limitations of a being's strength before Apexification.
This was the level of overpowered grandeur Noah was going for as there were others like the Hyperversal Extremity who just targeted him wishing to put an end to his glorious journey!
And it was why he was scheming against such beings.
As he marveled at the wonders a nearly completed Apexification would bring, the scheme he had put into motion unfolded at this juncture.

He had left behind a sliver of his Recorded History in front of the unknown Hyperversal Extremity gazing at him, making it seem like he was unbelievably in the process of masking or hiding it as it was just taking time before it fully disappeared.
But the moment Noah cast Oracular Annals Curator, he could have masked his Recorded History from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity instantly!
A shred of it was left as this portion of Recorded History...Noah pulled it ever so closer towards a certain clone of his.
A clone situated near an existence surrounded by mystery...the veiled Adjudicator of Dissolution!

He even went as far as having this Clone rise and look above with a grim expression, the pulled Recorded History becoming manifested closely to this part of his soul as the Will of the Adjudicator of Dissolution was roused to lock onto him.
And an instant later...she perceived a foreign Hyperversal Extremity Authority actually reach out its grasps towards a part of this being before her as...
BOOOM!
[You!]
A single word filled with bone cold apathy and a shred of disbelief.
It was followed by a torrential explosion of Hyperversal Extremity Authority as from calmness in one moment, it felt like the end of Reality was coming in the next!
A shocking eruption of Hyperversal Extremity Authority erupted deep in the Aeonic Annals of Dissolution.
Far outside of it, in a hidden Infinite Hyperversal Haven the size of a grain of sand...

The one to scheme and bring this event to fruition stared as the last pieces of fair stellar skin appeared on his clone that was Alexander King, his body simmering with brilliance as at this scene....his will burst out to see where it had arrived.
What stage had the Apex Aeonic Lifeform version of himself reached with the Foundation he held and everything else?
The answer was a disgustingly obscene one.

You are now able to traverse across the Recorded Histories of other beings without their knowledge so long as their souls are lesser to yours in Value.

Upon further enhancement, the feature can also entirely mask your Recorded History and the Recorded History of those connected to you within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity for the cost of 10% of your Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values every minute- allowing you to attain a right normally reserved for those who have achieved Hyperversal Extremity Authority...
A feature that was simple in its description and grand in its workings.

A feature that Noah activated the moment it was selected as before the Hyperversal Extremity before him could come out of his stupor, his Recorded History and everything that represented him and his people began to disappear!
BZZZT!
And at such a juncture, the will of the Hyperversal Extremity was roused as the visage of Hyperversal Extremity Kabul sharpened his eyes and instantly moved.

He suspended his disbelief and acted first as the massive crimson gold bubble he saw rapidly retreated, becoming a small point of light an instant later as the rest of the bubbles around it disappeared entirely!
Abilities of Absolute Dynamis of Extremity were things that Hyperversal Extremities commonly delved into as their workings were mysterious for each being.

Even at this moment, the Hyperversal Extremity Authority Kabul was utilizing stemmed from the very first Absolute Dynamis of Extremity he had managed to forge after attaining Extremity in Devouring with the efforts of his Master!
The abilities had their distinction in the name.
They were Absolute.
So why was a single dwindling point of crimson gold light still there after Noah had used [Ocular Annals Curator]?
Why was there a part of him not being able to be hidden away to the extent that the will of the Hyperversal Extremity Authority Kabul reached into it?!
The answer was a dazzling one.
[Every day, the Oraculum Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity will bud Oraculum Fruits of Extremity equivalent to the number of concepts in its makeup.
The Oraculum Fruits of Extremity can be devoured as they are extremely conducive to raising the Boundary Layers of all...]
After the complete Convergence of the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity, its prompts continued to descend even though Noah's were currently filled with a blinding cold light of tyranny!

There was supposedly an Investiture of Extremity that all beings were bound by that made it so Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and Hyperversal Extremities could not freely massacre or interfere negatively against lower lifeforms.
And yet everything that had occurred so far showed loopholes and unfairness as simply...it seemed like a load of bull!
One could not depend on any set constructs, laws, or people as they had to depend on themselves.
Noah would depend on himself...but he would also use the set laws for his gains.

[The Authority of the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity will course across your Aspects of Existence to fortify your Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation passively when utilizing your Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi, granting an increase in all your Hyperversal Values unceasingly.]

[The combination of your Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi, Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation, and the authorities of the Indefatigable, Aletheian, Vitalistic, and Oraculum Absolute Dynamis of Extremity coursing through you has caused the strengthening and strengthening of your Aspects of Existence to reach an even more abnormal level, granting you an increase of +25 Hyperversal Soul Values, +25 Hyperversal Damage Values, +75 Hyperversal Defense Values, and +75 Hyperversal Vitality Values daily.]
Set in weaving grand plans, even Noah had to come to a stop on this particular prompt.
One of the True usages of the Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity unveiled itself.

Noah's Main Body was not able to support another Dynamis of Extremity before Apexification as even with all of his terrifying methods, he wouldn't have been able to greatly increase his daily increase of Hyperversal Soul Values from +.5.

Yet after the completion of Vitalistic and Aletheian Dynamis of Extremity brought it to 2.5....the addition of Oraculum brought the daily increase of his power to an even more abnormal level as Noah's Main Body could now gain an equivalent of 25 Values of a newly advanced weak Apex Aeonic Lifeform!
The Defense and Vitality Values were even more obscene.

The elevation of the clone of Alexander King would open up unimaginable pathways for Noah's Main Body as his Foundation would likely grow to be something that utterly exceeded any possible limitations of a being's strength before Apexification.
This was the level of overpowered grandeur Noah was going for as there were others like the Hyperversal Extremity who just targeted him wishing to put an end to his glorious journey!
And it was why he was scheming against such beings.
As he marveled at the wonders a nearly completed Apexification would bring, the scheme he had put into motion unfolded at this juncture.

He had left behind a sliver of his Recorded History in front of the unknown Hyperversal Extremity gazing at him, making it seem like he was unbelievably in the process of masking or hiding it as it was just taking time before it fully disappeared.
But the moment Noah cast Oracular Annals Curator, he could have masked his Recorded History from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity instantly!
A shred of it was left as this portion of Recorded History...Noah pulled it ever so closer towards a certain clone of his.
A clone situated near an existence surrounded by mystery...the veiled Adjudicator of Dissolution!

He even went as far as having this Clone rise and look above with a grim expression, the pulled Recorded History becoming manifested closely to this part of his soul as the Will of the Adjudicator of Dissolution was roused to lock onto him.
And an instant later...she perceived a foreign Hyperversal Extremity Authority actually reach out its grasps towards a part of this being before her as...
BOOOM!
[You!]
A single word filled with bone cold apathy and a shred of disbelief.
It was followed by a torrential explosion of Hyperversal Extremity Authority as from calmness in one moment, it felt like the end of Reality was coming in the next!
A shocking eruption of Hyperversal Extremity Authority erupted deep in the Aeonic Annals of Dissolution.
Far outside of it, in a hidden Infinite Hyperversal Haven the size of a grain of sand...

The one to scheme and bring this event to fruition stared as the last pieces of fair stellar skin appeared on his clone that was Alexander King, his body simmering with brilliance as at this scene....his will burst out to see where it had arrived.
What stage had the Apex Aeonic Lifeform version of himself reached with the Foundation he held and everything else?
The answer was a disgustingly obscene one.
[Name]:: Alexander King(Noah Osmont)
[Realm]:: Fourth Aletheian Haven of Extremity
[Lineage]:: Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor
[Titles]:: True Emperor of Quintessence, Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor, One Who Gazes Upon Hyperversal Authority, Aletheian, Indefatigable, Tyrannical Emperor...
[Quintessential Hyperversal Mana Value]:: Infinite
[Quintessential Hyperversal Vitality Value]:: 5,999
[Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Value]:: 4,999
[Quintessential Hyperversal Defense Value]:: 5,999
[Quintessential Hyperversal Damage Value]:: 4,999
[Hyperversal Dignity]:: 2
[Hyperversal Mastery]:: 2
[Absolute Hyperversal Authority Resistance]:: 15%
[Dynamis of Extremity]:: Indefatigable(Absolute), Aletheian(Absolute), Vitalistic(Absolute), Oraculum(Absolute)
[Boundaries of Extremity]:: Quintessence, Blood, Manadynamics, Loot, Reality, Dimensions, Anima, Body, Origin, Soul, Genesis, Apocalypse, Prana, Dreams, Avalon...

chapters.title: Chapter 2523 Rage Against the Dying Light! I
paragraphs: A stat panel that showed utterly magisterial values presented itself as the visage of Alexander King glowed with quintessence.

It couldn't be described by anything else other than quintessence as his eyes carried the emerald glow of the Absolute Vitalistic Clones of Extremity while pulsing with golden light from the intensity of the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity!
Soul Values and Damage Values of 4,999!
Vitality and Defense Values of 5,999!
Mind you...a non-unique Apex Aeonic Lifeform had an average Value of 1!

The reason for such abnormal numbers on the Apexification of Noah's were all due to his Foundation, unique Origin and Soul, and the many Concepts he held which all reached the 10th Boundary Layer right at Apexification.
Most other beings had a single Boundary achieve the 10th Boundary Layer, but most other beings didn't define themselves by 81 Concepts like Noah did.
Due to the large number of Boundaries achieving the 10th Boundary Layer, there were some that were particularly generous in their boons!

{The 10th Boundary Layer of Prana}:: An astonishing force of life rages within you as Prana permeates and pulses with vitality across your very cells constantly, granting you an additional +100 Quintessential Hyperversal Vitality Values.

Prana's 10th Boundary Layer was short and simple, yet it showed just how pristine and shocking a Crimson Consummate Boundary was as its 10th Layer alone was equivalent to nearly all the Vitality Values that Euryale held before she perished under Noah's hands.
His single Boundary was worth that much!
Multiple other boundaries in Noah's roster granted similar boons as they were the reason for the ridiculously high initial Quintessential Hyperversal Values.

{The 10th Boundary Layer of the Soul}:: A Quintessential Hyperversal Soul stands gloriously above others as it strives to reinforce that which it defines. Its mere presence at the 10th Boundary Layer grants you an additional +150 Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values. The breadth of your soul is expanded ever more as your Hyperversal Dignity and Mastery experience a boom to bring you ever closer to Extremity...
Many of his Boundaries were intent on bolstering either aspects of him as they contributed to his ridiculous values.

After that...his Values should experience another boost from all the advanced And all this was before he utilized the authority of the 10th Boundary of Quintessence to take any of his 81 Boundaries towards the 11th Layer.
After that...his Values should experience another boost from all the advanced Boundary Layers!
HOONG!
Wild waves of power emanated from the countenance of Alexander as all of his Vassals surrounding him felt their hearts palpate at his grandeur.
They had reached a new height as Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, and yet his aura surpassed them in such a manner that they felt like children before him!
Even the figure of his Main Body that had yet to undergo Apexification felt like a mountain they could never truly scale.

They were many times stronger than common Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, but most of them held the same issue of not being able to bring together different authorities to make an Absolute Seed of Extremity possible even though their Foundations had already paved the way towards it.
They gazed towards Noah with longing as they wondered.
Why was this? What were they missing?
WAP!
Space snapped as if it was squeezed while the astounding visage of Alexander King disappeared, leaving behind the magisterial main body of Noah as his people gazed towards him for answers.
As for where Alexander King had disappeared to...
In a verdant domain filled with golden misty light.
Nothing could be seen on what was occurring within as the most powerful Ancestor of the Lernaean Lineage was currently undergoing Dual Cultivation for the first time.
Amidst the dense golden mist, Aurelia bit her lips as she tried her best to allow her soul to concentrate on the connection and breaths of her body.

She felt like she had joined together with an endless conduit that held essence and authority that even exceeded her, and when she took the Quintessential Breath of Extremity at the same time as him during this connection- she was able to feel the lines of multiple authorities coming together much easier!
But still...it wasn't enough for her to grasp something as immaculate as an Absolute Seed of Extremity in such a short period of time.
BZZT!

At such a moment, she felt the domain buzz as an overwhelmingly powerful aura appeared, her will almost rising to attack when she noticed the familiar aura of dominance with the same being she was connected to.
Yet the power had far exceeded even hers by what- six times? Eight? It was unbelievable as she barely managed to get her words out.
"You...you underwent Apexification?"

"No, just a part of my soul contained in a Clone. I brought this part of me here because I will be forging my fifth Absolute Seed of Extremity through this body. Use this coming chance and connection to make sure you condense your Absolute Seed of Extremity as well."
Forging a Fifth Absolute Seed of Extremity.
He spoke of it so freely as even with her golden hair strewn chaotically on her head, Aurelia still gazed towards the arriving figure of Alexander King as she spoke with disbelief!
"Your fifth?! What the hell-...yaa!"
Her words weren't able to finish as the visage of Alexander King exploded with power.
"Focus."
His single word pulsed with irrefutable power as the Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity of Indefatigable, Aletheian, Vitalistic, and Oraculum flashed over his body.

He breathed in as thereafter, the authorities of Necromancy, Summoning, Apocalypse, Death, the Seven Deadly Sins....a great deal of concepts began to cycle around him as he was once more about to make something immensely difficult for others to do look extremely easy!

There were many things happening concurrently that his soul effectively handled, but he didn't pause on the things he planned to do as the moment many Boundaries began to revolve around his body, he also gave another command.
"Let Quintessence disintegrate any obstacles and attain the 11th Boundary Layer."

chapters.title: Chapter 2524 Rage Against the Dying Light! II
paragraphs: The Boundary that was Quintessential in its name.

The effects of its 10th Boundary were applied to itself first as an invisible dam seemingly broke, the aura around Noah's body of Alexander King becoming even more maddening because along with Quintessence going towards the 11th Boundary Layer...
HOONG!

His 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians carried out their utterly reality breaking feature as the rest of the 80 Boundaries within them also began surging towards the 11th Boundary Layer.
He kept going.
He didn't stop for even a second nor change his plans when he just came across a Hyperversal Extremity seeking to act against him!
A Hyperversal Extremity that at this moment through Noah's actions...faced the Wrath of the Adjudicator of Dissolution.
{You!}
The anger was understandable.

The disbelief in her single word was attributed to the fact that she couldn't believe a Hyperversal Extremity- an existence that had truly achieved Extremity...to actually act out against an existence that hadn't even undergone Apexification!
They had to first ignore their Dignity in order to do so.
They had to ignore the Investiture of Extremity and what it stood for.
They then had to utterly ignore her position as the Adjudicator who imposed the rulings of the Investiture of Extremity.
They had to think through all of this...and still choose to do what they were doing now!
The veiled eyes of Svetlana turned exceedingly cold as she didn't lift a finger.

Yet a maddening Hyperversal Extremity Authority erupted from all around her and ascended towards the foreign Hyperversal Extremity reaching out towards Noah, this whole region of reality instantly shattering as the will of Hyperversal Extremity Kabul on the other end was instantly alerted, becoming roused and trying to sink backwards into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity to return to his body!
His eyes were somber as his actions shouldn't have been found out until after he completed what he wanted to.
This was how he knew the authority of an Adjudicator to work!
If it wasn't actively in her vision when it occurred, she would find out about it within moments due to her authority as an Adjudicator.
She would know when the Investiture of Extremity was violated.

Buy knowing this after it happened...was utterly fucking useless for the weaker lifeform attacked while the more powerful one would be slapped on the wrist and set as an example for the future- telling others not to repeat such a thing again!

This was why even though it was something rarely done, Hyperversal Extremities or Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who weren't actively under the gaze of the Adjudicator would be able to achieve their aims and only be punished after.
But for Hyperversal Extremity Kabul to not even succeed and be found out...
His somber volition turned below him as he saw the visage of the body of the being he was looking for.
And on him, he saw...a smile.
He instantly understood what had occurred.
He...was baited? He? A Hyperversal Extremity?!
HOONG!

He was retreating ever faster across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as rage began to build within him, but this rage turned into shock a moment later as he felt his Hyperversal Extremity Will suddenly stop its movement back towards his body.
Thereafter, he actually felt it accelerate forward outside of his own control towards where he was escaping from!

This wasn't all as the thin strand of connection there was across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity was pulled upon...his body in the Quasarian Lands felt a tug as something unimaginable happened thereafter.
In the domain that used to be Xiaomi's home, Zeitgeist was watching Hyperversal Extremity Kabul's situated body with a hint of worry as a moment after...
CRACK!
The plane around them splintered as a crack appeared tight above Hyperversal Extremity Kabul!
{HOO!}

A bellow was heard from his roused body as he tried to erupt with maddening Hyperversal Extremity Authority, and yet it was as if an undeniable invisible hand ahead appeared, the Hyperversal Extremity Authority he was releasing instantly snuffed out as he was plucked away from this region!
He was plucked away as shockingly, he moved across the Recorded Histories of the very Aeonic Annals of Extremity towards where a part of his Hyperversal Extremity Will was currently contained!
It was a startling action as nearby, Zeitgeist felt his Aspects of Existence receive an enormous shock, blood leaking from his orifices as he staggered back.
Far away from this location, in a crack of darkness pulsing with Vacuous Hyperversal BOOM!

Authority, the head of the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction popped out inquisitively as he felt the massive waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority spreading out distinctly across different regions of the Haven of Dissolution!

And back in the domain where the Adjudicator of Dissolution's veiled visage was, her eyes coldly watched while a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity was plucked across the very Aeonic Annals of Extremity to appear before them- his body surrounded by terrifying waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority that was oppressive around him on all sides!

His face was ashen as he constantly enlarged and reduced in size, wisps of Absolute Dynamis of Extremity trying to rise and be snuffed out as even without lifting a finger, the massive and much more refined tier of Authority the Adjudicator of Dissolution controlled seemed capable of crushing Kabul entirely.
And at such a juncture...
{Master!}
He bellowed out with a guttural roar as he didn't feel any sense of communication coming from the Adjudicator of Dissolution.
It seemed that she only wanted to crush his Hyperversal Authority on all sides!
There was no rebuke or even a inquiring as to why he did what he did to buy time for his Master to come.
Things were not flowing how they wanted nor planned for.

The Adjudicator of Dissolution moved too swiftly without even inquiring as if she knew exactly what was happening, with her veiled figure not even batting an eye when she heard Kabul roar out the word Master!
Her gaze only became colder as from afar.
From outside the very Havens of Dissolution.
BOOM!
Reality seethed as an interminable force barreled through.
It seemed to be swallowing up reality, time, and space itself as it had both arrived...
and not arrived at this moment.
An dominance of heavy insanity and power.
The Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Devouring!

chapters.title: Chapter 2525 Rage Against the Dying Light! III
paragraphs: Everything was seemingly being swallowed up by an indomitable force as a terrifying aura unveiled itself, this authority being so potent that it even devoured time itself!

This could best be seen by what occurred next as even though this terrifying aura should have been arriving from a vast distance, the maddening aura from afar disappeared as if it was never there- and it instead blared up right beside the visage of Hyperversal Extremity Kabul who was getting ground down by the authority of the Adjudicator of Dissolution.
The maddening aura appeared here as if it had been at this location this whole time!
Tendrils of black and crimson darkness pulsed out powerfully as they acted like an endless shawl wrapping over this being.

A devouring darkness was constantly rising from the tip of his feet all the way to the top of his head as it seemed to be trying to swallow him alive, and one could only see his endlessly stellar pupils amidst this darkness!
His concept that he had taken to Extremity was Devouring as he had defined himself with it.
When a concept proceeded so extremely far in the bounds of Extremity, it would even be capable of doing what other concepts stood for- and sometimes even better!

He held the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Devouring, and yet he could swallow up and alter the orientation of time itself. He could traverse across great distances faster and more proficiently than any spatial concept.
And at this moment...
BZZZT!

The darkness around him rose as his hand reached out towards the struggling figure of Kabul, and this time...he devoured the nearby Hyperversal Extremity Authority itself as Kabul's sorry figure gradually became able to breathe easier!

The environment reality still buzzed and shook at the heart auras in this region as seeing the appearance of a second Hyperversal Extremity Authority, the Adjudicator of Dissolution seemed unphased as she didn't question what he was doing here nor what his purpose could be.
She knew his purpose very well.
She just didn't think such purpose would pull in the appearance of an existence who had forged an Absolute Seed of Extremity without even undergoing Apexification!
{Can you all no longer sit still?}
Her gaze was far reaching.
She did not just see Kabul and the Hyperversal Extremity of Devouring as she seemed to see other forces standing beside them as well!
And the Extremity shrouded with tendrils of Devouring stabilized Kabul as he spoke out with a voice that seemed to be eating away at one's Soul.

{Whatever could the Adjudicator of Dissolution be talking about? I'm here answering the call of my disciple who was having his very Hyperversal Authority ground down by the one who should be one of the Seven Protectors.}
WAA!
His words boomed out in this region as sheltered behind the grandeur of the Adjudicator of Dissolution, even Noah in the far distance had his eyes become sharp at the pressure this being emanated.
Kabul was a Hyperversal Extremity as Noah had felt firsthand how overwhelming his pressure was.
But this existence currently protecting Kabul...he made even this Hyperversal Extremity seem like a child!
It caused Noah to question just how wide the gaps of power were amongst Hyperversal Extremities.
As for the Adjudicator of Dissolution...she faced this pressure easily head on as she locked her gaze with the Hyperversal Extremity of Devouring.
She locked onto his eyes which were one of the few things revealed by this being.
His eyes.
She had seen such eyes too many times in her life.
Eyes filled with apathy and disregard for her very existence as they triggered a past memory to appear and disappear within a span of an instant.
An instant of a memory to her, but it was akin to her reliving many years in that instant!
{Dmitri...what are you?}
"Nothing."
{Sergei...what are you?}
"Nothing."
A massive existence was floating in a darkened space as he gazed down at an obsidian stellar disk of earth that held a dozen souls.
Each time, he floated to a different one and asked questions as his voice leaked with potent Hyperversal Extremity Authority!
All around this region, only an overwhelming darkness could be felt and seen as those here seemed like everything across existence.
The visage of the dark existence pulsing with Hyperversal Extremity Authority moved on to a different figure among the dozen.
{Svetlana...what will you amount to?}

The question was posed to a young woman who seemed to have barely entered adulthood with a head overflowing with dark hair, her eyes filled with immense darkness and a lack of life as she replied without any emotions.
"Nothing."
She answered just like all others, but...
{Look at me when you reply, girl.}
SPLUCH!
As his words ended, the left arm of the young woman became utterly shredded and destroyed- everything being turned to mush right up to the shoulder as black gold blood exploded out like a river!
Yet no emotion showed itself on the young woman as she turned her head up and gazed into eyes filled with utmost apathy and disregard for her and everything else in life.
Those eyes.
She gazed at them and replied emotionlessly once again.
"Nothing."
She was the last of the 12 as after she finished, the immensely powerful Hyperversal Extremity moved away and gazed at all of them.
{That is right. You are all nothing. You were born with nothing. And you determination die with nothing. Your only purpose is the mission. Continue this mission until the last moments of your life.}
WAA!
And a reply came out in unison soon after...
"Yes, Master!"
Darkness and coldness were all they could see.
And in such an environment...
{Good.}

The voice of the Hyperversal Extremity thundered out as his authority leaked out and surged towards all 12 beings below- filling their bodies until they ballooned up to the extent that their souls were about to break!
{Not many of you determination survive. For those whose wills can overcome...I will ask you to rage.}
HUUM!
{Rage against the dying light. When your spirit feels like it's about to be extinguished...fight. Fight and fight some more!}
The obsidian tendrils of Hyperversal Extremity Authority around him raged as his covered figure seemed to pulse with immense madness and at the same time, clarity.
{Rage, children. Because if you do not...you may never have the chance to even gaze upon the dying light.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2526 Rage Against the Dying Light! IV
paragraphs: A distant memory.
It came and left just as quickly as not even an instant passed, the Adjudicator of Dissolution gazing at the eyes that pulled this memory forward as she spoke coldly.

{Kabul has violated the Investiture of Extremity by attacking an existence yet to even undergo Apexification. For such a blatant action by someone of his stature...his Hyperversal Extremity Authority shall be stripped by half!}
For his blatant violation of the Investiture of Extremity, Kabul would be stripped of half of his Hyperversal Extremity Authority!

It was a shocking punishment that was meant to serve more as a message than anything else as with it, beings would be told that they shouldn't just expect Obsidian or Crimson Haven Albatrosses to bear the weight of if they violate the Investiture of Extremity.
But...the tendrils of Devouring around a certain being vibrated as he shook his head.
{No. Taking half the authority of a Hyperversal Extremity for merely gazing upon the Recorded History of a lower life form is an unreasonable price.}
He spoke with the same dominance and surety as the Adjudicator of Dissolution as if they were equals!
And yet the veiled figure of Dissolution turned her head as her fair hand rose up.
{You seem to be under the misconception that I was asking for permission.}
WAA!
{No...my punishment is already done.}
Her words were utterly cold as her fair hand that had risen came down!
And with it...
Behind the figure of the Hyperversal Extremity of Devouring, Kabul cried out as even under the protection of his Master, he found that a great chunk of his authority and power was fading away!

This was an unfathomable situation as the profound and powerful Hyperversal Authority of Devouring was all around him, and the authority of the Adjudicator of Dissolution shouldn't have been able to reach him.
And yet...

{Erasing the Recorded History of a weak-willed Hyperversal Extremity who would go as far as to blatantly attack lower lifeforms is an easy thing to do. Let this serve as a warning to any others alongside him. Erasing their records in the event of any violations...will be just as easy.}
Her voice felt chilling as Kabul's soul shuddered.
She had...erased so much of his Recorded History to the extent that half of his Hyperversal Extremity Authority was taken away?!

His soul felt the changes that were so profound that it shouldn't be possible for any common Hyperversal Extremity to even dream of it. And yet...he found to his horror that he couldn't find any knowledge or records of two of his Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
Not just that, he had lost any knowledge of a few dozen of his Boundaries, with the second boundary he should have attained Extremity in after Devouring...also being nowhere in sight!
{No...} His soul felt blank as if it had forgotten utterly crucial things that should have never left him.

He couldn't help but feel a sense of profound fear when he gazed towards the veiled Adjudicator of Dissolution as her power...it was actually so terrifying that it could go as far as erase the Recorded History that even included a Boundary that had reached Extremity? His Recorded History that shouldn't even be accessible by any in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity?!
Just...who was she?
In his fear, he floated ever closer behind the Hyperversal Extremity of Devouring as he felt his Master gaze towards the Adjudicator of Dissolution coldly.
{Letting it serve as a warning...what a curious thing for you to say, Adjudicator.}
His voice was deep as he gazed towards the surroundings, seemingly seeing through all veils and gazing at all of Dissolution as his eyes even came to lock onto Noah's visage.

{Do you know what is even more curious though? Most Adjudicators quietly observe their jobs and duties. Yet in the span of days, you've had multiple interventions publicly spread all around. Apex Aeonic Lifeforms killing lower lifeforms, hundreds of Scions perishing under your watch, an Apex War blooming, and now...even a clash against Hyperversal Extremities. It really brings to question your judgment and position.}
HOONG!

The shocking words caused even Noah's eyes to turn sharp as he felt the dense Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Devouring blaze, the very reality itself being devoured as the figure of the injured Extremity disappeared first.
At the shocking words, the veiled visage of the Adjudicator of Dissolution actually laughed sonorously as one could feel immense coldness in it, her voice booming out on all sides!
{How kind of you to worry about my position. When you are able to stand before my presence for longer than a few seconds before scurrying away, maybe then I'll take your worries with care.}
Words that utterly decimated the grandeur of the Hyperversal Extremity of Devouring echoed out.

In the far distance, a hidden figure of Ahpuch's Master, the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction- his visage drew a sharp breath as he was once more reminded how unfathomable the Adjudicator of Dissolution was!

Without trading any more words, the brilliant aura of Devouring fully disappeared along with the being that came with it- a massive void being left in space that the Adjudicator of Dissolution waved her hands to erase.

The surroundings then became veiled and distorted as she stared towards a far pocket of space where the aura of Destruction silently disappeared, her gaze then upcoming to land on Noah as she asked coldly.
{Why are dredges of Devouring looking at you?}

Even though she knew that part of this was due to her position, there also seemed to be more in play as when she focused on Noah, he only shook his head while gazing towards the twisting landscape around them.
"They seem to want one of my people who has an Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation."
WAA!
He spoke freely as the hidden eyes of the Hyperversal Extremity pulsed!

He held an existence with such a foundation?! Even though it wasn't as perfect as a being like him who had forged an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, it still meant that it was an existence that was reasonably assured to achieve Extremity in time as she would be sought after by any Inheritance or even the Seven Clans!

This being before her also seemed to become more and more unfathomable, but she had no idea that among Noah's people, there were multiple who were at the cusp of attaining an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity as there were dozens of Extremity Foundations just waiting for a missing spark to do the same!

When all of it was unveiled in the upcoming Apex War along with an massive number of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms that would make one think they stemmed from a powerful Inheritance of Extremity...the reasoning and understanding of reality would be warped for many!

chapters.title: Chapter 2527 Adumbrative Viewpoint!
paragraphs: {Adumbrative Viewpoint}:: Innumerable paths litter the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as Unrecorded Histories become Recorded Histories constantly. Truly powerful beings are capable of peering into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity and gazing at not just that which has been Recorded, but that which still remains Unrecorded. This capability allows you to view Unrecorded and Recorded Histories pertinent to your path, with your gazing of such history allowing you to more seamlessly select which path you will follow. When it comes to events deemed crucial by you in advance, this ability will activate passively to show you an Unrecorded History for the expense of 25% of your Soul Values. Active usage of the ability will cost the same as you can view a random number of Recorded and Unrecorded Histories pertaining to you or those weaker than you, with the cost of Soul Values varying when it comes to other targets...
The details of another feature of the Dynamis of Extremity that had allowed Noah to hide his Recorded History in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity unfolded before him as his Soul oversaw many things.

He was also digesting the events where he witnessed multiple Hyperversal Extremities clashing in the Haven of Dissolution as he was reminded of how many layers of mysteries the Adjudicator he was connected to had!
He needed more information.
He needed to be knowledgeable of what was occurring around him...and even what would occur in the future if he was to be able to dominantly continue his path.
The Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity provided for this need with its features, with the characteristic of Adumbrative Viewpoint being at the very forefront!

Inside the golden misty domain where the gazes of many were obscured, the valiant cries of Aurelia could be heard as while Noah performed Dual Cultivation with her and advanced 81 Boundaries to the 11th Layer, in addition to forming yet another Absolute Seed of Extremity...he silently cast {Adumbrative Viewpoint}.
BZZT!
Golden light overflowed from him.
His eyes showed astounding brilliance as if trillions of golden Singularities were being born.

Then...part of his soul became bathed entirely with the authority of the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity as it sank into a vast and endless locale that could truly only be reached and employed by the powerful.
And even by the truly powerful, they could only gaze upon what was already written and recorded.
Very few could observe what had yet to be recorded!

Noah's vision saw the budding of countless bubbles of light before him as he passed through every single one, all of them becoming mere points of light as for the first round, he thought of anything relevant to himself.
The countless glimmers of light pulsed and transformed before his eyes as soon after, all that his vision saw was a dazzling golden book.
Its covers were rough and ancient as if it had seen the vicissitudes of time, and yet its pages were clear gold as they were ready to accept eons of history.

The golden pages unfurled until they arrived at a specific blank page, words shimmering with the authority of the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity beginning to be written as alongside this, a fantastical scene bloomed before Noah's eyes.
{{...The surroundings were murky and filled with an overabundance of Sources of Chaos.
Rivers of blood flowed as deathly authorities ran rampant, a thick taste of death and destruction overwhelming any weak being as Commander Vladic looked at all of this with a blank expression.

He stood above the bodies of his lifeless brethren that formed into mountains below his feet, and yet a verdant obsidian authority curled in endlessly like a smoke as he saw the bodies of his people rise- their musculature spasming as from them, deathly skeletal atrocities that seemed to have at the very minimum 1 Apex Aeonic Soul Values rose.
At the very minimum!
It mattered not whether they were bodies of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms or Reverend Emperors, when they rose from death- they pulsed with a horror of at least 1 Apex Aeonic Soul Value!
KA! KA! KA!
They were only one of the reasons for him being where he was right now as in the distance, the cackling of a Lich reveling in death could be heard.
Dense clouds of verdant obsidian light covered everything else in the surroundings as he couldn't discern how everyone else was faring.
But did he really need to wonder? Was it not all just pure death?
Was what this...fiend before him brought really anything but death?

His blank eyes rose to find the visage of an existence billowing with verdant obsidian authority across his body, and yet his eyes shone with golden radiance as the pressure he emanated felt like it was crushing Vladic's soul even from afar!
The enemy commander that Osmont brought forth as his backing.
His name had been ringing out as chants from the countless Legions of atrocities rising in his wake!
As Vladic gazed towards his coming figure, he found his lips moving outside the control of his will as he spoke in a raspy voice.
"You think they will let you do all this without repercussions? To desecrate my Lineage and the very life forms of Inheritances? You..."
SQUELCH!

With a beckoning of his hand, a deathly verdant black bone spear stabbed out and impaled the figure of Vladic, thousands of Damage Values erupting out in a contained fashion so as to not destroy him right away while the voice of the fiend before him rang out.
"Relish this death."
WAA!
"Because from it, you will rise to become even stronger. This...shall be your atonement and gift for making today's reality occur."
His voice caused Vladic's soul to feel so extremely cold as he felt poisonous tendrils sinking into his Aspects of Existence- into his very Records and begin altering them!
Horrid fear rose in his heart at this as he thought of Euryale.
As he thought of how he got here!
He stared at the fiend...no.
"You...you are no fiend."
BZZT!
The last vestiges of his life left him as even in his fear, he managed to cry out in his raspy voice.
"Demon. You...are a demon!"

Noah's vision saw the budding of countless bubbles of light before him as he passed through every single one, all of them becoming mere points of light as for the first round, he thought of anything relevant to himself.
The countless glimmers of light pulsed and transformed before his eyes as soon after, all that his vision saw was a dazzling golden book.
Its covers were rough and ancient as if it had seen the vicissitudes of time, and yet its pages were clear gold as they were ready to accept eons of history.

The golden pages unfurled until they arrived at a specific blank page, words shimmering with the authority of the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity beginning to be written as alongside this, a fantastical scene bloomed before Noah's eyes.
{{...The surroundings were murky and filled with an overabundance of Sources of Chaos.
Rivers of blood flowed as deathly authorities ran rampant, a thick taste of death and destruction overwhelming any weak being as Commander Vladic looked at all of this with a blank expression.

He stood above the bodies of his lifeless brethren that formed into mountains below his feet, and yet a verdant obsidian authority curled in endlessly like a smoke as he saw the bodies of his people rise- their musculature spasming as from them, deathly skeletal atrocities that seemed to have at the very minimum 1 Apex Aeonic Soul Values rose.
At the very minimum!
It mattered not whether they were bodies of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms or Reverend Emperors, when they rose from death- they pulsed with a horror of at least 1 Apex Aeonic Soul Value!
KA!
KA!
KA!
They were only one of the reasons for him being where he was right now as in the distance, the cackling of a Lich reveling in death could be heard.
Dense clouds of verdant obsidian light covered everything else in the surroundings as he couldn't discern how everyone else was faring.
But did he really need to wonder?
Was it not all just pure death?
Was what this...fiend before him brought really anything but death?

His blank eyes rose to find the visage of an existence billowing with verdant obsidian authority across his body, and yet his eyes shone with golden radiance as the pressure he emanated felt like it was crushing Vladic's soul even from afar!
The enemy commander that Osmont brought forth as his backing.
His name had been ringing out as chants from the countless Legions of atrocities rising in his wake!
As Vladic gazed towards his coming figure, he found his lips moving outside the control of his will as he spoke in a raspy voice.
"You think they will let you do all this without repercussions?
To desecrate my Lineage and the very life forms of Inheritances?
You..."
SQUELCH!

With a beckoning of his hand, a deathly verdant black bone spear stabbed out and impaled the figure of Vladic, thousands of Damage Values erupting out in a contained fashion so as to not destroy him right away while the voice of the fiend before him rang out.
"Relish this death."
WAA!
"Because from it, you will rise to become even stronger.
This...shall be your atonement and gift for making today's reality occur."
His voice caused Vladic's soul to feel so extremely cold as he felt poisonous tendrils sinking into his Aspects of Existence- into his very Records and begin altering them!
Horrid fear rose in his heart at this as he thought of Euryale.
As he thought of how he got here!
He stared at the fiend...no.
"You...you are no fiend."
BZZT!
The last vestiges of his life left him as even in his fear, he managed to cry out in his raspy voice.
"Demon.
You...are a demon!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2528 The Curtains Draw Close! I
paragraphs: {{..."You are a Demon that Elder Ahpuch will destroy with surety. A demon that no Inheritance will leave alive! You-GOH!"

Vladic's Will and Soul were utterly torn as even his raspy voice couldn't be heard, and from his visage impaled by bones...a verdant black smoke bloomed and covered everything about him as a blazing authority of death began to rise from it!}}
The first page closed as the dazzling scenes Noah saw faded, the massive golden book before him beginning to flip towards another page.
His manifested Will smiled while gazing at the ancient book before him as he felt like a privileged reader who was gazing upon a history that had yet to even occur!
"A Demon, huh?"
He thought of the words Commander Vladic was saying before he was undoubtedly liberated by his doing as Alexander King.
He thought of the shocking descriptions of lifeless bodies rising again to have at the very minimum 1 Apex Aeonic Value!
It seemed the Absolute Seed of Extremity he was forming currently...was not something to be scoffed at as its capabilities were something to utterly dread.

He wasn't able to tell of the whole situation of the Apex War of Annihilation from the one Unrecorded History, but he could affirm that the Commander of the Noblesse Lineage would die even before the war was over as there was one name for him to pay attention to!
Ahpuch!
Even with the dreadful power Alexander King showed, Vladic still spoke with his fear that such a being could stop him?
Before Noah could ponder even more, the book before him had opened to another golden page as radiant halcyon runic words began to be etched.
The ability of Adumbrative Viewpoint would show a random number of Histories with every cast as Noah would attain an unknown amount of information each time.
And at the second Unrecorded History seemed to be especially radiant as another scene bloomed before him.

{{...Venous and vessel like structures could be seen snaking out for light years, the figures of a group of Scions passing across the top of such structures as their voices could be heard in the distance.

"Word is that fewer and fewer Golden and Obsidian Extremity Panaceas can be found. It's astounding when most of us were able to attain at least a Golden Extremity Panaceas, the number far exceeding what was recorded in previous Initiation Steps of Extremity Sanctification."
Their robes held a dazzling pink plum petal to signify their Inheritance as they moved further away, their voices still resonant.
"It also means the last Extremity Panacea should soon be appearing. Another Crimson Extremity Panacea...!"

Their voices held fervor as they moved away, not noticing that below them, amidst the intersecting venous structures extending in the distance...there was a calm aura that floated above a pool of obsidian liquid that held a thin dried out stalk at its very center.

No signs of life or even the powerful Leviathans of Dissolution were present as this being held a shining horn on her forehead, her hair filled with streaks of crimson and now, even more golden streaks of light as the temperature around her constantly fluctuated.
It was Ayame of Infinite Extremity!
While others guessed and moved haphazardly, she came to this location after much deliberation.

Her exceedingly beautiful face carried traces of hesitation as she waved her hands to show a few twirling Golden and Obsidian Extremity Panaceas, but her gaze remained on the area ahead as she waited.
She was unlike the others. She could peer into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as while others wondered when the Last Extremity Panacea would come, she had arrived at where it should bloom!
She...had glimpsed at something that had yet to even be recorded.
It cost her a lot to do this before undergoing Apexification as the only way she even had a chance of doing so was due to nothing other than her Origins.
Infinite Extremity.
There were many Inheritances and the Seven Clans out there- each had their own grandiose names.
Infinite Extremity...they were not simply a grandiose name. They lived up to it!}}
"Oh?"
Infinite Extremity.

He was given a glimpse that some factions held deep history and power that he The second scene Noah was shown held fantastical implications for Ayame that Noah had first come across during the scuffle with the Scions of the Genesis Institute of Extremity.
Infinite Extremity.
He was given a glimpse that some factions held deep history and power that he needed to carefully observe and understand!
And just as the Unrecorded History involving Ayame disappeared, the pages fluttered as another began.

It was all still under a single cast as all of it only showed the beginnings of Noah deeply understanding how reality would unfold in the coming future- where he would be able to understand his enemies in a way even they didn't understand themselves!
And just like this, time flowed.
Within the Aeonic Haven of Penumbra.

Unlike Dissolution, Penumbra shared a trait with other Havens that had already undergone Extremity Sanctification as it was exceedingly vast, with its explored lands under the dominance of many different factions.

The Cult of Endless Shadows had their hegemony centralized in a small segment within the southern region of Penumbra, and yet even this small segment had a wondrous array of Planes of Existence stretched out artificially in its own preset Planar System!

Noah had only now begun to near it while following Hyperversal Extremity Gabriella and Grand Primeval Elder Silas in tow as the blinding shadowy lights in the distance began to reveal more of this world of tantalizing darkness and shadows.
At such a time, the vibrant countenance of the Hyperversal Extremity in front of them turned around while speaking calmly.
"Your soul was tense this whole time until just moments ago. Whatever could have happened to cause your qualms against a Hyperversal Extremity to lessen even further?"
Hyperversal Extremity Gabriella asked with a smile as she found Noah's demeanor utterly unique.

Silas retained a respectful expression before this being while having already sent Noah multiple messages to show the utmost respect towards her- her standing being something not many in the whole of the Cult of Endless Shadows could match!
Yet Noah freely gazed back at her while his will took in the grandness before him, his words ringing out resonantly.

"What happened? A body of mine just watched a Hyperversal Extremity have half of their Recorded History erased from existence. It made me comprehend even the Esteemed Hyperversal Extremities aren't all that in the face of true power."
News hadn't yet fully spread as with the threat from the Hyperversal Extremity of Devouring, they were bound to.

The upper echelons of the Cult of Endless Shadows would be among the first to hear of the stunning event that had just occurred in the Haven of Dissolution, Elder Silas turning ashen at Noah's words and about to turn towards Hyperversal Extremity Gabriella to apologize when this existence actually laughed while her deep eyes locked onto Noah with even more scrutiny!

{You're truly living up to your name when you act like this...and you're making my anticipations all that much higher for you. Very well, enter our Cult of Endless Shadows and let us see more of you- we shall also deliberate when you can obtain the Shadow Sword, or if you are even qualified to begin with!}
A long expanse of shadows were cast behind her.
With her words, it seemed like the gates into the Cult of Endless Shadows truly opened at this juncture!
