chapters.title: Chapter 2529 The Curtains Draw Close! II
paragraphs: His authority gave the illusion as if he was as vast as an endless sea.
But he knew it was just that.
An illusion.
Within this illusion, he could see the scenes where stood on dark skies with the Hyperversal Extremity Gabriella and Elder Silas.

He could see his Reified Sources of Extremity moving across the vibrant and unique space within the Extremity Vein of Dissolution as they grabbed anything even shimmering with the essence of an Aeonic Treasure of Extremity.
He could see his figure standing before the Adjudicator of Dissolution, and his many bodies standing before many different existences.
He could see it all within this vastness that was himself as after a while...
THUMP!
The beat of his heart reverberated out and took him out of this illusion.
And instead...he stepped into the very real reality as he felt this vast authority in the form of multiple Boundary Essences coursing across his body.
This authority wasn't endless...but there was one thing that was.
THUMP!
Manadynamics joined the fray as Quintessential Hyperversal Mana proliferated all around.

It brought together the vibrant concepts of Necromancy, Summoning, Cthulhu, Apocalypse, Death, Pride, Gluttony, Sloth, Envy, Greed, Lust, and Wrath that were coursing through Noah's body with every breath!
The deeply cerulean Mana was telling him that it was time!

His portion of the soul that was taking on the identity of Alexander tuned out everything else momentarily but the task at hand as after activating {Adumbrative Viewpoint} and seeing the grandness of the next Absolute Seed of Extremity that he would make, Noah sought to even go above this as he expanded the base Boundaries he was mixing!
Manadynamics joined the fray to give this new Boundary the quality of endlessness.
With this quality in place, he then pulled in Niflheim and Entropy!
BZZZT!

His Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi buzzed as it supported it all efficiently for now, the number of Boundaries Noah was trying to fuse in this new Dynamis of Extremity already exceeding what the previous Dynamis held during their formation!
He wanted to add even more, but of course, they had to have a semblance of compatibility. Otherwise, even with his Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi- it would all fall apart.
He felt the many strands of authorities cycling in line through him as he carefully added...Aether and Conquest.
THUMP!
His heart beat resonantly again as his whole soul now felt a strain.
Yet his will was still bright as in the midst of concepts like Necromancy and Death...
"Add in the Concept of Life, Prana, and the Soul"
A verdant life flourished as both the Boundaries of Life and Prana joined the fray only to be followed by the concept of the Soul!

Since he had foreseen the very Recorded History of being like Commander Vladic be changed upon their death by the effects of this new Dynamis, the inclusion of the Soul among others would only magnify the brilliance.
But...the cycling authorities turned unstable as they seemed to say it was one too many and even possibly not aligned in their definition!
But the tyrannical will of the soul doing all this couldn't allow such a thing as to complete everything...
The radiant multicolored light of Quintessence shone.
It cascaded down and dominantly suppressed all others under its light, telling every single one to behave!
And...
{An unfathomable resonance is occurring with an extremely large number of concepts.}
{An Absolute Seed of Extremity unlike any other has begun to be forged!}
Manadynamics, Necromancy, Summoning, Cthulhu, Apocalypse, Death, Pride, Gluttony, Sloth, Envy, Greed, Lust, Wrath, Niflheim, Entropy, Aether, Prana, Life, Conquest, Soul, Quintessence
21 Concepts.
Noah was only attempting such a drastic thing due to the expanded breadth that his soul of Alexander King now held as an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!
THUMP!
The beat of his heart was resonant as another full cycle was completed.
There was no disharmony.
Quintessence forcefully corrected any discrepancies there were between the many Concepts and brought together a product of utmost majesty.
And the result was a glorious one.
{A tier of a Dynamis of Extremity belonging only to you has come to fruition.}
{A Quintessential Absolute Seed of Extremity has been born!}
SHIING!
His body of Alexander King shone with brilliance.
The visage of Aurelia that was connected to him in this misty domain...
"No way..."

Aurelia said out with hazy eyes as she felt the Convergence of an abstruse Absolute Seed of Extremity she had been feeling this whole time in her soul...she felt it all meld together under the impressive light of the seed being born within Alexander King!

As if it was ashamed that it couldn't be converged this whole time when something even grander than it was just converged in the body of the being who held the Sources of the very concepts Aurelia was trying to converge!
So ridiculously, two Absolute Seeds of Extremity formed simultaneously within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven at this juncture.
One within Caterina Aurelia Dismukes.
And the other was within an elevated portion of Noah's soul as what he forged was a distinctive type of an Absolute Seed of Extremity!
A Quintessential Absolute Seed of Extremity!
His soul burned gloriously with four Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity already.
And yet a mere forming Quintessential Absolute Seed of Extremity caused their countless branches to shake and flourish with even more brilliance.
{The Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity has named itself!}

{The Thanatos Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity has formed under unimaginably distinctive conditions- the resonance of concepts within it and its standing placing its rate of Convergence at 50%}
It didn't even wait to be named.
It named itself in a grand show of power as it named itself Thanatos!
A word that was steeped in death.
A word that was actually reminiscent to a river in the old Niflheim Dimension where grand battles were fought before!

Such a word forged into a blinding runic seed in Noah's Soul as even while it was 50% of the way converged, the grandeur it released seemed to be competing with the auras of the Perennial Yggdrasils of Extremity within his soul!
